invite:0.en: Grey Crow slid a data chip across the steel table. 'This access code will *invite* you past every locked door in the tower,' he said, voice flat. I pocketed the chip. Somewhere above us, Zero was already moving. The clock on the wall read 03:47.
invite:0.cnHint: 灰鸦把一块芯片推过来，说这个代码能____我进入大楼每一扇门。
invite:0.hook: But the chip felt wrong — too warm, too eager.
invite:0.line: 'This code will *invite* you past every door in the tower.'

million:0.en: The terminal screen filled with numbers. Ali leaned close and whispered, 'One *million* encrypted messages, all sent from this room, all on the same night.' I stared at the data. Someone had used this office as a broadcast hub. Zero had been busy. Very busy.
million:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现这个房间在同一个夜晚发出了____条加密信息。
million:0.hook: Every message was addressed to the same dead account.
million:0.line: 'One *million* messages, all from this room, all one night.'

represent:0.en: On the wall hung twelve coded symbols. Grey Crow traced one with his finger. 'Each symbol *represents* a district that has gone silent,' he said. I counted the dark marks. Twelve districts. Twelve blackouts. Zero had not been striking at random. This was a map.
represent:0.cnHint: 墙上的每个符号____一个已经断联的区域，灰鸦指着它们说。
represent:0.hook: The thirteenth symbol was still wet.
represent:0.line: 'Each mark *represents* a district that has gone completely silent.'

surprise:0.en: I opened the cabinet expecting blank drives. The *surprise* hit me like cold air: inside were stacks of printed transcripts, each one stamped with my own name. Ali went quiet behind me. Grey Crow did not move. Someone had been building a file on me for a very long time.
surprise:0.cnHint: 打开柜子时，我感到一阵____——里面全是印有我名字的文件。
surprise:0.hook: The oldest transcript was dated the day I was born.
surprise:0.line: 'The *surprise* is that every file in there carries your name.'

topic:0.en: Zero's broadcast cut through the static. The voice was calm, almost polite. 'Tonight's *topic* is simple,' it said. 'Who taught you to listen?' I froze. The signal was coming from inside the building. Ali grabbed my arm. Grey Crow was already at the door, hand raised: stop.
topic:0.cnHint: 零点的广播响起，宣布今晚的____是"谁教你倾听的"。
topic:0.hook: The broadcast was coming from the room directly above us.
topic:0.line: 'Tonight's *topic* is simple: who taught you to listen?'

meat:0.en: The safe house smelled of cold *meat* and stale air. Someone had been here recently — a half-eaten meal still sat on the counter. Ali checked the corners while I studied the table. A map was carved into the wood. Shallow lines, deliberate cuts. Zero had left a message.
meat:0.cnHint: 安全屋里有冷____的气味，桌上还有人刻下的地图。
meat:0.hook: The carved route led straight to the city's dead centre.
meat:0.line: 'Cold *meat* and a carved map — someone left this for us.'

drink:0.en: A glass sat at the centre of the interrogation table. Grey Crow said nothing, just watched me. 'Go ahead,' Ali said softly. 'It's just water.' I looked at the glass. In this city, you never *drink* what a stranger sets out for you. I pushed it aside and asked my first question.
drink:0.cnHint: 审讯桌上有一杯水，但在这座城市里我不敢随便____陌生人摆出的东西。
drink:0.hook: Grey Crow smiled when I pushed the glass away.
drink:0.line: 'In this city you never *drink* what a stranger sets out.'

sleep:0.en: Ali found me at the console at dawn. 'You need *sleep*,' she said, not unkindly. I shook my head. The last intercepted signal was still looping on the screen, the same three words repeating in the dark. I had to decode them before Zero moved again. Rest could wait. It had to.
sleep:0.cnHint: 阿栗劝我去____，但我盯着屏幕上反复出现的三个词，无法离开。
sleep:0.hook: Then the three words changed — and they spelled my real name.
sleep:0.line: 'You need *sleep* — but I know you won't take it.'

shop:0.en: The signal led me to a narrow *shop* wedged between two dark towers. Inside, rows of encoded data chips lined the shelves like canned goods. Ali was already there, turning one chip over in her fingers. 'Grey Crow said to find the blue label,' she whispered. The owner watched us without blinking.
shop:0.cnHint: 信号把我引到一家夹在高楼之间的____，伙伴已在里面等候。
shop:0.hook: The chip in Ali's hand began to transmit on its own.
shop:0.line: 'This *shop* sells more than chips — it sells secrets.'

electronic:0.en: Grey Crow's map was not paper. It was a living *electronic* grid, lines shifting every few seconds as the city's signal network breathed. I pressed my palm to it and felt a low hum climb my arm. Ali said nothing. Somewhere in that grid, Zero had left a trap.
electronic:0.cnHint: 引路人给了我一份不断变化的____地图，我感到其中隐藏着陷阱。
electronic:0.hook: One blinking node on the grid spelled my name in code.
electronic:0.line: 'The *electronic* map never lies — but Zero can make it mislead.'

wild:0.en: The data burst hit me like a wave — *wild*, unfiltered, every forbidden word Harbor City had ever banned, screaming through my skull at once. I grabbed the wall. Ali caught my arm. 'You heard it all?' she asked. I nodded, tasting static on my tongue.
wild:0.cnHint: 一股____的数据冲击了我的神经，包含了这座城市所有被禁止的词语。
wild:0.hook: Hidden inside the noise was a single calm voice saying my name.
wild:0.line: 'That *wild* signal will burn your mind if you hold it too long.'

rich:0.en: Zero's safe house was *rich* with stolen data — every wall covered in decoded intercepts, city blueprints, guard schedules. It was too much, too neat. 'He left this for us to find,' Grey Crow said from the doorway, voice flat. I looked at the center of the room and saw the countdown.
rich:0.cnHint: 零的藏身处里____地堆满了窃取的情报，但引路人认为这是一个圈套。
rich:0.hook: The countdown on the wall read forty seconds and falling.
rich:0.line: 'A room this *rich* with intel means someone wants us here.'

special:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a small device and said nothing. Ali leaned over my shoulder. 'It is *special* — it can rewrite a broadcast mid-air, change the words before they land,' she said quietly. I turned it over. It felt light for something that could silence a whole city block.
special:0.cnHint: 引路人给了我一个____的装置，据说能在空中改写广播内容。
special:0.hook: The device was already warm, as if someone had used it minutes ago.
special:0.line: 'Handle this *special* tool carefully — one wrong input ends the mission.'

text:0.en: The wall was covered in old paint, but under my flashlight a hidden *text* appeared — thin letters scratched below the surface, a message left before the city banned handwriting. I read it twice. It named a place, a time, and a person I thought was dead.
text:0.cnHint: 墙上隐藏的____在灯光下显现，里面提到了一个我以为已经死去的人。
text:0.hook: The last word of the message was still wet.
text:0.line: 'Read the *text* fast — the ink is programmed to vanish at dawn.'

front:0.en: We took the *front* room of the empty building, the one facing the street, the one Zero would expect us to avoid. That was the point. Grey Crow stood at the window without showing his face. 'He will look for us in the back,' he said. Below, a black car slowed and stopped.
front:0.cnHint: 我们故意选择了建筑____面的房间，因为引路人认为对手不会料到这一点。
front:0.hook: The car door opened, and the figure that stepped out was not Zero.
front:0.line: 'Hold the *front* position — do not move until I give the word.'

law:0.en: 'You cannot touch me,' Zero said from across the dark room, voice smooth. 'The *law* in Harbor City covers signal theft only if the signal is registered. Mine never was.' Grey Crow stepped forward. 'Then we are not here as investigators,' he said softly. Zero's smile faded.
law:0.cnHint: 零用城市的____漏洞保护自己，但引路人的回应让他笑容消失。
law:0.hook: Grey Crow reached into his coat and produced something that was not a badge.
law:0.line: 'The *law* has gaps — and I have lived inside them for years.'

thinking:0.en: The server room hummed like a trapped animal. I spread the stolen files across the cold floor and forced myself still. My *thinking* had to be clear — one wrong move and Zero would vanish into the city's noise forever. Ali watched the door. Grey Crow's last message blinked on my wrist.
thinking:0.cnHint: 调查员在机房里整理文件，必须保持冷静的____，因为零随时可能逃跑。
thinking:0.hook: Then the lights cut out, and something moved behind the servers.
thinking:0.line: 'Your *thinking* is the only weapon that matters right now,' Grey Crow had warned.

cover:0.en: The archive room was all dust and dead screens. I used a stack of old printed reports as *cover*, crouching behind them while Zero's agent swept a light across the shelves. My breath came in slow, silent pulls. Ali had said this room was safe. Ali had been wrong.
cover:0.cnHint: 调查员躲在旧档案室里，用一堆报告作为____，等待危险过去。
cover:0.hook: The light stopped moving — and footsteps turned directly toward me.
cover:0.line: 'Find solid *cover* and do not make a sound,' Ali had said.

earth:0.en: Grey Crow kept a small pot of dark *earth* on the windowsill of the safe house — soil from outside the city walls, he said, to remember what was real. I stared at it while the encrypted signal looped in my head. Zero had sent a warning. The pot was cracked in two.
earth:0.cnHint: 调查员在安全屋里看着那盆____，意识到格雷·克劳已经发出过警告。
earth:0.hook: Someone had been here before me, and they had left no other trace.
earth:0.line: 'This *earth* is the only honest thing left in Harbor City,' Grey Crow once said.

paper:0.en: Every wall of the back office was layered with *paper* — printed intercepts, hand-copied codes, signals no machine was allowed to store. Zero had built a map out of words. I read fast, fingers moving down each sheet. One line near the bottom made my stomach drop.
paper:0.cnHint: 调查员在办公室的____地图上飞速阅读，一行字让他/她心头一沉。
paper:0.hook: The line read: the investigator's name, followed by tomorrow's date.
paper:0.line: 'Every sheet of *paper* in this room is a confession,' I said to no one.

art:0.en: The forgery lab smelled of chemicals and cold light. Zero had turned code-writing into an *art* — each fake identity was layered, tested, nearly alive. I found forty-three of them filed in a locked drawer. Grey Crow had told me to expect ten. Ali did not answer my call.
art:0.cnHint: 调查员在伪造实验室发现了远超预期的假身份，零已将造假变成了一种____。
art:0.hook: Forty-three names — and one of them belonged to someone on my team.
art:0.line: 'Zero treats deception as an *art*, and that makes them very dangerous,' Grey Crow said.

street:0.en: The map on the table showed every blocked *street* in the eastern grid — routes Zero had already closed. I traced the open paths with one finger. There was one left. Grey Crow marked it in red and wrote two words beside it: do not. Ali was already on her way there.
street:0.cnHint: 调查员盯着地图，发现零已封锁了大量____，只剩一条路——而那条路被标了警告。
street:0.hook: My call to Ali went straight to static, and the red line seemed to pulse.
street:0.line: 'That *street* is a trap and Grey Crow knows it,' I said, reaching for my coat.

talent:0.en: Zero had a *talent* for silence — no record, no signal, no shape in the city's data. I had been chasing a ghost for six days. Then Ali found a single keystroke log buried in the building's old system. One line. One time stamp. I finally had a location.
talent:0.cnHint: 零拥有隐身的____，调查员追踪六天后终于在旧系统中发现了一条线索。
talent:0.hook: The location was inside our own building — sub-level three.
talent:0.line: 'Zero's real *talent* is making you look in the wrong direction,' Grey Crow said flatly.

overall:0.en: I laid every piece of evidence on the table and stepped back. The *overall* picture was worse than I had thought — Zero had been inside our network for months, not days. Grey Crow stood in the doorway, reading the same pattern I was. Neither of us spoke for a long moment.
overall:0.cnHint: 调查员将所有证据摆出来，____来看，情况比预想的严重得多。
overall:0.hook: Grey Crow finally said, very quietly, 'We have already lost something we don't know about yet.'
overall:0.line: 'The *overall* situation is bad, but we still have one move left,' Grey Crow said.

satisfaction:0.en: The server room smelled of burnt wire and cold air. I cracked the final layer of Zero's encryption at 3 a.m. and felt a deep *satisfaction* settle in my chest — not pride, just the quiet certainty that the hidden signal was mine now. Ali watched the data scroll across the screen without a word.
satisfaction:0.cnHint: 调查员破解了零点最后一层加密，心中涌起一种____。
satisfaction:0.hook: Then the screen went dark, and something else began to type.
satisfaction:0.line: 'That *satisfaction* won't last — Zero already knows you're here.'

cultivate:0.en: Grey Crow had spent ten years in this back-room library, surrounded by coded texts and dead languages. 'You don't find signal-readers,' he told me, refilling a cracked cup with black tea. 'You *cultivate* them — slowly, like a rare plant in bad soil.' I wasn't sure if he meant me.
cultivate:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉调查员，信号解读者不是找来的，而是慢慢____出来的。
cultivate:0.hook: He slid a folder across the table and would not meet my eyes.
cultivate:0.line: 'I chose to *cultivate* you because no one else could hear what you hear.'

productive:0.en: Three hours locked in the archive room with Ali and we had almost nothing. 'This isn't *productive*,' Ali said, pushing away a stack of printed intercepts. 'Zero changes the cipher every six hours — we're always one step behind.' The neon outside buzzed. Somewhere in the noise, I heard a pattern.
productive:0.cnHint: 阿栗认为在档案室里花费的时间并不____，因为零点一直在改变密码。
productive:0.hook: I pressed my ear to the wall and the pattern got louder.
productive:0.line: 'Stop — this line of thinking is actually *productive*. Say that again.'

vision:0.en: The hidden signal painted shapes behind my eyes: streets, a tower, a single lit window. Grey Crow called it a *vision*, but I knew it was data — compressed, biological, real. 'Your mind decodes what machines can't,' he said. Ali just looked worried. The window in my head had a shadow moving inside it.
vision:0.cnHint: 调查员在脑海中看到了隐藏信号投射出的影像，灰鸦称之为____。
vision:0.hook: The shadow in the window raised one hand, as if waving goodbye.
vision:0.line: 'That *vision* is a map — and it ends at the tower on Ninth Street.'

distance:0.en: Zero's broadcast origin kept shifting. I tracked it across six city blocks, then lost it near the old port. Ali marked each point on a paper map. The *distance* between the first and last point formed a near-perfect circle — deliberate, geometric, a message in itself. Zero was drawing something for us.
distance:0.cnHint: 调查员发现零点广播起源点之间的____构成了一个几乎完美的圆形。
distance:0.hook: At the circle's center was the one building with no address on record.
distance:0.line: 'The *distance* is the clue — Zero wants us to find the center.'

forward:0.en: Every exit in the relay station was locked. Behind us the door had sealed with a magnetic click. Ali tried the panel twice and shook her head. 'Only way is *forward*,' I said, meaning through the dark corridor where Zero's last signal had died. The floor hummed beneath our feet like something alive.
forward:0.cnHint: 调查员和阿栗被困在中继站，唯一的办法是继续向____走。
forward:0.hook: The humming stopped, and something at the far end of the corridor turned on a light.
forward:0.line: '*Forward* is the only option — whoever set this trap wants us to keep moving.'

harmful:0.en: The broadcast carried a hidden sub-layer — not just coded text but a low frequency that made my teeth ache. Grey Crow confirmed it: *harmful* to anyone without a signal-reader's natural filter. Zero had turned language into a weapon aimed at the general population. Ali pulled the plug on the receiver before I could stop her.
harmful:0.cnHint: 零点的广播包含一个对普通人____的低频层，调查员的特殊能力使其免疫。
harmful:0.hook: But the signal had already been live for eleven minutes.
harmful:0.line: 'This frequency is *harmful* — Grey Crow never told you how many people it already hit.'

impossible:0.en: The cipher used a key that changed based on real-time rainfall data from seventeen city sensors. Replicating it without access to the city grid should have been *impossible*. Yet Zero had done it from a room with no network connection. I stared at the hardware on the table and felt the ground shift under my certainty.
impossible:0.cnHint: 零点在没有网络连接的情况下完成了一件理论上____的事——复制了实时变化的密码密钥。
impossible:0.hook: One cable led from the hardware to a drain in the floor — and the drain went somewhere.
impossible:0.line: 'You keep saying *impossible*, but Zero is sitting in that room proving you wrong.'

respond:0.en: The server room hummed beneath the city. I pressed my ID against the cold panel. Nothing. I tried the code Grey Crow had given me. A red light blinked. I needed the machine to *respond* before Zero's signal reached this floor. Every second of silence felt like a step closer to failure.
respond:0.cnHint: 侦探在地下服务器室等待机器____，时间正在流逝。
respond:0.hook: The red light blinked once more, then went dark.
respond:0.line: 'The system won't *respond* — someone cut it off from inside.'

welcome:0.en: I stepped into the narrow control room. Ali stood by a bank of screens, her face lit blue by the glow. She looked up, and for a moment something warm crossed her eyes. 'You made it,' she said. That quiet *welcome* was the only comfort I had felt in three cold days.
welcome:0.cnHint: 侦探进入控制室，伙伴的____让他短暂感到温暖。
welcome:0.hook: Then Ali's smile vanished, and she pointed at the screen behind me.
welcome:0.line: 'Your *welcome* here depends on what you brought with you.'

appeal:0.en: Grey Crow spread the documents across the steel table under a single white lamp. His voice was low and steady. 'This *appeal* goes to the High Council at dawn. If they reject it, the broadcast ban becomes permanent.' I stared at the pages. One signature was missing — mine.
appeal:0.cnHint: 引路人向侦探展示一份将在黎明提交的____文件，却发现少了一个签名。
appeal:0.hook: The clock on the wall read four fifty-nine.
appeal:0.line: 'Sign the *appeal* now, or the whole city stays silent forever.'

finally:0.en: For two days Ali had been cracking the locked archive. Screens flickered, alarms triggered, dead ends piled up. Then, deep past midnight, in the back room of the empty relay station, the last layer broke open. She *finally* had the file that linked Zero to the censorship grid.
finally:0.cnHint: 阿里在中继站深夜____破解了封存档案，找到了关键证据。
finally:0.hook: But the file's first line read: 'If you see this, it is already too late.'
finally:0.line: 'We *finally* have proof — now we have to survive long enough to use it.'

guess:0.en: Grey Crow tapped a line of coded text on the wall screen. 'What do you see?' he asked. I studied the pattern — repeating intervals, broken rhythm. 'A location,' I said. 'I *guess* it's the old data vault on Level Nine.' He said nothing, but his silence told me I was right.
guess:0.cnHint: 侦探____出密文指向的地点，引路人的沉默证实了答案。
guess:0.hook: Level Nine had been sealed since the riot of 2087.
guess:0.line: 'I *guess* you already know what we will find down there.'

protection:0.en: The corridor lights had failed. I moved by touch along the wall. Ali had written a short patch into my coat's wiring — a signal blocker. 'Thin *protection*,' she had said, 'but better than nothing.' Now, in the dark, with Zero's drones sweeping the floor above, thin felt paper-thin.
protection:0.cnHint: 侦探在黑暗走廊中只靠阿里提供的微弱____信号屏蔽器前行。
protection:0.hook: Overhead, a drone's beam cut through a ceiling crack.
protection:0.line: 'That patch is your only *protection* — do not let it get wet.'

resident:0.en: The records room smelled of damp paper. I pulled file after file until I found the name. Grey Crow had been a *resident* of Tower Block Fourteen for eleven years — right through every blackout, every raid, every silence the city had ever imposed. He had watched it all from inside.
resident:0.cnHint: 侦探在档案室发现引路人长期是十四号楼的____，经历过城市所有封锁。
resident:0.hook: On the back of the file was a photo I was not meant to see.
resident:0.line: 'Every *resident* of that block signed the same agreement — or disappeared.'

willing:0.en: Zero's offer sat on the table between us: full clearance, a new identity, a way out. I looked at it for a long moment. Ali had risked everything. Grey Crow was still out there. I was not *willing* to walk away, no matter how clean the exit looked. I pushed the paper back.
willing:0.cnHint: 侦探面对对手提出的优厚条件，却不____接受，将文件推了回去。
willing:0.hook: Zero's eyes did not change, and that was the most frightening thing.
willing:0.line: 'I am not *willing* to trade their lives for my own comfort.'

meaning:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Harbor City's old archive tower. I found Grey Crow crouched over a cracked terminal, eyes sharp. 'Every symbol in Zero's broadcast has a *meaning*,' he said. 'Strip one layer and another appears.' The cursor blinked. Something vast was hiding inside seven lines of code.
meaning:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在档案塔的服务器室里，试图破解零点广播中每个符号的____。
meaning:0.hook: The seventh line was not code — it was a name.
meaning:0.line: 'Every symbol has a *meaning*, and this one is aimed at you.'

strengthen:0.en: Ali spread the cracked signal map across the cold floor of the archive basement. 'We need to *strengthen* the relay before Zero cuts the channel,' she said, twisting two bare wires together with steady hands. A red light on the board turned green. Outside, rain hammered the sealed windows.
strengthen:0.cnHint: 阿栗在地下室里努力____信号中继，以防零点切断通讯。
strengthen:0.hook: Green turned red again — someone else was on the line.
strengthen:0.line: 'We must *strengthen* the relay now, or we lose everything tonight.'

competitive:0.en: The decryption arena deep inside the archive tower ran on silent rules. Every operator bid processing power like currency. Grey Crow leaned close and whispered, 'Zero built this system to stay *competitive* — always one step ahead of every investigator sent after him.' I watched the bid counter spin and felt very small.
competitive:0.cnHint: 灰鸦解释零点建立这套系统是为了在追踪者中保持____优势。
competitive:0.hook: Then Zero's own bid appeared — from inside our terminal.
competitive:0.line: 'Zero stays *competitive* by knowing your move before you make it.'

recently:0.en: Ali pulled a thin data chip from her coat and held it to the light. 'This was planted in the archive's intake log — *recently*, within the last six hours,' she said. The timestamp matched the moment I first entered the building. My mouth went dry. Someone had been watching from the very beginning.
recently:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现档案馆的记录芯片____被人动过手脚，时间点令人不安。
recently:0.hook: The chip held only two words: 'Leave now.'
recently:0.line: '*Recently* someone rewrote the intake log — after you walked in.'

nation:0.en: Grey Crow pressed play on the recovered audio file. A calm voice filled the basement: 'No single city holds this key — every *nation* that signed the old code treaty carries one fragment.' Ali and I exchanged a look. Zero was not chasing a local secret. The scale of it hit me like cold water.
nation:0.cnHint: 灰鸦播放的音频显示，这个秘密牵涉签署过旧协议的每一个____。
nation:0.hook: One fragment was already missing from the treaty archive.
nation:0.line: 'Every *nation* that signed the treaty is now a target, not a partner.'

perceive:0.en: The archive room was still and dim. I stared at the coded mural painted across the steel wall — shapes that looked random until I shifted my angle. Then I began to *perceive* the pattern: a map of Harbor City's hidden relay towers, drawn in plain sight for years. My pulse jumped hard.
perceive:0.cnHint: 我在昏暗的档案室里凝视墙上的密码壁画，终于开始____出隐藏的规律。
perceive:0.hook: One relay tower on the map was already marked with a cross.
perceive:0.line: 'You can only *perceive* the map if you already know what you lost.'

pound:0.en: Ali dropped a recovered data drive onto the metal table. It landed with a heavy *pound* that echoed in the empty archive room. 'Three hundred grams of solid proof,' she said, voice flat. 'Zero's entire operation log, unencrypted.' Grey Crow did not smile. He simply asked how long we had before Zero noticed it was gone.
pound:0.cnHint: 阿栗把数据硬盘重重地摔在桌上，发出沉闷的____声，称里面藏有完整证据。
pound:0.hook: Grey Crow checked his watch — we had eleven minutes.
pound:0.line: 'Every *pound* of that drive is evidence Zero will kill to recover.'

purpose:0.en: I found the hidden sub-folder at the back of the archive system: one file, no name, no date. I opened it. A single sentence waited inside: 'The *purpose* of this signal is not to inform — it is to be found by the one person Zero fears.' The room felt smaller. The file had my name in the metadata.
purpose:0.cnHint: 我在档案系统深处发现一个隐藏文件，其中揭示了这个信号真正的____。
purpose:0.hook: The metadata showed the file was created on the day I was born.
purpose:0.line: 'The *purpose* of this file was never the data — it was always you.'

admit:0.en: The server room was cold and dark. I pressed Grey Crow against the wall. 'You were here last night,' I said. He looked away, then back at me. Finally, he had to *admit* the truth — he had opened the door for Zero. Now everything changed.
admit:0.cnHint: 灰鸦被迫____他昨晚为零点开了门。
admit:0.hook: The door he opened led somewhere I could not follow.
admit:0.line: 'I *admit* it — I let him in. I had no choice.'

association:0.en: A cracked screen on the wall showed a logo — the sign of a group called the Signal Chain. Ali leaned close and whispered, 'That *association* controls every encrypted broadcast in Harbor City.' Three floors below us, their meeting was already in progress.
association:0.cnHint: 阿栗告诉我，那个____掌控着全城的加密广播。
association:0.hook: Whatever they were deciding below us, we were already too late.
association:0.line: 'The *association* meets tonight — and they know we are here.'

brand:0.en: Zero had left his mark everywhere in the room — a small burned shape pressed into each wall panel. Grey Crow ran his fingers over one and said nothing. That *brand* was a warning, a signature, a threat all at once. He had been here. He was watching.
brand:0.cnHint: 零点在每块墙板上都留下了他的____作为警告。
brand:0.hook: Every burned mark meant he had counted the steps to our door.
brand:0.line: 'That *brand* means he was here before we even started looking.'

deep:0.en: Ali pulled up the building's floor map on her device. 'The signal is coming from below,' she said. We followed the stairs down, and down again. The air grew heavy and still. *Deep* inside the structure, behind a locked steel door, something was transmitting without stop.
deep:0.cnHint: 信号来自大楼____处一扇上锁的钢门后面。
deep:0.hook: Whatever was transmitting had been running for longer than this city existed.
deep:0.line: 'It is *deep* underground — no one was supposed to find it.'

discover:0.en: I moved the shelf aside and found a hidden panel behind it. My hands shook a little as I opened it. Inside was a drive, a key card, and a list of names. To *discover* this cache here, in Zero's own space, meant he had never planned to run.
discover:0.cnHint: 我在零点的房间里____了一个藏有名单的隐秘格子。
discover:0.hook: One name on that list was mine.
discover:0.line: 'If you *discover* what is on that drive, you cannot unknow it.'

essential:0.en: Grey Crow spread the documents across the table. 'Most of this is noise,' he said, 'but this part —' He tapped one page. 'This is *essential*. Without it, the whole operation makes no sense.' The page held a single frequency, a time, and a place I already knew.
essential:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指出文件中最____的一页，上面是一个我熟悉的地点。
essential:0.hook: The place on that page was where I grew up.
essential:0.line: 'This code is *essential* — lose it and the entire plan falls apart.'

fine:0.en: Ali checked the room one more time and turned to me. 'Everything looks *fine*,' she said — but her voice had a tight edge to it. She was not convinced, and neither was I. The room was too clean. Someone had already been here and taken what mattered.
fine:0.cnHint: 阿栗说一切看起来____，但房间干净得可疑。
fine:0.hook: Rooms this clean always mean someone got here first.
fine:0.line: 'It looks *fine* to me — which is exactly why I do not trust it.'

largely:0.en: I reviewed every file from the night's search. The early leads had been dead ends, and the side passages had taken hours. The case was *largely* built on signals that seemed real but pointed nowhere. Only one thread remained, and it ran straight to the top floor.
largely:0.cnHint: 调查____建立在那些似乎真实却指向虚空的信号上，只剩一条线索。
largely:0.hook: The last thread was thin enough to break — or strong enough to hang someone.
largely:0.line: 'This case is *largely* noise — but that one thread is not.'

machine:0.en: The server room hummed like a living thing. Every *machine* in the row processed stolen data, feeding it to Zero's network. I pressed my back against the cold wall and counted the blinking lights. Fourteen units. Ali had warned me: pull the wrong cable, and the whole city grid goes dark.
machine:0.cnHint: 服务器机房里，每台____都在处理偷来的数据，我必须找到正确的那根线。
machine:0.hook: My hand hovered over the cable — one wrong move, lights out.
machine:0.line: 'Every *machine* in this row answers to Zero — touch nothing yet.'

observe:0.en: Grey Crow had one rule before any raid: *observe* silence for sixty seconds and listen. I stood in the dim corridor, holding my breath. Somewhere ahead, a door clicked. The sound was too clean, too deliberate. Someone else was already inside, and they were not on our side.
observe:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要求在突袭前____六十秒的安静，而我听到了不该出现的声音。
observe:0.hook: The door clicked again — this time, closer.
observe:0.line: '*Observe* silence now, or they will hear us before we see them.'

fat:0.en: The evidence file was huge — years of records, layers of encrypted logs, bloated with useless noise. Ali called it a *fat* archive: too big to send, too important to delete. I had four minutes to pull the core data before Zero's sweep program wiped everything off the server.
fat:0.cnHint: 这份____的档案文件塞满了多年记录，我只有四分钟时间提取核心数据。
fat:0.hook: The sweep program ticked down — three minutes, fifty seconds.
fat:0.line: 'This *fat* archive is a trap — take only the core file and run.'

helpful:0.en: The old terminal in the corner looked broken, but its offline index proved *helpful*: it listed every hidden folder Zero had created in the past year. I copied the path names by hand. Ali watched the door. Grey Crow had said to trust nothing electric, and tonight that rule saved us both.
helpful:0.cnHint: 角落里那台旧终端机意外地____，它的离线索引列出了零点藏匿的所有文件夹。
helpful:0.hook: The last folder name on the list made my pen stop cold.
helpful:0.line: 'That old box is more *helpful* than it looks — copy everything now.'

position:0.en: Grey Crow marked my *position* on a small paper map with a single dot: east stairwell, second floor, behind the fire panel. I was the bait. Zero's team would sweep west first, giving Ali ninety seconds to clone the drive. The plan was clean. What came next was not.
position:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在纸质地图上标出了我的____，我是诱饵，给阿栗争取九十秒时间。
position:0.hook: Ali's signal never came — ninety seconds passed in silence.
position:0.line: 'Hold your *position* until I signal — do not move before that.'

threat:0.en: Zero's voice came through the speaker above my head, low and flat. It was not a warning — it was a *threat* designed to measure how much I knew. I said nothing. Silence, Grey Crow once told me, is the only answer that gives nothing away. I kept my eyes on the exit sign.
threat:0.cnHint: 零点通过扬声器发出____，想试探我知道多少，我选择了沉默。
threat:0.hook: Then the exit sign above the door switched off.
threat:0.line: 'That was not a warning — that was a *threat*, and he means it.'

trend:0.en: Ali pulled up a six-month graph on the small screen. The *trend* was clear: every blackout in Harbor City had started in this building, in this room, at the same hour. Someone had been running tests. Grey Crow studied the line and said nothing for a long time. Then he tapped the final data point.
trend:0.cnHint: 阿栗展示的图表显示出清晰的____：每次全城断电都始于这栋楼的同一个房间。
trend:0.hook: Grey Crow tapped the last point and whispered, 'Tomorrow night.'
trend:0.line: 'Look at this *trend* — every blackout leads back to this exact room.'

ultimately:0.en: We had three paths out of the building. Grey Crow closed two of them himself — too exposed, too slow. *Ultimately*, only the maintenance shaft remained, a narrow steel passage that ran beneath the main floor. Ali went first. I followed, pulling the access panel shut behind me. Above us, boots crossed the floor.
ultimately:0.cnHint: 三条撤退路线中，灰鸦否定了两条，____只剩下那条狭窄的维修通道。
ultimately:0.hook: Above the panel, heavy boots stopped — right over my hands.
ultimately:0.line: '*Ultimately*, there is only one way out — follow me and stay low.'

australia:0.en: The data chip Grey Crow handed me was cold, barely the size of a tooth. 'This signal was routed through *Australia* before it hit Harbor City,' he said, tracing a red line across the map. Someone had sent the message from the far side of the world to hide the source.
australia:0.cnHint: 灰鸦向我展示信号路由图，发现信号绕经遥远的____才抵达海港城。
australia:0.hook: The return address, however, pointed to the room directly above us.
australia:0.line: 'The signal passed through *Australia* — whoever sent it did not want to be found.'

authority:0.en: The door to the records room was sealed with a silver lock. Ali pressed her badge against the panel and it beeped twice. 'We have *authority* to open it,' she said, voice steady. Inside, rows of files waited in the dark — each one stamped with Zero's code name.
authority:0.cnHint: 阿栗亮出证件，以____强行进入档案室，发现所有文件都标有零点的代号。
authority:0.hook: The last file in the row had today's date — and my name on it.

confident:0.en: Zero's voice came through the broken speaker, calm and almost warm. 'You found the room. Good.' I gripped the desk, heart loud in my chest. He sounded *confident*, as if every step I had taken was already part of his plan. The lights flickered once, then died.
confident:0.cnHint: 零点的声音透过扬声器传来，语气____，仿佛我的每一步行动都在他的掌握之中。
confident:0.hook: In the sudden dark, something moved behind the filing cabinet.
confident:0.line: 'I am *confident* you will make the right choice — you always do.'

crowd:0.en: Monitors lined the wall, each showing a different street. A *crowd* had gathered at the east gate — hundreds of people pressing forward, drawn by a broadcast only they could hear. Ali pointed at the centre of the screen. Zero stood among them, invisible in plain sight.
crowd:0.cnHint: 监控画面显示东门外聚集了大批____，零点就隐藏在人群中央。
crowd:0.hook: Then the broadcast cut off, and every face in the crowd turned toward the camera.
crowd:0.line: 'He is hiding inside the *crowd* — we have maybe two minutes.'

highly:0.en: Grey Crow dropped a printed report on the table. 'Zero is *highly* skilled at rewriting signal paths,' he said, underlining a string of numbers. 'He does it so cleanly that most scanners miss it entirely.' I stared at the numbers. One sequence matched the code on my own badge.
highly:0.cnHint: 灰鸦的报告显示零点 ____擅长改写信号路径，而那串数字与我的证件编码完全吻合。
highly:0.hook: Someone had been rewriting my path long before tonight.
highly:0.line: 'He is *highly* dangerous — do not let him speak first.'

occur:0.en: I was reviewing the logs when it hit me. The blackouts did not *occur* at random — each one matched the exact moment Zero accessed a new node. Ali leaned over my shoulder, reading the same pattern. We had been chasing smoke while he rewired the entire city beneath us.
occur:0.cnHint: 我查看日志时突然意识到，停电事件并非随机____，而是与零点入侵节点的时间完全吻合。
occur:0.hook: The next blackout, according to the pattern, was thirty seconds away.
occur:0.line: 'It did not *occur* by chance — someone planned every second of this.'

regularly:0.en: 'Zero checks this terminal *regularly*,' Grey Crow said, pointing at a faint wear mark on the keyboard. 'Every third night, same hour.' Ali set a small device behind the screen without a sound. We stepped back into the shadow and waited. The clock on the wall ticked toward midnight.
regularly:0.cnHint: 灰鸦发现零点 ____使用这台终端，阿栗趁机在屏幕后安装了追踪装置。
regularly:0.hook: At midnight exactly, the terminal screen lit up on its own.
regularly:0.line: 'He visits *regularly* — he will not expect us to be waiting.'

responsible:0.en: The final file named the person *responsible* for every coded blackout in Harbor City over the past year. I turned the page slowly. Grey Crow said nothing. Ali put a hand on my arm. The name printed there was someone I had trusted since my first day on the job.
responsible:0.cnHint: 最终档案揭露了过去一年所有停电事件的____人，那个名字让我震惊不已。
responsible:0.hook: The photograph clipped to the file showed a face I saw every morning.
responsible:0.line: 'Whoever is *responsible* for this has been inside our team from the start.'

slightly:0.en: The server room hummed low. I pressed my ear to the cold door and heard it — a signal, *slightly* off the normal frequency, like a voice trying not to be caught. Ali had warned me about hidden broadcasts buried in the building's own power lines. Someone was still transmitting from inside.
slightly:0.cnHint: 调查员在服务器室门外听到一个____偏离正常频率的信号。
slightly:0.hook: The signal carried a name — and it was mine.
slightly:0.line: 'The pitch is *slightly* wrong — someone is masking a live feed in there.'

vital:0.en: Grey Crow spread the stolen schematics across the cold table. One node pulsed red. 'That junction,' she said quietly, 'is *vital*. Cut it and every encrypted channel in the east district goes dark.' Ali stared at the map. I stared at the door, because someone had just tried the handle from the other side.
vital:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指出地图上一个____的节点，就在此时门把手动了。
vital:0.hook: The handle turned a second time — slower, more deliberate.
vital:0.line: 'That node is *vital* — touch it wrong and we lose everything tonight.'

mention:0.en: Zero's file had been scrubbed clean. No record, no photo, no address. But there was one *mention* — a single line buried in a deleted log: a server room, sub-level three, access at midnight. Ali read it over my shoulder and said nothing. Grey Crow had told us never to go below ground alone.
mention:0.cnHint: 档案中只有一处____，指向地下三层的服务器室。
mention:0.hook: Grey Crow had also told us she would never go below ground — yet her keycard was already logged there.
mention:0.line: 'There is only one *mention* of Zero in the whole system — find it.'

rare:0.en: The air on sub-level three was thin and stale — *rare*, almost, like the building had forgotten to breathe down here. A single lamp threw orange light across rows of dead terminals. Ali pointed to one screen still alive in the dark. On it: a countdown. Eleven minutes.
rare:0.cnHint: 地下室空气____而稀薄，阿栗发现一块屏幕上显示着倒计时。
rare:0.hook: Ten minutes and fifty seconds — and no sign of the exit.
rare:0.line: 'The air is *rare* this deep — the ventilation was cut on purpose.'

useful:0.en: I cracked open the terminal and found a folder labeled DEAD DATA. Most files were corrupted noise. But one was still whole — a map of every safe house in Harbor City. Grey Crow leaned close. 'That,' she said, 'is *useful*.' Zero had built the network. Zero had also marked every exit with a red X.
useful:0.cnHint: 调查员在终端找到一份____的地图，但所有出口都被标了红叉。
useful:0.hook: We were standing inside one of those red-X locations right now.
useful:0.line: 'Keep it — a map like this is *useful* only once, so use it right.'

blood:0.en: The encrypted graffiti on the wall read like a poem, but Grey Crow translated it fast: a warning, a name, a debt. 'Old Harbor City slang,' she said. '*Blood* means loyalty in this code — and whoever wrote this is calling in a promise.' Ali went pale. The handwriting matched her own.
blood:0.cnHint: 墙上暗语中的____一词代表忠诚，而笔迹竟然与阿栗的一模一样。
blood:0.hook: Ali said she had never been to this room before in her life.
blood:0.line: 'In the old code, *blood* is not a threat — it is a contract you cannot break.'

fund:0.en: Zero had not acted alone. The transaction logs proved it: a hidden *fund*, moved in small pieces across forty accounts, all feeding one operation. Grey Crow traced the last transfer to a name I recognized — the office two floors above us. Ali grabbed my arm. The elevator light blinked on.
fund:0.cnHint: 交查员发现一笔隐秘的____流向楼上的某个办公室，此时电梯亮起了灯。
fund:0.hook: Whoever was in that elevator had already pressed the button for sub-level three.
fund:0.line: 'The *fund* is real and it is moving right now — we have maybe four minutes.'

anxiety:0.en: Waiting was the worst part. Ali paced the narrow room, her *anxiety* visible in every short step, every glance at the door. I kept my eyes on the decryption bar — sixty percent, seventy. Grey Crow stood perfectly still, which was somehow worse. At ninety-eight percent the terminal made a sound I had never heard before.
anxiety:0.cnHint: 等待解密时，阿栗的____写在每一个焦躁的脚步里，终端在98%时发出了怪声。
anxiety:0.hook: The decryption stopped — and then the screen went completely dark.
anxiety:0.line: 'Your *anxiety* is loud — Zero can probably hear it through the walls.'

experiment:0.en: The lab on Sub-Level Four was dark except for one humming terminal. Ali pointed at the glass tank in the corner. 'They ran an *experiment* here,' she said, her breath fogging in the cold air. 'Someone was testing how long a human mind could hold a coded signal before it broke.'
experiment:0.cnHint: 阿里在废弃实验室里发现了一个令人不安的____，暗示有人曾用人类思维做测试。
experiment:0.hook: The tank still held something small, and it was still moving.
experiment:0.line: 'This *experiment* was never meant to have survivors,' Ali said.

nature:0.en: Grey Crow spread the decoded files across the table. Every page carried the same header: PROJECT HOLLOW. 'Look at the data,' he said quietly. 'The *nature* of the signal is not digital. It behaves like a living thing — it learns, it hides, it chooses its host.' I felt cold settle into my spine.
nature:0.cnHint: 灰鸦向我解释这个神秘信号的____，令我脊背发凉。
nature:0.hook: If the signal was alive, it already knew we were reading it.
nature:0.line: 'You must understand the *nature* of what hunts us,' Grey Crow warned.

status:0.en: Zero's voice cut through the static on the broken speaker. 'Check my *status* in the city registry,' he said. 'Go on. Look.' Ali pulled up the screen. The record showed one word under his name: ERASED. No ID. No address. No past. He had made himself a ghost long before tonight.
status:0.cnHint: 零点让我们查他在城市档案里的____，结果只有一个字：已注销。
status:0.hook: A ghost can walk anywhere — and no one can stop what does not exist.
status:0.line: 'My *status* in their system is nothing — that is my power,' Zero said.

accident:0.en: 'The fire on Level Nine last spring was not an *accident*,' Grey Crow said, sliding a thin folder toward me. The report inside listed four names — all researchers, all dead, all linked to Project Hollow. Someone had cleaned house before the project could be exposed. Neat. Quiet. Total.
accident:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我九楼的那场大火根本不是____，四名研究员的死亡背后另有隐情。
accident:0.hook: My own name was written in pencil at the bottom of the last page.
accident:0.line: 'Call it an *accident* one more time and I will show you the proof,' Grey Crow said.

active:0.en: Ali's scanner swept the dark server room. Every terminal should have been dead — the building had lost power three hours ago. 'Three nodes still *active*,' she whispered, staring at the blinking lights. Someone was running a live feed from inside this room, right now, in the dark, while we stood there watching.
active:0.cnHint: 阿里的扫描仪显示断电大楼里仍有三个节点处于____状态，有人在暗中监视。
active:0.hook: The camera mounted above the door slowly turned to face us.
active:0.line: 'Three nodes still *active* — we are already being watched,' Ali said.

feed:0.en: Zero sat cross-legged on the floor, a thin cable running from his wrist port to the wall. 'I can *feed* false data into their monitoring grid,' he said without looking up. 'Give me four minutes.' The door at the far end of the hall rattled. We did not have four minutes.
feed:0.cnHint: 零点试图向敌方监控网络____虚假数据，但时间已经不够了。
feed:0.hook: The door burst open before he reached the two-minute mark.
feed:0.line: 'I will *feed* them lies until they cannot trust their own screens,' Zero said.

article:0.en: Ali found it tucked behind a loose wall panel: a single printed page, dated six years ago. 'This *article* was pulled from every public channel the day after it ran,' she said, smoothing the creased paper. The headline read: HARBOR CITY GRID WAS BUILT TO LISTEN. Someone had known the whole time.
article:0.cnHint: 阿里在墙板后发现了一篇被全面封禁的____，标题揭示了这座城市隐藏已久的秘密。
article:0.hook: The author's name had been cut away with something sharp and deliberate.
article:0.line: 'This *article* cost someone everything — we owe it to them to finish this,' Ali said.

awareness:0.en: The server room hummed like a living thing. I moved between cold racks, checking each node. Then my *awareness* sharpened — one terminal showed a live feed no one had logged. Someone else was in the system, right now, watching the same data I was.
awareness:0.cnHint: 我在服务器室巡查时，突然对周围异常的____让我警觉起来。
awareness:0.hook: The cursor blinked once, then spelled my name.
awareness:0.line: 'Your *awareness* just saved us both,' Grey Crow said quietly.

introduce:0.en: Grey Crow led me into a dim control room. Wires ran across every wall like veins. 'I want to *introduce* a new routing path,' he said, fingers moving fast across the board. The old map dissolved. A new one took its place — and it led straight under the city.
introduce:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在控制室里决定____一条新的数据传输路径，地图随之改变。
introduce:0.hook: The new route ended at a location marked only with a skull.
introduce:0.line: 'Let me *introduce* you to the only door Zero never found.'

expense:0.en: Ali spread the receipts across the floor of the safe house. Every credit, every coded transaction — all traced back to one account. 'The *expense* of running this network is enormous,' she said. 'Whoever funds Zero is not hiding anymore. They want us to see.'
expense:0.cnHint: 阿栗在安全屋里查账，发现维持这个网络的____远超想象，幕后金主已不再掩藏。
expense:0.hook: The account number matched the city's own emergency fund.
expense:0.line: 'No honest group pays that *expense* without leaving a name.'

toward:0.en: The lift dropped us into sub-level nine. I could feel the pressure shift as we moved *toward* the central relay — a giant humming pillar of light and steel. Ali gripped my sleeve. The relay was already spinning faster than its rated limit. Something had triggered it.
toward:0.cnHint: 我们向中央中继器____走去，发现它已在超速运转，有人抢先一步动了手脚。
toward:0.hook: A shadow stepped out from behind the pillar and raised one hand.
toward:0.line: 'Every step *toward* that relay is a step Zero is counting.'

track:0.en: I pulled up the signal log and ran a reverse trace. Line after line scrolled past. Then one *track* stood out — a thin, repeating pulse buried under noise, timed to the city's own clock signal. Zero was hiding messages inside Harbor City's official broadcast.
track:0.cnHint: 我在信号日志里发现了一条隐藏的____，零点把秘密信息藏进了城市的官方广播中。
track:0.hook: The next pulse was set to fire in sixty seconds.
track:0.line: 'Follow that *track* and you follow Zero all the way home.'

afford:0.en: 'We cannot *afford* to wait,' Grey Crow said, shutting the door of the relay booth. Outside, Zero's jamming signal was already eating our comm lines. Every minute we stayed still was a minute the exits narrowed. I checked my tools. One charge left. One shot at this.
afford:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说我们____不起等待，零点的干扰信号正在一点点封死我们的退路。
afford:0.hook: The jamming signal suddenly cut to silence — which was worse.
afford:0.line: 'We can't *afford* another mistake at this stage.'

feature:0.en: The stolen blueprint filled the wall screen. Ali zoomed in on the lower level. 'Look at this *feature*,' she said, pointing to a small unmarked room at the building's core. No label, no function listed — but power lines ran to it from every direction. That room was the real target.
feature:0.cnHint: 阿栗在蓝图上发现了一个奇特的____——一个无标注的核心房间，所有电力线都汇聚于此。
feature:0.hook: Grey Crow whispered, 'Zero has been living inside that room.'
feature:0.line: 'That *feature* does not appear on any public record.'

innovative:0.en: Zero's lock was unlike anything I had trained on. No keypad, no biometric scan. Ali studied it for ten seconds. 'It is *innovative*,' she admitted, almost with respect. 'The lock reads the electromagnetic pattern of whoever stands before it.' She paused. 'Lucky we borrowed Grey Crow's coat.'
innovative:0.cnHint: 零点设计的门锁极为____，它通过读取人体电磁特征来识别身份，但阿栗想到了破解办法。
innovative:0.hook: The coat's lining held a signal — but whose?
innovative:0.line: '*Innovative* design, but every lock has one flaw.'

institution:0.en: The briefing room smelled of cold coffee and old secrets. Grey Crow spread a map across the table. 'This *institution* has controlled Harbor City's communication codes for thirty years,' he said. 'Tonight, we shut it down.' I studied the building's layout and felt the weight of what we were about to do.
institution:0.cnHint: 灰鸦向我介绍那个掌控全城通讯密码的____，我们今夜要将其关闭。
institution:0.hook: The blueprint showed a door that was not on any official record.
institution:0.line: 'This *institution* has held the city's voice hostage long enough.'

outcome:0.en: Ali pulled up the mission data on a cracked screen. Every scenario ended badly — for us. 'The *outcome* depends on whether Zero has already changed the access codes,' she said quietly. I watched the numbers scroll and said nothing. Outside, rain hammered the roof like a countdown.
outcome:0.cnHint: 阿栗分析任务数据，每种情形的____似乎都对我们不利。
outcome:0.hook: Then one scenario, the last one, showed a different number entirely.
outcome:0.line: 'The *outcome* changes the moment we stop playing by their rules.'

recognize:0.en: The server room was dark except for blinking red lights. I moved between the racks and stopped. Something felt wrong. Then I saw it — a small symbol carved into the metal. I *recognized* it immediately. Zero had been here. The dust on the floor had been disturbed, recently, and deliberately.
recognize:0.cnHint: 我在服务器室发现了一个符号，立刻____出那是零点留下的痕迹。
recognize:0.hook: A soft sound behind me said I was not alone.
recognize:0.line: 'I *recognize* this mark — Zero wants us to find it.'

safety:0.en: Grey Crow locked the inner door and turned to face us. 'Your *safety* is not guaranteed past this point,' he said, voice flat. 'If Zero triggers the signal burst, the whole floor goes dark.' Ali checked her kit without blinking. I copied her calm, though my hands were not calm at all.
safety:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我们，进入这扇门后我们的____就无法保证了。
safety:0.hook: The lights flickered once, then held — for now.
safety:0.line: 'Your *safety* ends where that signal begins — choose fast.'

collect:0.en: Ali moved along the wall of terminals, fingers quick and silent. 'I need two more minutes to *collect* the encrypted logs,' she whispered. Somewhere above us a ventilation fan changed pitch. Grey Crow touched my shoulder and pointed up. We both understood: someone on the floor above had just started moving.
collect:0.cnHint: 阿栗需要时间从终端____加密日志，但楼上突然传来了动静。
collect:0.hook: The fan sound stopped, and footsteps began.
collect:0.line: 'Let me *collect* the last file — thirty seconds, I promise.'

door:0.en: There were three corridors and only one way out. Zero had made sure of that. I reached the steel *door* at the end of the passage and pressed my ear against it. Silence. Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Do not open that yet. Not until Ali gives the signal.'
door:0.cnHint: 我摸到了走廊尽头那扇钢____，但灰鸦让我等待阿栗的信号。
door:0.hook: The signal never came — but the door opened anyway.
door:0.line: 'That *door* is the only way out, and Zero knows it too.'

eventually:0.en: Zero had covered every exit, changed every code, and cut the backup power. It looked impossible. But Ali kept working, layer by layer, and Grey Crow kept watch. *Eventually*, a single green light blinked on the panel. One path remained open. It was narrow, and it would not stay open long.
eventually:0.cnHint: 阿栗一层层破解封锁，____终于在控制面板上打开了一条通路。
eventually:0.hook: Green light or trap — we had no time to tell the difference.
eventually:0.line: '*Eventually* every lock breaks — this one just broke for us.'

match:0.en: Zero stepped out of the shadows at the far end of the room. I had expected a monster. What I found was someone almost ordinary. 'You are good,' Zero said, almost with respect. 'But you are not a *match* for what comes next.' Behind Zero, a second screen lit up with a new countdown.
match:0.cnHint: 零点现身并嘲讽说我们根本不是接下来那件事的____。
match:0.hook: The countdown read forty seconds and was already falling.
match:0.line: 'You are clever, but no *match* for the system I have built.'

operation:0.en: The server room hummed in the dark. Grey Crow pulled up a holographic map and pointed at a blinking node. 'This *operation* runs across nine districts,' he said. 'One wrong step and every signal in Harbor City goes silent.' I stared at the map. My hands were cold.
operation:0.cnHint: 灰鸦向我展示了一次跨越九个区域的____，一步走错后果不堪设想。
operation:0.hook: The node began to blink faster — someone else was already inside.
operation:0.line: 'This *operation* touches every corner of the city — move carefully.'

population:0.en: Ali spread the data across the table. The numbers were brutal. 'The whole *population* of Sector Seven has been cut off from the open network,' she said quietly. No news, no calls, no signal. Three million people, blind and silent. I felt something cold settle in my chest.
population:0.cnHint: 阿栗说第七区的全体____已被切断网络，三百万人陷入黑暗。
population:0.hook: Then the lights above our table went out, one by one.
population:0.line: 'The entire *population* of Sector Seven is deaf and blind right now.'

quick:0.en: Zero's message arrived in broken code. I ran it through the filter twice before the words appeared. Grey Crow leaned over my shoulder. 'Be *quick*,' he said. 'That message has a kill-timer — thirty seconds before it erases itself.' I typed as fast as I could. Twenty seconds. Ten.
quick:0.cnHint: 收到零点的加密信息，灰鸦催促我要____，因为消息即将自毁。
quick:0.hook: The screen flashed white — and the message was gone.
quick:0.line: 'Be *quick* — this signal dies in thirty seconds.'

scale:0.en: The model loaded slowly. When it finally appeared, I stepped back. Ali whispered something I could not hear. The *scale* of the network was beyond anything I had imagined — ten thousand hidden nodes, layered like a city beneath the city. Grey Crow said nothing. He just pointed at the center.
scale:0.cnHint: 当隐藏网络的____呈现在眼前时，我和阿栗都震惊了。
scale:0.hook: At the very center of the map, my own ID was glowing red.
scale:0.line: 'The *scale* of this network — it is larger than Harbor City itself.'

basic:0.en: 'Forget your tools,' Grey Crow said, pushing my scanner aside. 'The *basic* rule of this place is simple: trust the signal, not the source.' I had heard that line in training. But here, in the cold hum of the relay station, it felt like a warning built from real pain.
basic:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我这个地方最根本的____规则：相信信号，不要相信来源。
basic:0.hook: Then the relay station sent out a signal — in my voice.
basic:0.line: 'The *basic* rule here is trust the signal, never the source.'

constantly:0.en: The ceiling fan turned. The decryption log scrolled. I was *constantly* checking the door — every creak, every flicker of light felt like Zero closing in. Ali put a hand on my arm. 'Stop,' she said. 'Fear is noise. Noise gets you caught.' I took a breath and looked back at the screen.
constantly:0.cnHint: 我____地盯着门口，阿栗提醒我恐惧本身就是一种干扰。
constantly:0.hook: A shadow passed under the door and did not move on.
constantly:0.line: 'You are *constantly* watching the door — that fear will give us away.'

favor:0.en: Grey Crow studied the two routes on the screen for a long time. 'I *favor* the east corridor,' he said at last. 'Less light, more cover.' Zero would expect us to take the fast path. Taking the slow one was the only move that made sense. Ali nodded. I grabbed my kit.
favor:0.cnHint: 灰鸦表示他____东侧走廊，那里更暗，掩护更多。
favor:0.hook: The east corridor door was already open — and it had been locked a minute ago.
favor:0.line: 'I *favor* the east corridor — Zero will never expect it.'

absence:0.en: Something was wrong before I could name it. Then I understood. The hum was gone. The *absence* of that constant background noise meant the building's core system had shut down. Grey Crow looked at the ceiling. Ali checked her device. No power, no signal, no way out through the usual channels.
absence:0.cnHint: 那台设备持续的嗡嗡声消失了，这种____意味着整栋楼的核心系统已经关闭。
absence:0.hook: In the silence, we heard slow footsteps coming down the hall.
absence:0.line: 'The *absence* of that hum means the whole system just went dark.'

safe:0.en: The server room smelled of cold metal and burnt wires. Grey Crow pointed to the wall behind a dead monitor. 'There,' he whispered. I pulled the panel aside and found a heavy iron *safe*, its dial still warm, as if someone had opened it only minutes ago.
safe:0.cnHint: 克劳在废弃服务器室的墙后发现了一个____，表盘余温未散。
safe:0.hook: The dial was warm — someone beat us here.
safe:0.line: 'That *safe* holds the only copy of the signal key.'

speed:0.en: Ali's fingers flew across the keyboard. 'Forty seconds before the firewall reboots,' she said without looking up. I watched the progress bar crawl and felt my chest tighten. The *speed* of her work was the only thing standing between us and total blackout in the city grid.
speed:0.cnHint: 阿里以惊人的____破解防火墙，争分夺秒。
speed:0.hook: Thirty seconds left — and the bar was only half full.
speed:0.line: 'I need more *speed* or we lose the whole grid tonight.'

burden:0.en: Zero dropped a thick folder on the table between us. 'Every name, every signal, every lie,' he said quietly. 'Carry it if you want the truth.' I picked it up. The *burden* of those pages pressed into my palms like a stone I could never put down again.
burden:0.cnHint: 零点将厚重的卷宗交给叙述者，那份____从此压在心头。
burden:0.hook: The last page had my own name on it.
burden:0.line: 'This *burden* is yours now — I carried it long enough.'

former:0.en: Grey Crow laid two signal chips side by side on the desk. 'Choose carefully,' he said. The *former* was old, cracked at one corner, but still alive with faint pulses. The second was clean and new. I reached for the old one. Grey Crow nodded, as if he had expected exactly that.
former:0.cnHint: 克劳摆出两枚信号芯片，叙述者选择了____。
former:0.hook: Grey Crow's nod told me the choice had already been made for me.
former:0.line: 'The *former* chip still carries the original frequency — trust it.'

oppose:0.en: 'You cannot *oppose* the broadcast and survive,' Zero said, his voice flat as dead air. He stood at the far end of the narrow room, coat still wet from the rain. I kept my eyes on him and said nothing. Silence, Ali once told me, is the loudest answer you can give.
oppose:0.cnHint: 零点警告叙述者，____那次广播将付出生命代价。
oppose:0.hook: His flat voice made the threat feel worse than a shout.
oppose:0.line: 'To *oppose* them is to vanish — you understand that?'

unable:0.en: The coded message filled the screen in long broken lines. I read it twice, then a third time, pressing my fingers against my temples. I was *unable* to find the key pattern hidden inside. Grey Crow watched from the doorway and said nothing, which told me the pattern was there — I just was not ready.
unable:0.cnHint: 叙述者盯着加密信息，____找出隐藏的密钥规律。
unable:0.hook: Grey Crow's silence meant the answer was there — and I was missing it.
unable:0.line: 'I am *unable* to crack this alone — I need the second fragment.'

unusual:0.en: Ali noticed it first: the hum of the ventilation system had changed pitch, low and steady instead of its normal rhythm. '*Unusual*,' she said softly, tilting her head. We both froze. In Harbor City, when a building changes its breath, it means someone has taken control of its lungs.
unusual:0.cnHint: 阿里察觉到通风系统发出____的声音，暗示大楼已被人控制。
unusual:0.hook: The building was breathing differently — and it was not for us.
unusual:0.line: 'That sound is *unusual* — someone changed the air system remotely.'

apart:0.en: Grey Crow pulled the small device *apart* on the table, piece by piece, each component laid in a neat line under the pale ceiling light. 'Every part has a story,' he said. I leaned in close. One tiny chip had a symbol I had seen before — on the wall of the room where the case began.
apart:0.cnHint: 克劳将装置拆____，其中一枚芯片刻有叙述者曾见过的符号。
apart:0.hook: That symbol meant the case had never really started — or never ended.
apart:0.line: 'Take it *apart* slowly — one wrong move and the signal dies.'

advice:0.en: Inside the safe house, Grey Crow spread a map across the table. Rain hammered the steel shutters. 'My *advice*,' she said quietly, 'is to trust no signal you did not send yourself.' I stared at the blinking red dot on the map. It was moving — and it was wearing my frequency.
advice:0.cnHint: 在安全屋里，灰鸦给了我关键的____，但地图上有什么东西让我背脊发凉。
advice:0.hook: The red dot stopped — right where Ali was sleeping.
advice:0.line: 'My *advice* is to trust no signal you did not send yourself.'

attempt:0.en: The server room hummed cold and blue. I watched the lock panel flicker — someone was trying to get in. Every *attempt* failed, but each one left a new layer of code on the door, building something. Building a key. I had maybe four minutes before that key was complete.
attempt:0.cnHint: 有人在不断____进入服务器室，而每一次失败都在悄悄为成功铺路。
attempt:0.hook: The fourth layer snapped into place with a soft, final click.
attempt:0.line: 'Each *attempt* leaves a mark — they are writing the key as they fail.'

draw:0.en: Ali pinned two route plans to the wall. One led through the east tunnel, one through the data floor. 'It is a *draw*,' Ali said, tapping both sheets. 'Same risk, same time.' I looked closer. Somebody had already circled the data floor in red ink — from the inside of the folder.
draw:0.cnHint: 阿栗认为两条路线____难分高下，但文件夹里有人已经替我们做了选择。
draw:0.hook: The red ink was still wet.
draw:0.line: 'On paper it is a *draw*, but someone already picked for us.'

facility:0.en: The signal led me to sub-level four — a locked *facility* labeled LANGUAGE CORE. Grey Crow had never mentioned it. Banks of humming machines lined every wall, each one parsing forbidden words and storing them like ammunition. Somewhere in this room, Zero kept a weapon that needed no gun.
facility:0.cnHint: 信号把我引向了一个从未被提及的地下____，里面储存着比武器更危险的东西。
facility:0.hook: One machine was already running my name through its filter.
facility:0.line: 'This *facility* does not store data — it stores silence.'

firm:0.en: Zero's voice came through the speaker, smooth and cold. I expected threats. Instead he said, 'Join me.' I kept my voice *firm*. 'No.' A long pause followed, filled only by rain on concrete and the hum of servers. Then Zero laughed once, short and sharp, and the lights went out.
firm:0.cnHint: 零点向我发出邀请，我用____而坚定的声音拒绝了他，然后整个房间陷入黑暗。
firm:0.hook: In the dark, something began typing on its own.
firm:0.line: 'Keep your voice *firm* — he reads fear the way others read code.'

innovation:0.en: The evidence log showed it clearly: Zero's encryption was not stolen tech. It was original. Grey Crow called it 'the most dangerous *innovation* in Harbor City in forty years — a code that learns the person trying to break it.' I set down the file. My hands were the ones that had been trying to break it all week.
innovation:0.cnHint: 档案揭示零点的加密是一项可怕的____，而我突然意识到自己已经成了它的学习对象。
innovation:0.hook: The code now knew exactly how my mind worked.
innovation:0.line: 'This *innovation* does not just defend — it studies you as you attack.'

multiple:0.en: The intercepted file opened to reveal *multiple* copies of the same message, each one slightly different — one word changed per copy, moving like a slow dial. Ali leaned in. 'It is a combination lock,' she said. 'Made of language.' I touched the screen. The moment I pressed the first word, an alarm began to sound.
multiple:0.cnHint: 截获的文件包含____份细微不同的相同信息，阿栗说那是一把用语言做成的密码锁。
multiple:0.hook: I had already pressed the wrong word.
multiple:0.line: '*Multiple* versions of the same message — that is how the lock is built.'

path:0.en: The building diagram showed only one *path* to the core room: a narrow corridor lined with sound sensors. One wrong word spoken aloud would seal it. Grey Crow had marked the route in pencil, with a single note at the end: 'Silence is also a language. Learn it.' I took one step forward. The sensors woke up.
path:0.cnHint: 通往核心机房只有一条____，走廊里全是声音传感器，沉默本身也是一种语言。
path:0.hook: The sensors had already registered the sound of my heartbeat.
path:0.line: 'There is only one *path*, and it demands perfect silence from you.'

character:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Harbor City's grid. Grey Crow handed me a cracked data chip. 'Every agent has a *character* burned into their code,' he said. 'Yours says you ask too many questions.' I looked at the chip. My name was already on the case file.
character:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，每个特工的____都刻在他们的代码里。
character:0.hook: The chip held one more name — and it was Zero's.
character:0.line: 'Your *character* is written in the system, whether you like it or not.'

clean:0.en: Ali swept the safe-house table with one arm. Papers hit the floor. 'We keep this *clean*,' she said, meaning the room, or maybe the plan. Outside, boots scraped the fire-escape stairs. We had thirty seconds to decide what stayed and what burned.
clean:0.cnHint: 阿栗要求我们保持安全屋____，而楼梯上已经有了脚步声。
clean:0.hook: The door handle turned before we could move.
clean:0.line: 'Keep it *clean* — leave nothing they can read.'

convey:0.en: Zero's message arrived as noise in the water pipes — three short bursts, two long. Grey Crow listened, eyes closed. 'He's trying to *convey* a meeting point,' Crow murmured. I wrote the pattern on my palm. The address it spelled was the last place I wanted to go.
convey:0.cnHint: 零点用水管的声音来____一个会面地点。
convey:0.hook: The address on my palm matched the city's oldest locked tower.
convey:0.line: 'What can three pipe-bursts *convey* that words cannot?'

distraction:0.en: Ali knocked a tray of cups off the counter. The crash pulled every eye in the server room toward her. It was a *distraction*, clean and simple. I had eight seconds at the terminal. My fingers moved. Seven. Six. An alarm I had not planned for began to wail.
distraction:0.cnHint: 阿栗制造了一个____，让我有时间接触终端。
distraction:0.hook: The alarm meant someone had been watching us the whole time.
distraction:0.line: 'I am the *distraction* — do not waste it.'

fight:0.en: The backup drive was locked behind a glass panel. I had no key, no tool, only the *fight* left in my tired hands. I struck the panel once, twice. Grey Crow said nothing, just watched the door. On the third strike the glass gave. So did the silence in the hall.
fight:0.cnHint: 我只剩下一口____，拼命击碎玻璃拿到备份驱动器。
fight:0.hook: Footsteps filled the hall, fast and sure.
fight:0.line: 'There is still *fight* in you — use it now.'

finish:0.en: Grey Crow laid the decryption key on the table. 'We are close,' he said, voice flat. 'But close is not a *finish*.' The city grid flickered outside the window. Zero had cut power to three blocks. Ali looked at me. We both understood: this ended tonight, one way or another.
finish:0.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我们，接近目标还不算____。
finish:0.hook: Zero's voice crackled from the dead speaker on the wall.
finish:0.line: 'There is no *finish* line until the signal goes dark.'

frequently:0.en: The hidden frequency shifted *frequently*, every four minutes by Grey Crow's count. We had been chasing it for an hour across the basement radio room. Each jump took us closer to the source. Ali marked each new position on the map with a red dot. The dots formed a face.
frequently:0.cnHint: 隐藏的频率____改变，我们一直在追踪它的源头。
frequently:0.hook: The face on the map was smiling back at us.
frequently:0.line: 'It shifts *frequently* — he knows we are listening.'

invest:0.en: 'You have to *invest* time in the cipher,' Grey Crow said, tapping the wall of printed code. 'Every hour you give it, it gives something back.' I had given it three nights. My eyes burned. Outside, Harbor City's rain had not stopped once. Neither had Zero's transmissions.
invest:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说我们需要____时间去破译密码。
invest:0.hook: On night four, the cipher finally answered.
invest:0.line: '*Invest* one more hour — it is almost open.'

moment:0.en: The server room hummed in the dark. I found the hidden port and jacked in. Data poured past my eyes like rain on glass. For one *moment* the whole city grid lay open before me — every signal, every secret, every locked door waiting to fall.
moment:0.cnHint: 调查员入侵城市主网，在某个____里看见了所有隐藏的秘密。
moment:0.hook: Then a second presence entered the grid beside me.
moment:0.line: Ali said, 'This *moment* won't last — grab what you need now.'

nice:0.en: Grey Crow spread three data chips on the steel table. 'Each lock has a different key,' he said. He tapped the smallest chip. The *nice* difference between its code layers was almost invisible, but it was the only one that could open the archive without triggering an alarm.
nice:0.cnHint: 灰鸦向调查员展示芯片，指出其中一枚在编码层面上____的差异是破局关键。
nice:0.hook: Someone had already handled that chip — the prints were fresh.
nice:0.line: Grey Crow said, 'A *nice* gap in the code is all the door needs.'

peer:0.en: The archive corridor was unlit. I pressed close to the wall and tried to *peer* through the frosted panel ahead. Shapes moved on the other side — one tall, one low. Ali touched my arm and shook her head. Whatever was in there, it already knew we were coming.
peer:0.cnHint: 调查员在黑暗档案走廊里费力____向前方看，发现里面似乎早有人等待。
peer:0.hook: The frosted panel began to slide open on its own.
peer:0.line: Ali whispered, 'Don't *peer* too long — they can see your light.'

pretty:0.en: On Zero's desk sat a small glass ornament, glowing faint blue. Among all his cold tools and wire bundles, that delicate *pretty* looked completely out of place. Grey Crow's voice crackled in my ear: 'Don't touch it. That thing is a trigger, not a decoration.'
pretty:0.cnHint: 零点桌上摆着一件发光的____，灰鸦警告调查员那其实是一个触发装置。
pretty:0.hook: The ornament's glow shifted from blue to sharp red.
pretty:0.line: Grey Crow warned, 'That *pretty* on his desk is a trap.'

recommendation:0.en: The station chief slid a sealed card across the desk. 'This is Grey Crow's *recommendation*,' she said flatly. 'He says you can be trusted with Level Four access.' I picked it up. The card was blank. Whatever message it carried was locked inside the material itself.
recommendation:0.cnHint: 站长将灰鸦的____交给调查员，那张看似空白的卡片里藏着某种隐秘信息。
recommendation:0.hook: My fingerprint on the card triggered a single quiet click.
recommendation:0.line: She said, 'Grey Crow's *recommendation* is the only reason you're here.'

strange:0.en: The safe house should have been empty. Instead, every chair was pulled back from the table, as if people had just left in a hurry. A cup of water was still warm. Nothing was broken or taken. The layout felt *strange* to me — too neat, too arranged, like a stage set.
strange:0.cnHint: 调查员进入安全屋，发现一切____得像是刻意布置的场景，令人不安。
strange:0.hook: Ali found a second door behind the wall that no map showed.
strange:0.line: I told Ali, 'Something feels *strange* — this place was prepared for us.'

widespread:0.en: Grey Crow pulled up the city feed on the cracked monitor. Red markers covered the map from the port to the uptown towers. '*Widespread* signal interference,' he read aloud. 'Started eighteen minutes ago.' Zero had not just hit one node. He had cut the whole city's private channels at once.
widespread:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在监控屏幕上发现全市____的信号干扰，零点的攻击范围远超预想。
widespread:0.hook: Our own encrypted line went dead three seconds later.
widespread:0.line: Grey Crow said, '*Widespread* jamming means Zero is moving tonight.'

wonderful:0.en: The old decoder clicked and the hidden broadcast came through clean for the first time. The voice was calm, the words precise. Ali laughed under her breath. 'It's *wonderful*,' she said — not in joy, but in the way people speak when something terrible turns out to be exactly as bad as they feared.
wonderful:0.cnHint: 解码器终于破译了隐藏广播，阿栗用____来形容这个发现，语气里却带着寒意。
wonderful:0.hook: The broadcast named our safe house address, street and floor.
wonderful:0.line: Ali said quietly, 'It is *wonderful* — and it means we are already late.'

announce:0.en: The ceiling speakers crackled to life. A cold, flat voice began to *announce* something across every floor of the building: 'All exits are now sealed. Compliance is required.' Grey Crow grabbed my arm. 'That signal,' he whispered, 'it's Zero. He's taken the broadcast tower.'
announce:0.cnHint: 大楼广播突然响起，灰鸦意识到是零点在____某件危险的事。
announce:0.hook: The last stairwell light went dark.
announce:0.line: 'They *announce* the lockdown, but the real message is hidden inside the static.'

appropriate:0.en: Ali pulled a keycard from her coat. 'Is this *appropriate*?' she asked, holding it up. The card belonged to the building's chief systems officer. Grey Crow did not answer. He was already moving toward the server room door, his eyes fixed on the blinking red lock panel ahead.
appropriate:0.cnHint: 阿栗拿出一张不该拥有的门卡，质疑这样做是否____。
appropriate:0.hook: The lock blinked once, then turned green.
appropriate:0.line: 'Tell me if this feels *appropriate* to you — using a dead man's card.'

chief:0.en: On the wall screen, a name appeared: Director Voss, *Chief* of Signal Control. Grey Crow went still. 'He's the one who built the censorship grid,' he said quietly. Ali looked at me. We all understood now. This room, this moment — we were standing at the center of everything.
chief:0.cnHint: 屏幕上出现了信号管控部门____的名字，灰鸦神情凝重。
chief:0.hook: Behind the wall, something began to hum.
chief:0.line: 'The *chief* never comes to the field — so why is his badge logged here tonight?'

clearly:0.en: The data on the screen was *clearly* not random. Every packet, every timestamp formed a pattern that pointed to one address: sub-level four. Ali traced the lines with her finger. Grey Crow stood at the door, listening. Outside, boots echoed on the hard floor, getting closer fast.
clearly:0.cnHint: 屏幕上的数据____指向地下四层，三人意识到时间不多了。
clearly:0.hook: Ali whispered, 'Someone already knows we are here.'
clearly:0.line: 'You can *clearly* see the signal loops back — Zero has been watching this room.'

communicate:0.en: Grey Crow pressed a small device behind his ear. 'This is how we *communicate* without being traced,' he said, handing Ali and me each a matching chip. 'Zero controls the public network. These chips use a buried frequency he hasn't found yet.' I pressed mine in and heard only silence — clean, safe silence.
communicate:0.cnHint: 灰鸦分发秘密芯片，让三人能在零点的监控下____。
communicate:0.hook: Then the silence broke with a single, sharp tone.
communicate:0.line: 'We *communicate* on layer nine — if you hear static, pull the chip out immediately.'

emphasis:0.en: Grey Crow read the intercepted message aloud, placing slow *emphasis* on the final line: 'The grid shuts down at midnight.' He looked up. No one spoke. That one line, stressed above all others, told us Zero was not bluffing. Whatever he had planned, it was already in motion, ticking like a hidden clock.
emphasis:0.cnHint: 灰鸦朗读截获的信息，特别的____落在最后那句话上，众人沉默了。
emphasis:0.hook: Midnight was only eleven minutes away.
emphasis:0.line: 'Listen to the *emphasis* in his words — Zero wants us to be afraid before we act.'

emphasize:0.en: Ali pointed at the coded map on the table. 'I want to *emphasize* one thing,' she said, her voice steady and low. 'There is only one way out once we go in, and it closes in four minutes.' Grey Crow nodded once. I checked my chip, checked the door, and tried to slow my breathing.
emphasize:0.cnHint: 阿栗郑重____只有一条退路，而且四分钟后就会关闭。
emphasize:0.hook: Four minutes felt like four seconds.
emphasize:0.line: 'I *emphasize* this now so no one hesitates when the moment comes.'

england:0.en: The file on the screen was stamped: ORIGIN — *England*, North Signal Division, archived 2031. Grey Crow exhaled slowly. 'That division was shut down decades ago,' he said. 'Someone pulled a ghost protocol out of cold storage.' Ali zoomed in on the seal. Beneath it, a second name — one we all recognized.
england:0.cnHint: 档案显示信号协议来源于____的一个早已关闭的部门，众人看到了熟悉的名字。
england:0.hook: The second name was Grey Crow's.
england:0.line: 'A protocol from *England* — buried for sixty years — and it just activated itself tonight.'

immediately:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Harbor City's old district. I found the terminal Grey Crow had marked — a blinking cursor on a black screen. I plugged in the drive and *immediately* the walls of text began to scroll. Zero's encryption was unraveling, layer by layer, right in front of me.
immediately:0.cnHint: 我将驱动器插入终端，数据____开始滚动显示。
immediately:0.hook: Then the screen went dark, and footsteps echoed outside.
immediately:0.line: 'Plug it in and *immediately* watch what breaks free,' Grey Crow had warned.

improvement:0.en: Ali spread the old city maps across the safe-house table. She had marked every signal dead zone in red ink. 'This version is better,' she said, tapping the newest route. The *improvement* was clear — three fewer checkpoints, two faster exits. Zero would never expect us to move through the eastern corridor.
improvement:0.cnHint: 阿栗展示了新版路线图，这次的____让我们有了更大胜算。
improvement:0.hook: But one corridor was marked in a color neither of us had chosen.
improvement:0.line: 'The *improvement* in this route could save our lives tonight,' Ali said.

afternoon:0.en: The rain had not stopped since noon. By *afternoon*, the safe house felt smaller, the walls closer. Grey Crow sat by the frosted window, watching water run down the glass. I checked the receiver — still no signal from Ali. Outside, neon signs bled color into the wet street below.
afternoon:0.cnHint: ____时分，安全屋里气氛压抑，我们焦急地等待阿栗的信号。
afternoon:0.hook: At half past three, the receiver crackled once, then went silent.
afternoon:0.line: 'By *afternoon* we either move or we're finished,' Grey Crow said quietly.

expand:0.en: Zero's broadcast was thin at first — a whisper beneath the city's noise. Then, inside the monitoring room, I watched the signal begin to *expand*, filling frequency after frequency on my display. Ali grabbed my arm. The broadcast was rewriting the public grid in real time, block by block, moving toward us.
expand:0.cnHint: 零点的信号开始____，逐渐覆盖整个城市的通信网络。
expand:0.hook: In sixty seconds it would reach the block where we were hiding.
expand:0.line: 'Watch it *expand* — that is how Zero takes a city,' Ali said.

regardless:0.en: Grey Crow dropped a data chip on the table. 'Take it,' he said. I had a hundred reasons to walk away — Zero's agents were already in the building, and the exits were narrowing. But I picked up the chip *regardless*, because some choices are not really choices at all. The door handle turned.
regardless:0.cnHint: 尽管危机四伏，我____还是拿起了那枚数据芯片。
regardless:0.hook: Behind the door, something breathed slowly and did not knock.
regardless:0.line: '*Regardless* of the risk, we finish this tonight,' Grey Crow said.

rid:0.en: The virus sat dormant on the city's language network — Grey Crow called it a leech. Ali had spent three nights writing the clean code. 'This will *rid* the grid of Zero's planted words,' she said, fingers moving fast across the keyboard. One final key press. The leech began to shrink on the monitor.
rid:0.cnHint: 阿栗用她编写的代码，试图____城市语言网络中零点植入的病毒。
rid:0.hook: Then a second leech appeared, deeper in the system than before.
rid:0.line: 'This code will *rid* us of every ghost Zero left behind,' Ali said.

dog:0.en: A small *dog* sat at the far end of the corridor, perfectly still, watching me. In Harbor City, animals were rare indoors — they were also known cover for mobile sensors. I froze. Grey Crow had warned me about this exact model: fur over a metal frame, eyes that recorded everything it saw.
dog:0.cnHint: 走廊尽头有一只____，但它很可能是零点安插的移动监控装置。
dog:0.hook: Its eyes shifted color from brown to a cold, steady blue.
dog:0.line: 'That *dog* has been watching your every step for twenty minutes,' Grey Crow said.

busy:0.en: The monitoring station was *busy* with noise — feeds from forty city blocks, voices over open channels, alert tones stacking on top of each other. I almost missed it: one quiet line of code, slipping through the chaos like a knife. Ali caught it first. She pointed at the screen without a word.
busy:0.cnHint: 嘈杂____的监控站里，阿栗在海量数据中发现了一行隐藏的关键代码。
busy:0.hook: The code line read: 'Target confirmed. Room four. Now.'
busy:0.line: 'The feed is too *busy* — Zero is using the noise as cover,' Ali said.

intelligence:0.en: Grey Crow spread a thin file across the wet table. 'This *intelligence* came from deep inside Zero's network,' he said quietly. I studied the pages. Signal maps, names in code, supply routes hidden in plain sight. The data was real. Too real. Someone had wanted us to find it.
