fly:0.cnHint: 调查员在信号塔内发现一只____，这是零点留下的暗号，意味着城市广播即将中断。
fly:0.hook: Ali's hand froze one centimetre above the transmitter.
fly:0.line: 'One dead *fly* on the lens — he has been here already.'

judge:0.en: The hearing room was empty except for a single chair and a screen. Text rolled across it: YOU ARE THE *JUDGE* NOW. CHOOSE. Two file names blinked below the message. One would expose Grey Crow. One would expose Zero. I sat down slowly. The cursor waited, patient as a held breath.
judge:0.cnHint: 调查员独自面对屏幕，被迫以____的身份在两个秘密之间做出抉择。
judge:0.hook: Both files could not be true — but both could destroy everything.
judge:0.line: 'I never asked to be a *judge*, but here I sit.'

store:0.en: The safe house sat behind a closed *store* — dusty shelves, broken lights, the smell of old metal. Ali pressed her ear to the back wall. Somewhere beyond it, a server hummed. Grey Crow had said the data cache was here. I pulled the door. It swung open without a sound.
store:0.cnHint: 我们在一家废弃的____后面找到了藏匿点，阿里发现了可疑的声音。
store:0.hook: The server held one file, and it had my name on it.
store:0.line: 'This *store* is cover — the real prize is behind that wall.'

budget:0.en: Zero had hacked the city grid using a ghost account with a tiny *budget* — barely enough credits to run three commands. But three commands were all he needed. Ali stared at the transfer log. 'He spent almost nothing,' she said. That was the terrifying part. Cheap and perfect.
budget:0.cnHint: 零点只用了极少的____就入侵了城市电网，阿里看着记录倒吸一口冷气。
budget:0.hook: If he did this on three credits, imagine what he does with more.
budget:0.line: 'A *budget* this small means he planned every single move.'

grant:0.en: The override key could *grant* access to every locked level in Harbor City's central tower. Grey Crow slid it across the table toward me, eyes flat. 'Once you use it, they know you exist,' he said quietly. Ali looked away. The key was cold in my hand. Too cold.
grant:0.cnHint: 引路人把一把能____所有权限的密钥推给了我，警告我使用后将暴露身份。
grant:0.hook: I closed my fingers around it and made a choice I could not undo.
grant:0.line: 'That key will *grant* you one door — choose the right one.'

hospital:0.en: The signal trace ended at the old *hospital* on Meridian Street — sealed since the flood of 2071, windows dark, the entrance wrapped in yellow tape. Ali checked her scanner. Heat signatures inside: two, maybe three. Grey Crow had been missing for six hours. I already knew where he was.
hospital:0.cnHint: 信号追踪指向了一家废弃的____，阿里的扫描仪显示里面有人。
hospital:0.hook: The tape across the door had already been cut and carefully replaced.
hospital:0.line: 'Grey Crow went into that *hospital* and never came back out.'

island:0.en: The encrypted map showed a single *island* in the middle of the city reservoir — man-made, unmarked, reachable only by maintenance boat. Ali said Zero had been using it as a relay point for months. No cameras, no patrol. I checked the tide schedule. Tonight the water was low enough to walk.
island:0.cnHint: 加密地图显示水库中央有一座____，零点曾用它作为中继站。
island:0.hook: A light blinked once on the island, then went dark again.
island:0.line: 'That *island* is invisible on every official map — that is the point.'

native:0.en: The dialect in the broadcast was *native* Harbor City slang — the kind only someone born in the lower districts would know. Zero was not from here. Ali froze. That meant someone else had recorded the message, someone local, someone we had not counted. Grey Crow said nothing. His jaw tightened.
native:0.cnHint: 广播中使用了____的港城方言，说明背后还有我们不知道的本地人。
native:0.hook: Grey Crow's silence told me he already knew who it was.
native:0.line: 'Only a *native* speaker could fake that accent well enough.'

tradition:0.en: By *tradition*, every investigator in our unit left a mark on the wall of the briefing room before a final mission — a small cut, a symbol, proof they were once real. I stood in front of the wall. Names I recognised. Names I did not. Ali handed me the blade without a word.
tradition:0.cnHint: 按照我们小队的____，每位调查员在最终行动前都要在墙上留下印记。
tradition:0.hook: One mark on the wall had been scratched out, and the edges were still fresh.
tradition:0.line: '*Tradition* says you mark the wall — unless you plan not to return.'

africa:0.en: The backup signal bounced through seventeen relays — the last one traced to a dormant satellite originally launched for *Africa* agricultural data, now drifting, forgotten, repurposed. Ali said Zero had been hiding in plain sight inside dead infrastructure for years. Grey Crow pulled up the satellite's ID. He exhaled slowly. 'Elegant,' he said.
africa:0.cnHint: 备用信号最终追溯到一颗为____农业项目发射的废弃卫星，零点就藏在这里。
africa:0.hook: The satellite was scheduled for deorbit in exactly forty-eight hours.
africa:0.line: 'He rerouted through an *Africa* relay — nobody watches those old birds.'

passion:0.en: Inside the relay station, Grey Crow spread old circuit maps across the table. 'Zero built this network out of pure *passion*,' he said quietly, tracing each line. That kind of obsession leaves marks — patterns only someone who truly loved the work would hide here.
passion:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在中继站内研究电路图，谈起零点对这项工作的____。
passion:0.hook: The pattern pointed to a room no map showed.
passion:0.line: 'His *passion* built every hidden node in this city.'

temperature:0.en: The server room hummed in the dark. I checked the gauge on the wall — the *temperature* had climbed ten degrees in an hour. Ali pressed her hand to the nearest rack and pulled back fast. Something inside was running very hard, processing data it was never meant to hold.
temperature:0.cnHint: 服务器室里，阿栗发现机架的____异常升高。
temperature:0.hook: Whatever it was computing, it would finish before dawn.
temperature:0.line: 'The *temperature* spike means the core is almost full.'

board:0.en: A steel *board* was fixed to the wall of the relay station, covered in coded symbols burnt into the surface. Grey Crow ran one finger along the top row. Each mark was a name — a contact, now silent. I counted them. Twenty-three. The last one was still warm to the touch.
board:0.cnHint: 中继站墙上的一块____刻满代号，最后一个仍是温热的。
board:0.hook: One name near the bottom edge was mine.
board:0.line: 'Every name on this *board* trusted the wrong signal.'

handle:0.en: The cabinet door had no lock — only a short iron *handle*, worn smooth by years of use. Ali reached for it. I caught her wrist. 'Zero always rigs the first thing you touch,' Grey Crow said from behind us. We stood still, the silence pressing in like water.
handle:0.cnHint: 阿栗伸手去拉铁柜的____，我及时阻止了她。
handle:0.hook: A faint click came from inside the cabinet anyway.
handle:0.line: 'Never *handle* anything Zero left without checking twice.'

ideal:0.en: 'This room is *ideal*,' Zero's voice came from the speakers, smooth and unhurried. 'Sealed walls, one exit, no outside signal.' I looked at Ali. She was already scanning for a second way out. Grey Crow stood at the centre of the room, eyes closed, listening to something I could not hear.
ideal:0.cnHint: 零点的声音从扬声器传来，称这个房间对他的计划而言____。
ideal:0.hook: Grey Crow's eyes opened, and he smiled at the ceiling.
ideal:0.line: 'You think this room is *ideal*, but so do we.'

ride:0.en: The freight lift was the only way down. 'One last *ride*,' Ali said, stepping inside. The doors closed and the cage dropped fast, cables singing in the shaft. Grey Crow watched the floor numbers count down on the small display. At level four the numbers stopped. The lift did not.
ride:0.cnHint: 我们踏上货梯，开始最后一次____，数字却在四层停了。
ride:0.hook: The doors opened onto a floor that should not exist.
ride:0.line: 'This *ride* goes somewhere not on any plan I have seen.'

adjust:0.en: The signal was drifting. I reached for the receiver and began to *adjust* the frequency dial, degree by slow degree. Grey Crow stood at the window, watching the street below. 'You have about forty seconds,' he said, without turning. The static thinned. A voice began to form inside the noise.
adjust:0.cnHint: 我试着____接收器的频率，杂音中隐约有声音浮现。
adjust:0.hook: The voice was reading out coordinates — for this building.
adjust:0.line: '*Adjust* it slowly, or the signal will collapse for good.'

basis:0.en: 'On what *basis* did you trust him?' Grey Crow asked, setting a data chip on the table between us. I had no clean answer. Zero had given me two true facts and one lie, and I had chosen to believe the lie. Grey Crow tapped the chip once. 'This is what it cost.'
basis:0.cnHint: 灰鸦质问我信任零点的____，桌上的芯片是代价的证明。
basis:0.hook: The chip held every name I had ever given Zero.
basis:0.line: 'Tell me the *basis* for every choice you made tonight.'

modern:0.en: The safe house was buried under a *modern* data-relay tower, its walls humming with live signals. Grey Crow tapped a glowing panel. 'Every old secret hides inside new machines,' he said. I pressed my ear to the cold steel and heard something that should not have been there.
modern:0.cnHint: 我们藏身于一座____建筑之下，灰鸦说旧秘密藏在新机器里。
modern:0.hook: The signal was not data — it was a voice calling my name.
modern:0.line: Grey Crow: 'This *modern* tower is the perfect place to hide the oldest lie.'

officer:0.en: A city *officer* in a grey coat stepped into the relay room and swept a light across the walls. Ali pulled me behind a server rack. My heart hit my ribs. The officer stopped, turned slowly, and aimed the beam at the exact rack where we crouched.
officer:0.cnHint: 一名____走进机房，阿里把我拉到机架后面躲藏。
officer:0.hook: The light crept closer, inch by inch, until it touched my boot.
officer:0.line: Ali: 'That *officer* knows this room — he came here before.'

convince:0.en: Zero's voice came through the wall speaker, smooth and cold. 'I can *convince* the city council your signal logs are forgeries,' he said. 'Walk away and live.' I looked at the data chip in my hand. He was not offering a deal — he was buying time.
convince:0.cnHint: 零点试图____我放弃，但我意识到他只是在拖延时间。
convince:0.hook: Behind me, the door handle began to turn without a sound.
convince:0.line: Zero: 'Nothing will *convince* them you are telling the truth — nothing.'

directly:0.en: Grey Crow walked *directly* to the central console and plugged in a thin black drive. No pause, no check — he had been here before. I asked how he knew the layout. He said nothing, only glanced at the emergency exit with eyes that held too many answers.
directly:0.cnHint: 灰鸦____走向主控台，他的熟练让我起了疑心。
directly:0.hook: His fingerprints were already on file — and the file was marked enemy.
directly:0.line: Grey Crow: 'Go *directly* to the lower console and do not look back.'

extend:0.en: Zero hit a key and the lockdown timer on the wall screen began to *extend*, adding ten seconds, then twenty. 'I control every clock in this building,' he said over the intercom. Ali looked at me. We had planned for three minutes. Now we had no idea how long we had.
extend:0.cnHint: 零点让倒计时不断____，我们的计划开始崩塌。
extend:0.hook: The number kept climbing, and Zero's laughter filled the room.
extend:0.line: Zero: 'I can *extend* your suffering as long as I choose.'

saturday:0.en: The mission file said *Saturday*, but today was Thursday. Grey Crow had moved the operation two days early without telling me. I checked the encrypted log — the change was made at three in the morning, from a terminal that matched Zero's handprint on file. Two days meant two fewer escape routes.
saturday:0.cnHint: 任务原定____执行，但有人提前了行动日期。
saturday:0.hook: Someone wanted us here early — and unprepared.
saturday:0.line: Grey Crow: 'On *Saturday* we would have been caught — I had no choice.'

april:0.en: A date stamp in the corner of the stolen archive read *April* 7, 2099 — three weeks from now. The file was not a record. It was a plan. Ali leaned over my shoulder and read the last line aloud: all relay towers dark, all exits sealed, all investigators listed by name.
april:0.cnHint: 档案上写着____的日期，那是一份针对我们的未来计划。
april:0.hook: My own name was at the top of the list, circled in red.
april:0.line: Ali: '*April* seventh — that is the night they plan to erase us.'

relative:0.en: The safe house smelled of cold coffee and old circuits. Grey Crow spread the map across the table. 'Zero's position is *relative* to the signal tower,' he said. 'Move the tower, move Zero.' Ali and I stared. The whole plan had just shifted by three city blocks.
relative:0.cnHint: 灰鸦解释道，零点的位置与信号塔____，只要移塔，局面就会改变。
relative:0.hook: Someone had already moved the tower an hour ago.
relative:0.line: 'Zero's strength is only *relative* to how much power we cut.'

rent:0.en: The back room cost nothing on paper. Grey Crow said he paid the *rent* in favors, not credits. Twelve locked servers lined the walls. Ali ran her fingers along one case. I checked the door log. The last visitor had signed in under my name, three nights before I ever found this place.
rent:0.cnHint: 灰鸦用人情而非钱币支付这里的____，但门禁记录却出现了我的名字。
rent:0.hook: My name was there, but I had never been here before.
rent:0.line: 'The *rent* on silence is higher than you think.'

round:0.en: We were on the third *round* of decryption and the code kept folding back on itself. Grey Crow paced the narrow room. Ali fed another key sequence into the terminal. Each cycle revealed one new layer and hid two old ones. Outside, rain hammered the steel shutters like a countdown no one had set.
round:0.cnHint: 第三____解密仍未突破，代码像迷宫一样不断折叠，窗外的雨声如同倒计时。
round:0.hook: The fourth round returned a message addressed to me personally.
round:0.line: 'Every *round* we lose, Zero gets one step closer to the core.'

structure:0.en: The building had no official address. Grey Crow called it a ghost shell. The inner *structure* was wrong — floors that stopped mid-air, staircases leading to sealed walls. Ali whispered that Zero had designed it to confuse any scanner. I looked up and saw a camera lens blink once, then go dark.
structure:0.cnHint: 这栋建筑的内部____极为诡异，据说是零点亲自设计来迷惑扫描器的。
structure:0.hook: The camera blinked again, and this time it tracked my face.
structure:0.line: 'The *structure* was built so that no map of it can ever be complete.'

typical:0.en: A *typical* briefing lasted five minutes. This one had already run forty. Grey Crow kept looping back to the same surveillance photo: a woman in a grey coat standing outside the archive. Ali said nothing. I finally spoke. 'That coat,' I said. 'That is the same coat hanging behind your door right now.'
typical:0.cnHint: 这次汇报远超____时长，灰鸦反复盯着同一张照片，我注意到了令人不安的细节。
typical:0.hook: Grey Crow's hand moved slowly toward the door without looking.
typical:0.line: 'This is not a *typical* signal — it is a direct call to you.'

vacation:0.en: The terminal showed fourteen agents listed as on *vacation*. Grey Crow laughed, short and dry. 'No one in this division takes vacations,' he said. Ali pulled up their last known locations. All fourteen had been in the archive district on the same night. I saved the list and felt the room grow very quiet.
vacation:0.cnHint: 系统显示十四名特工正在____，但灰鸦说这个部门从来没有人真正休假。
vacation:0.hook: One name on the list was Ali's, dated two weeks from now.
vacation:0.line: 'A *vacation* in this city means someone wants you gone quietly.'

acquire:0.en: Zero had spent years trying to *acquire* the signal key. Grey Crow told us that much. The key was not a file — it was a pattern burned into a specific frequency only one transmitter could produce. Ali found the transmitter listed as destroyed. I found its power log still running, live, in this very building.
acquire:0.cnHint: 零点多年来试图____那枚信号密钥，而我们发现那台据称已毁的发射器仍在运行。
acquire:0.hook: The transmitter was broadcasting right now, from the floor below us.
acquire:0.line: 'To *acquire* the key, Zero would erase every trace we ever existed.'

adequate:0.en: The backup power was *adequate* for six hours, Grey Crow said. Ali reset the timer. That left us five hours and eleven minutes to pull the core data before the building went dark and every lock in it snapped shut. I started the transfer. At the four-minute mark, the progress bar stopped moving entirely.
adequate:0.cnHint: 备用电源____支撑六小时，但数据传输刚开始四分钟，进度条就彻底停止了。
adequate:0.hook: The transfer had not frozen — it was being pulled the other way.
adequate:0.line: 'Five hours is *adequate* only if Zero is not already inside the system.'

comfortable:0.en: The safe house was small but warm. A single lamp cast orange light across the floor. Ali pulled a *comfortable* blanket over the stolen data chip and said nothing. Outside, Zero's drones swept the alley. We had maybe four minutes before the signal died and the city swallowed us whole.
comfortable:0.cnHint: 阿栗用一条____的毯子盖住了数据芯片，而零点的无人机正在外面扫描巷道。
comfortable:0.hook: The blanket moved — someone was already under it.
comfortable:0.line: 'This *comfortable* cover won't fool Zero for long,' Ali warned.

conclusion:0.en: Grey Crow spread three decoded files across the cracked table. Each one pointed the same way. 'There is only one *conclusion*,' he said, tapping the final page. The building's owner, the missing signal tower, and the silenced broadcast — all tied to a single name no one in Harbor City dared speak aloud.
conclusion:0.cnHint: 灰鸦分析了三份解密文件，得出了一个令人不安的____。
conclusion:0.line: 'The *conclusion* is clear — you were never meant to survive this.'

formal:0.en: Zero sent a *formal* notice to every investigator in the district. Clean text, official seal, correct grammar. It looked like law. It read like a threat. Ali slid the paper across to me without a word. I read it twice. My name appeared in the last line, listed under 'persons to be removed from the case.'
formal:0.cnHint: 零点发来一份措辞____的通知，而我的名字出现在最后一行。
formal:0.hook: The seal on the notice belonged to a bureau that no longer existed.
formal:0.line: 'A *formal* warning from Zero means the next step is silence,' Grey Crow said.

happiness:0.en: A child's drawing was pinned to the wall of the abandoned flat — two figures holding hands under a yellow sun. The word *happiness* was written in crayon below them, unsteady and bright. Ali looked at it a long time. I didn't ask why. Some things in Harbor City hurt more than any signal ever could.
happiness:0.cnHint: 阿栗在废弃公寓的墙上看到一幅写着____的蜡笔画，久久没有移开视线。
happiness:0.hook: The drawing was dated three days from now.
happiness:0.line: '*Happiness* is the one code Zero never learned to crack,' Ali said softly.

intelligent:0.en: The terminal blinked once, then answered my question before I finished typing it. Grey Crow leaned back. 'Zero built an *intelligent* system — it learns your patterns faster than you form them.' I pulled my hands from the keyboard. Every search I had run tonight had been a lesson I was giving the enemy without knowing it.
intelligent:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告说，零点建造的____系统已经从我每一次搜索中学习。
intelligent:0.hook: The terminal typed a message I had never sent.
intelligent:0.line: 'An *intelligent* trap looks exactly like the answer you were hoping for,' Grey Crow said.

novel:0.en: The clue was hidden inside a *novel* — a thin, forgotten book left on a shelf in the records room. Not the words, but the page numbers, underlined in pale ink. Ali cracked the sequence in under a minute. The coordinates they formed led to a floor of this very building that did not appear on any map.
novel:0.cnHint: 线索藏在一本____里，阿栗迅速破译了那串被标记的页码。
novel:0.hook: The shelf slid aside, and cold air poured out from the dark beyond.
novel:0.line: 'Whoever hid this *novel* knew we would be the ones to find it,' Ali said.

political:0.en: The broadcast was not about weather or crime. Grey Crow turned up the volume. 'It's a *political* signal,' he said. 'Whoever controls this frequency controls the next election.' The voice on the air was calm and certain, repeating a single phrase. I recognised it. Zero had used those exact words the night the old council disappeared.
political:0.cnHint: 灰鸦发现这段广播是一个____信号，与旧议会的失踪直接相关。
political:0.hook: The voice on the broadcast was broadcasting live — from inside our building.
political:0.line: 'This is not news — it is a *political* weapon aimed at the whole city,' Grey Crow said.

property:0.en: The deed was forged, but only slightly. Someone had changed one digit in the address, shifting ownership of the entire block to a shell name. 'All *property* on that street now belongs to Zero,' Ali said, spreading the documents under the light. That street held the last free signal tower in Harbor City.
property:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现那条街上所有的____已被悄悄转移到零点名下，包括最后一座自由信号塔。
property:0.hook: Our safe house was on that street.
property:0.line: 'When Zero owns the *property*, Zero owns everyone inside it,' Ali said.

conventional:0.en: The briefing room smelled of cold coffee and static. Grey Crow spread a map across the table. 'Forget *conventional* routes,' he said. 'Zero knows every road you'd normally take.' I studied the unmarked lines he'd drawn instead — paths that existed nowhere in any city record.
conventional:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，用____的路线只会走进陷阱。
conventional:0.hook: The unmarked path led straight under the sealed district.
conventional:0.line: 'Forget *conventional* routes — Zero has eyes on every one.'

disappear:0.en: Ali pulled up the security log on her cracked screen. Twelve operatives had entered Sub-Level 9 this month. I counted the exit records: only eleven names. 'One person did not come back,' she said quietly. Files, badge data, biometric trace — everything about the twelfth agent had managed to *disappear*.
disappear:0.cnHint: 档案室里，一名特工的所有记录都____了。
disappear:0.hook: Someone had erased that name before we ever arrived.
disappear:0.line: 'How does a whole person just *disappear* from every system?'

district:0.en: The city was carved into seven zones, each one controlled by a different signal tower. Grey Crow tapped the eastern block on the map. 'Zero operates out of the Rust *district*,' he said, 'where our scanners go blind.' I had heard stories about that sector. None of them ended well.
district:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指出，零点藏匿在城市某个____里。
district:0.hook: Our clearance badges were useless east of the iron wall.
district:0.line: 'The Rust *district* is where our signals die — and so do agents.'

greatly:0.en: I had run signal-trace drills before, but nothing like this. The encrypted broadcast we intercepted shifted codes every four seconds. Ali adjusted the decoder and the noise *greatly* reduced, sharpening into a single repeating word. We leaned closer to the speaker. The word was my own name.
greatly:0.cnHint: 阿栗调整解码器后，干扰____减少，信号变得清晰。
greatly:0.hook: My name, spoken in Zero's voice, filled the cold room.
greatly:0.line: 'Noise is *greatly* reduced — listen, that word is you.'

imitate:0.en: Zero's latest broadcast mimicked the police alert tone perfectly. Half the building had evacuated before we realised it was fake. 'Anyone can *imitate* an official signal with the right hardware,' Grey Crow said, sliding a small black device across the table. 'This is how he does it. Study it.'
imitate:0.cnHint: 零点用某种设备____官方信号，制造了一场假警报。
imitate:0.hook: The device in my hand was still warm from someone else.
imitate:0.line: 'He can *imitate* any official tone — even the one we trust most.'

implement:0.en: Ali laid three objects on the steel bench: a signal knife, a loop wire, and a small grey box. 'Each *implement* has one job,' she said, tapping each in turn. 'Cut, bind, transmit.' I picked up the grey box. It was lighter than I expected for something that could crack a tower core.
implement:0.cnHint: 阿栗向我介绍桌上每件____的具体用途。
implement:0.hook: One of those tools, she warned, had a hidden second function.
implement:0.line: 'Every *implement* on this bench has exactly one purpose — learn it.'

mood:0.en: Grey Crow had not spoken in twenty minutes. His jaw was tight and his eyes stayed fixed on the static screen. The room matched his *mood* — cold, still, heavy with something unsaid. Ali caught my eye and gave a small shake of her head. Whatever had changed, we would not hear it from him tonight.
mood:0.cnHint: 灰鸦沉默不语，房间里的气氛与他的____如出一辙。
mood:0.hook: Then the screen flickered, and his silence finally broke.
mood:0.line: 'Read the room — my *mood* should tell you this plan just changed.'

motivation:0.en: Zero had left a message inside the false alert: three lines of plain text, no code. The last line read — 'You still do not understand my *motivation*.' I read it twice. Grey Crow said nothing. Ali printed it out and pinned it to the wall as if it were a threat, or a clue, or both.
motivation:0.cnHint: 零点留下的信息让我们开始怀疑他真正的____。
motivation:0.hook: Grey Crow circled that last line and said: 'He wants us to ask.'
motivation:0.line: 'If we misread his *motivation*, we will walk into exactly what he built.'

obvious:0.en: The server room hummed beneath the old district archive. I scanned the rows of blinking drives. Someone had been here. The dust pattern was disturbed in a wide arc, and the missing unit left a gap *obvious* enough that even a rookie could read it as a warning.
obvious:0.cnHint: 档案室里有人动过设备，留下了____的痕迹。
obvious:0.hook: The gap pointed at something worse than theft.
obvious:0.line: Grey Crow said, 'The missing drive makes the trap *obvious*, rookie.'

ordinary:0.en: The holding room smelled of cold coffee and old paint. Grey Crow dropped a thin folder on the table. Inside: one photograph, one name, one address. Nothing about it looked dangerous. It was an *ordinary* file — the kind you pass without a second glance — and that was exactly why it scared me.
ordinary:0.cnHint: 那份____的文件夹里，隐藏着让人不安的秘密。
ordinary:0.hook: Files that look safe are the ones that kill you.
ordinary:0.line: Grey Crow said, 'An *ordinary* cover is Zero's favourite weapon.'

pace:0.en: Ali locked the door and began to *pace* the narrow control room, three steps left, three steps right. The signal was live. Zero had already entered the building. Every second we delayed was a second he moved closer to the core terminal. I watched Ali's boots wear a line in the floor.
pace:0.cnHint: 阿栗在控制室里不断____，因为敌人已经进入了大楼。
pace:0.hook: Ali stopped mid-step, eyes fixed on the monitor.
pace:0.line: Ali said, 'Stop watching me *pace* and start watching the door.'

participate:0.en: The briefing room held five investigators. Commander Lin looked at each face before speaking. 'Only two of you will *participate* in the final raid,' she said. 'The others run support from this room.' I felt the air shift. Grey Crow stared at the floor. I understood then: being chosen meant being exposed.
participate:0.cnHint: 指挥官宣布只有两名调查员能____最终突袭行动。
participate:0.hook: Grey Crow's silence told me everything about the risk.
participate:0.line: Commander Lin said, 'Those who *participate* must be ready to lose the signal.'

pilot:0.en: The transit log on the terminal showed a single departure: a cargo shuttle, cleared at midnight. The registered *pilot* was listed as a maintenance worker — no flight record, no licence number, just a blank line where credentials should be. Ali pulled the manifest. The cargo was marked as 'archived data'. It was not.
pilot:0.cnHint: 货运飞船的____身份存疑，货物清单也疑点重重。
pilot:0.hook: The blank licence line matched a name we already feared.
pilot:0.line: Ali said, 'No real *pilot* leaves a blank where the licence should be.'

primary:0.en: Grey Crow spread the building schematics across the desk. Three access points, two decoy routes, one true path. 'Your *primary* target is the relay node on sub-level four,' he said, tapping the deepest circle on the map. Everything else — the guards, the locks, the side corridors — was noise around that single point.
primary:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指出，____目标是地下四层的中继节点。
primary:0.hook: Sub-level four had no exit marked on the map.
primary:0.line: Grey Crow said, 'Forget the rest — the relay node is *primary*.'

priority:0.en: The alert board lit up with four simultaneous breach signals. Ali's hands flew across the keyboard, ranking each one. I leaned in. Three signals were minor — sensor ghosts. The fourth, in the basement corridor, pulsed red. 'That one is the *priority*,' Ali said without looking up. The others could wait. This one could not.
priority:0.cnHint: 四个警报同时响起，阿栗迅速判断出哪个是____。
priority:0.hook: The basement corridor camera had already gone dark.
priority:0.line: Ali said, 'Everything else waits — the basement breach is the *priority*.'

throughout:0.en: I reviewed the security log from the past six hours. Zero had moved like a ghost *throughout* the entire lower wing — past the check posts, past the sensor grids, past the locked archive bays — leaving not a single flag. He had not broken the system. He had simply never triggered it. That was far worse.
throughout:0.cnHint: 零点____整个下层区域穿行，却没有触发任何警报。
throughout:0.hook: A ghost who knows your sensors is already inside your mind.
throughout:0.line: Grey Crow said, 'He moved *throughout* the wing and we never saw him once.'

attribute:0.en: Grey Crow spread the stolen files across the cold server-room floor. Each fragment of code carried a hidden mark. 'You can *attribute* this breach to one person,' he said quietly, tapping a single encrypted signature that appeared in every file. I leaned in. The name behind that signature would end everything.
attribute:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在服务器室地板上展开文件，试图将入侵____到某个特定的人。
attribute:0.hook: The signature pointed to someone inside our own unit.
attribute:0.line: 'You can *attribute* this breach to one person,' Grey Crow said.

badly:0.en: The safe room smelled of burnt wire and cold coffee. Ali pressed a cloth against her arm where a spark had caught her. 'I'm not *badly* hurt,' she said, but her hand trembled as she typed the override code. The system had one minute before it locked us out forever.
badly:0.cnHint: 阿栗在安全屋里受了伤，但她坚持说伤势并不____，继续输入解锁代码。
badly:0.hook: Her trembling fingers hit the wrong key.
badly:0.line: 'I'm not *badly* hurt — just keep the door sealed,' Ali said.

bridge:0.en: The data hub sat at the center of Harbor City's network like a spider in its web. Grey Crow called it the *bridge* — the single point that connected every encrypted channel in the city. Whoever controlled it could read every secret. Zero already had his hands on the controls.
bridge:0.cnHint: 灰鸦将这个数据枢纽称为____，它连接着全城所有加密频道。
bridge:0.hook: Zero smiled at us through the security feed.
bridge:0.line: 'Control the *bridge*, and you control every voice in this city,' Grey Crow said.

casual:0.en: Zero walked into the relay station as if he owned it, his steps slow and *casual*, a plain coat over his shoulders. No weapon showed. No hurry. That calm was the danger — it meant he had already won something we had not yet lost. I signaled Ali to move left.
casual:0.cnHint: 零点以一种____的步态走进中继站，他的从容让我感到不安。
casual:0.hook: He turned and looked straight at the hidden camera.
casual:0.line: 'A *casual* walk through the front door — that is how confident he is,' I told Ali.

closely:0.en: I watched the scrolling code *closely*, line by line, my eyes burning from the pale screen light. Something in the pattern repeated every thirty-two characters — too regular to be noise, too hidden to be accident. Ali noticed me freeze. 'Found it?' she whispered. I was not sure yet. Almost.
closely:0.cnHint: 我____盯着滚动的代码，发现其中有一种隐藏的规律。
closely:0.hook: Then the pattern vanished, wiped clean in real time.
closely:0.line: 'Watch *closely* — the signal hides inside the silence between words,' Grey Crow said.

commit:0.en: Grey Crow set the decryption device on the table and looked at me. 'Once I run this, we *commit*. No quiet exit after.' The hum of the servers filled the silence. Ali nodded first. Then I did. Grey Crow pressed the key, and every screen in the room blazed white.
commit:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我们，一旦启动解密装置，我们就____了，没有退路。
commit:0.hook: An alarm we had never heard before filled the building.
commit:0.line: 'When we *commit* to this, there is no quiet way out,' Grey Crow said.

concentrate:0.en: '*Concentrate*,' Ali said sharply, gripping my shoulder. The interference was getting worse, layering signal over signal until the real message was buried. I closed my eyes, filtered the noise the way Grey Crow had taught me, and listened for the one voice underneath it all. It was Zero's. Reading our location.
concentrate:0.cnHint: 阿栗让我____精神，在层层干扰信号中找出真正的信息。
concentrate:0.hook: Zero had known where we were for the last ten minutes.
concentrate:0.line: '*Concentrate* — the real signal is under all that noise,' Ali said.

conscious:0.en: The light in the back office was a single yellow bulb. Grey Crow sat against the wall, eyes open, breathing slow. I was not sure he had heard me until he spoke. 'I'm *conscious*. I heard every word you said to Ali.' He stood without help. That steadiness scared me more than weakness would have.
conscious:0.cnHint: 灰鸦靠墙而坐，我不确定他是否____，直到他开口说话。
conscious:0.hook: He said he had also heard the voice I had not mentioned.
conscious:0.line: 'I'm *conscious* — and I heard what you chose not to tell me,' Grey Crow said.

worldwide:0.en: The signal hit every screen in the building at once. Grey Crow slid a data chip across the table. 'This broadcast is *worldwide*,' he said quietly. 'Every city, every hidden channel. Zero wants everyone to hear the message — and once they do, there is no pulling it back.'
worldwide:0.cnHint: 格雷·克罗告诉我，那条信号已____传播，无法撤回。
worldwide:0.hook: The countdown on the chip read: four minutes left.
worldwide:0.line: 'This signal is *worldwide* now — every city is listening.'

accomplish:0.en: Ali spread the broken files across the floor of the server room. 'We have one shot,' she said, pressing her fingers against the cold panel. Without this code, we could not *accomplish* anything. The door behind us was already sealed. The hum of machines grew louder.
accomplish:0.cnHint: 阿里说，如果拿不到这段代码，我们就无法____任何事。
accomplish:0.hook: Then the lights cut out, and something moved in the dark.
accomplish:0.line: 'Without that key, we cannot *accomplish* a single thing.'

address:0.en: The screen blinked once and showed a single line of text: an *address* — a room number deep inside Harbor City's closed east tower. Grey Crow circled it with his finger. 'Zero is there,' he said. 'Has been for three days. No one goes in. No one comes out.'
address:0.cnHint: 屏幕上出现了一个____，那是零藏身的地方。
address:0.hook: I memorised it, then watched the screen go dark forever.
address:0.line: 'That *address* is the last place anyone saw Zero alive.'

barely:0.en: I had *barely* reached the stairwell door when the alarm stripped the silence apart. Red light flooded the corridor. Ali grabbed my arm and pulled me flat against the wall. We could hear boots — many boots — pounding up from the floor below. No time to think.
barely:0.cnHint: 我____刚到达楼梯口，警报就响了。
barely:0.hook: The boots stopped directly on the other side of the wall.
barely:0.line: 'We *barely* made it — they were one floor behind us.'

blame:0.en: Grey Crow sat still at the centre of the cold room. 'If this fails,' he said, eyes on the dead monitor, 'the *blame* falls on me alone — not on you, not on Ali. I gave the order. I opened the door.' He did not look like a man asking for comfort.
blame:0.cnHint: 格雷·克罗说，如果行动失败，所有____都由他一人承担。
blame:0.hook: Ali looked at me, and neither of us believed him.
blame:0.line: 'The *blame* for this plan is mine — no one else's.'

chat:0.en: Zero's voice came through the small speaker, smooth and unhurried. 'Let us *chat* for a moment,' it said. 'You are standing in my server room, touching my machines. I find that interesting.' The speaker crackled. Ali stepped back. I did not move. Outside, rain beat against dark glass.
chat:0.cnHint: 零通过扬声器说想和我们____一会儿，语气平静得令人不安。
chat:0.hook: The door at the far end clicked open on its own.
chat:0.line: 'Let us *chat* — I have questions only you can answer.'

combat:0.en: The training files on the hard drive mapped every move Zero had used before. Grey Crow tapped the screen. 'This is not physical *combat*,' he said. 'It is a war of signals and broken locks. You fight by being three steps ahead, not by being stronger.' I read every line twice.
combat:0.cnHint: 格雷·克罗解释说，我们面对的____不是肉搏，而是信号与密码之间的较量。
combat:0.hook: The files ended with a warning no one had translated yet.
combat:0.line: 'This *combat* is fought with code, not with hands.'

danger:0.en: The sensor on Ali's wrist buzzed three times — the pattern that meant real *danger*, not a drill. She held it up without a word. I looked at the number on the display: twelve seconds of safe air left in the sealed room. Grey Crow was already moving toward the vent.
danger:0.cnHint: 阿里手腕上的传感器发出警报，提示我们正身处真正的____之中。
danger:0.hook: Grey Crow reached the vent — and found it welded shut.
danger:0.line: 'The *danger* level just hit red — we move right now.'

partly:0.en: The server room hummed behind a locked steel door. I pressed my ear against the cold metal. The signal was *partly* clear — enough to catch Grey Crow's encrypted signature buried in the noise, but something else was layered beneath it, something I could not yet name.
partly:0.cnHint: 我____听清了信号，但其中隐藏着另一层未知的信息。
partly:0.hook: The second signal had no known source in the whole city.
partly:0.line: 'The message is *partly* mine — the rest belongs to someone else.'

practical:0.en: Ali spread the stolen circuit maps across the dusty table. 'Forget the elegant approach,' she said. We needed a *practical* plan — one that worked in the dark, with broken tools and thirty seconds on the clock. I circled the ventilation shaft with a red marker.
practical:0.cnHint: 阿栗主张采用____的方案，我们在地图上标出了突破口。
practical:0.hook: The clock on the wall was already running — we just could not see it.
practical:0.line: 'Be *practical*. We have no time for a perfect solution.'

profit:0.en: Zero had not cracked the archive for justice. Grey Crow told me that much in a whisper through a cracked earpiece. Every stolen file had a buyer. Every buyer added to a growing *profit* that funded something far larger than one man's ambition. I felt cold.
profit:0.cnHint: 零点窃取档案并非出于正义，背后有人靠此____资助更大的阴谋。
profit:0.hook: The buyer list had one name I already trusted.
profit:0.line: 'There is no ideology here — only *profit* and the men who count it.'

promise:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a folded card in the dim copy room. On it was a single printed line — a *promise* that if I delivered the core drive before midnight, the sealed charges against Ali would disappear. I read it twice. It felt like a trap dressed as hope.
promise:0.cnHint: 灰鸦交给我一张卡片，上面是一个____，但这更像是一个伪装成希望的陷阱。
promise:0.hook: A promise written by a shadow is worth less than the paper it rides on.
promise:0.line: 'A *promise* from Zero means he still needs something from you.'

rarely:0.en: The archive terminal in Sub-level Four was *rarely* accessed — dust coated the keys and the login light blinked a slow, forgotten green. That made it perfect. Zero would not expect a signal routed through a machine the whole network had stopped watching years ago.
rarely:0.cnHint: 地下四层的终端____有人使用，这反而让它成为我们最安全的通道。
rarely:0.hook: But a thin scratch in the dust told me someone had been here first.
rarely:0.line: 'I *rarely* come down here — which is exactly why you should.'

severe:0.en: The system log printed in pale red letters across the screen. The breach had triggered a *severe* lockdown protocol — every exit sealed, every camera live. Ali's fingers stopped moving above the keyboard. I counted the seconds. The air in the room felt suddenly thinner.
severe:0.cnHint: 系统入侵触发了____的封锁程序，所有出口关闭，我们被困在内部。
severe:0.hook: Somewhere above us, boots were already moving toward the stairs.
severe:0.line: 'The penalty for this is *severe* — they will not ask questions first.'

smell:0.en: I stepped inside the abandoned relay station and stopped. The *smell* hit me before my eyes adjusted to the dark — burnt plastic and something chemical, sharp and wrong. Someone had destroyed equipment here recently. Grey Crow had said this room was untouched. Grey Crow had lied.
smell:0.cnHint: 我走进中继站，一股____让我意识到灰鸦对我撒了谎。
smell:0.hook: The ash on the floor was still warm beneath my boots.
smell:0.line: 'That *smell* — they wiped the drives with heat, not code.'

socialize:0.en: The data club was a cover. People came to drink and *socialize*, to trade small talk above the bass line — but below the floor, buried in a shielded crawl space, a secondary transmitter pulsed every eleven minutes. I had found Zero's real office. It looked nothing like one.
socialize:0.cnHint: 人们来这里____，但地板下藏着零点真正的发报装置。
socialize:0.hook: The transmitter pulsed once more — then went completely silent.
socialize:0.line: 'We *socialize* up here so no one listens down there.'

dinner:0.en: The coded invitation read: *dinner* at floor ninety-nine, eight sharp. I knew it was not about food. Grey Crow had planted the word in the city broadcast two hours ago — a signal only I could hear. Whatever was waiting at that table, it would change everything.
dinner:0.cnHint: 我收到一个暗语邀请，知道这顿____背后隐藏着危险的秘密。
dinner:0.hook: The elevator doors opened — and Zero was already seated.
dinner:0.line: 'This *dinner* is not a meal — it is a trap meant for you.'

embrace:0.en: Grey Crow stepped close and spoke in a low voice. 'To survive tonight, you must *embrace* every risk, not run from it.' The signal in my head pulsed in agreement. Outside the frosted window, Harbor City burned cold and bright, waiting for my next move.
embrace:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我必须____所有风险，而不是逃避它们。
embrace:0.hook: Then the lights cut out, and a door I had not seen swung open.
embrace:0.line: '*Embrace* the danger, or it will find you first.'

explanation:0.en: Zero slid a data card across the table. 'No *explanation* needed,' they said, voice flat as code. But I needed one badly — the card held names, and mine was at the top. Ali caught my eye from across the room and gave the smallest shake of their head.
explanation:0.cnHint: 零点不想给出任何____，但那张数据卡上的内容让我必须弄清真相。
explanation:0.hook: The card began to dissolve in the heat of my hand.
explanation:0.line: 'Your *explanation* had better arrive before that door does.'

intend:0.en: 'What do you *intend* to do with that signal?' Grey Crow asked, watching me from the corner of the dim room. I had picked up a forbidden broadcast — raw, unfiltered, full of city secrets. Ali was already at the door, coat on, ready to run.
intend:0.cnHint: 灰鸦问我____如何处理那个被禁止的信号。
intend:0.hook: Before I could answer, the broadcast went silent.
intend:0.line: 'I *intend* to use it before Zero gets there first.'

leadership:0.en: The *leadership* of the Signal Bureau met on floor ninety-nine each month — but tonight the room was empty except for one chair, one lamp, and a note in Ali's handwriting. Someone had cleared them out fast. I pressed my back to the wall and listened hard.
leadership:0.cnHint: 信号局的____层定期在这里开会，但今晚房间里空无一人，只有阿栗留下的字条。
leadership:0.hook: The note said only: 'They already know you are here.'
leadership:0.line: 'The *leadership* sold us out — every last one of them.'

locate:0.en: 'I need you to *locate* the source before midnight,' Grey Crow said, handing me a small device that hummed against my palm. The hidden signal was moving through the building's walls like water. Ali was already scanning the upper floors. Time was very short.
locate:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要我在午夜前____那个不断移动的隐藏信号源。
locate:0.hook: The device went cold — the signal had stopped moving.
locate:0.line: 'Can you *locate* it, or do we walk away right now?'

original:0.en: The file on the table was a copy — I was sure of it. The *original* had been taken hours before we arrived, replaced with clean, empty data. Ali ran a check and nodded grimly. Zero had been here first, and they had left nothing useful behind.
original:0.cnHint: 桌上的文件只是副本，____早已被零点取走，什么有用的都没留下。
original:0.hook: But one line of code in the copy had not been erased.
original:0.line: 'Find the *original*, and we find what Zero is hiding.'

overcome:0.en: The signal was designed to break focus — a wall of noise meant to *overcome* anyone trying to decode it. I held on, teeth tight, and pushed through. Grey Crow had trained me for exactly this. When the noise cleared, a single name was left standing in the silence.
overcome:0.cnHint: 那道信号噪音试图____我的解码专注力，但我坚持了下来，听到了一个关键的名字。
overcome:0.hook: The name belonged to someone I had trusted completely.
overcome:0.line: 'You will *overcome* it — I have seen you do harder things.'

threaten:0.en: The signal came through the walls of the old server room. Grey Crow leaned close and whispered that Zero had sent a message: cooperate or face the end. 'He will *threaten* anyone who gets near the truth,' Grey Crow said. I checked the door. It was already locked from the outside.
threaten:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告说零点会____那些接近真相的人。
threaten:0.hook: The lock clicked twice — someone was testing it from outside.
threaten:0.line: 'He will *threaten* anyone who gets near the truth.'

throw:0.en: Ali spread the stolen data cards across the table like a gambler's last hand. 'Every move we make is a *throw* of the dice,' she said quietly. One wrong step and Zero would know our location. The neon signs outside buzzed and flickered, casting red light across her face.
throw:0.cnHint: 阿栗说我们每一步行动都是一次危险的____。
throw:0.hook: Then one card began to glow — it was transmitting.
throw:0.line: 'Every move we make is a *throw* of the dice.'

unlike:0.en: The hidden room beneath the market was *unlike* anything I had seen. No wires, no screens — just bare walls covered in hand-written code. Grey Crow said Zero had built it before the city went digital. My fingers traced the symbols. One line made my stomach drop.
unlike:0.cnHint: 市场地下的秘密房间与我见过的地方____。
unlike:0.hook: The last symbol on the wall matched the one on my badge.
unlike:0.line: 'This place is *unlike* anything Zero has built before.'

vast:0.en: I pulled up the archive on the terminal. The *vast* number of encrypted files stretched across the screen like a frozen ocean. Ali counted under her breath and stopped at three hundred thousand. 'We have six minutes,' Grey Crow said from the door. I started with the oldest file.
vast:0.cnHint: 终端上____数量的加密文件让我们只有六分钟来寻找线索。
vast:0.hook: File one was dated the day I was born.
vast:0.line: 'The *vast* number of files — we cannot read them all in time.'

absolutely:0.en: Grey Crow pressed the drive into my hand and held my gaze. 'You must *absolutely* not open this until you are outside the building,' he said. His voice was flat, no room for argument. Ali nodded from the corner. I put the drive in my coat and headed for the stairs.
absolutely:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要我____不能在大楼里打开那个装置。
absolutely:0.hook: Behind me, the terminal screen went dark and silent.
absolutely:0.line: 'You must *absolutely* not open this until you are outside.'

accumulate:0.en: Zero had spent ten years letting small secrets *accumulate* inside the city's main data tower. Each one was worthless alone. Together they formed a complete map of every hidden agent in Harbor City. Ali stared at the list on the screen. I recognised the third name. It was mine.
accumulate:0.cnHint: 零点花了十年时间让小秘密慢慢____，最终构成一份完整的名单。
accumulate:0.hook: My name on that list meant Zero had known about me all along.
accumulate:0.line: 'He let every secret *accumulate* until the list was complete.'

breakfast:0.en: We had no time to sleep. Ali found a box of cold crackers on the shelf and called it *breakfast*. We ate standing up, eyes on the door monitor. Grey Crow said Zero's team moved at first light. The clock on the wall read five forty-two. First light was close.
breakfast:0.cnHint: 阿栗把架子上找到的饼干当作____，我们站着吃，眼盯着门口监视器。
breakfast:0.hook: At five forty-three, a shadow crossed the monitor screen.
breakfast:0.line: 'Call it *breakfast* if you like — we move the moment we finish.'

capacity:0.en: The old relay station had one flaw: its *capacity* to carry a signal was far below what Zero needed to broadcast citywide. Grey Crow traced the wiring with one finger. 'He will need a second node,' he said. Ali found it on the map before he finished his sentence.
capacity:0.cnHint: 旧中继站的信号____不足，零点必须启用第二个节点。
capacity:0.hook: The second node was inside the city's central hospital.
capacity:0.line: 'Its *capacity* is too low — he must have another node running.'

lift:0.en: The server room hummed beneath the city grid. I pressed the call button. The *lift* doors opened — but the car was empty, cables cut, a black drop below. Someone had killed the power to every floor except this one. I was trapped, and Zero knew it.
lift:0.cnHint: 我按下按钮，____的门打开了，但里面空空如也，下方是漆黑的深渊。
lift:0.hook: The doors slid shut behind me before I could step back.
lift:0.line: 'The *lift* only goes down from here,' Zero said softly.

mainly:0.en: Ali spread the city map across the cold table. The red marks were *mainly* clustered around the old harbor district — every blackout, every signal drop, every disappearance. The pattern was no accident. Someone had been drawing a net around a single building for months, and I had just walked inside it.
mainly:0.cnHint: 阿栗说，异常信号____集中在旧港区的某一栋建筑周围。
mainly:0.hook: The building on the map had no name, only a warning symbol.
mainly:0.line: '*Mainly* the lower floors — that is where they hide the core,' Ali said.

moral:0.en: Grey Crow lit a thin cigarette and stared at the cracked ceiling. 'Every operator in this city tells themselves a story,' he said. 'The *moral* is always the same: someone else paid the price.' He slid a folder across the table. Inside was my name, my file, my past mistakes laid bare.
moral:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说，这座城市里每个人行动背后都有一个____。
moral:0.hook: My own file listed me as the primary suspect.
moral:0.line: 'The *moral* of your story is not written yet,' Grey Crow said quietly.

nor:0.en: The safe house was silent. No heat, *nor* light, nor running water — Zero had cut every line. I moved by touch alone, fingers tracing cold pipes until I found the junction box. One wire still pulsed. Whatever signal it carried was small, fragile, and the only thing keeping me connected to Ali.
nor:0.cnHint: 安全屋里没有热气，也没有灯光，零点切断了所有线路。
nor:0.hook: Then the single wire stopped pulsing in my hand.
nor:0.line: 'No exit on the left, *nor* on the right,' Ali whispered in my earpiece.

pick:0.en: Thirty coded files sat on the dead terminal, each one a different cipher. Grey Crow had warned me I could only crack one before the system locked. I had to *pick* carefully. Ali's location data pointed to file seventeen. My gut said file three. The clock on the wall showed forty seconds left.
pick:0.cnHint: 我必须在三十个加密文件中____出一个，时间只剩四十秒。
pick:0.hook: I pressed a key — and the building's alarm screamed to life.
pick:0.line: '*Pick* the wrong one and every door seals,' Grey Crow had said.

pollution:0.en: The rooftop vents fed directly into the lower archive room. Grey Crow's notes called it a design flaw; Zero called it an opportunity. The air *pollution* from the harbor reactor had been piped in deliberately, eating through the old data cores year by year. Someone wanted those records gone without a trace.
pollution:0.cnHint: 档案室的空气____是人为引入的，目的是悄悄销毁旧数据核心。
pollution:0.hook: One data core still breathed — and it held every name.
pollution:0.line: '*Pollution* is just destruction with better timing,' Zero's voice crackled through the vent.

quit:0.en: My hands would not stop shaking. Three hours inside the locked server block, no signal out, no reply from Ali. Part of me wanted to *quit* — drop the drive, walk to the nearest exit, let the city swallow the secret whole. But Grey Crow's voice replayed in my head: some doors only open once.
quit:0.cnHint: 我想____，放下一切离开，但灰鸦的话让我停下了脚步。
quit:0.hook: That was when the lights came back on and I saw Zero waiting.
quit:0.line: 'If you *quit* now, every name on that list disappears,' Grey Crow had warned.

recall:0.en: I pressed my back to the cold wall and closed my eyes. I tried to *recall* every word Zero had spoken during our first meeting in the lower archive — the pauses, the slips, the moment his eyes moved left. Somewhere in that memory was the cipher key. I had one chance to find it.
recall:0.cnHint: 我努力____零点在档案室初次见面时说过的每一个字，试图找出密码线索。
recall:0.hook: The memory surfaced — and it changed everything I thought I knew.
recall:0.line: '*Recall* the code he used, not the words,' Ali urged in my ear.

consideration:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Harbor City's old transit hub. Grey Crow spread six stolen data chips across the cold floor. 'Every chip is a *consideration*,' he said — each one a reason to move, or a reason to stop. I picked up the red chip. The lock on the far door clicked open.
consideration:0.cnHint: 灰鸦将六块芯片摆在地上，每块都是行动前必须权衡的____。
consideration:0.hook: The red chip was warm — it should have been cold.
consideration:0.line: 'Every *consideration* here could save us — or bury us.'

disaster:0.en: Ali pulled up the city grid on a cracked tablet. The numbers were wrong — all of them. A silent override had rerouted Harbor City's power to a single block. 'If that core overloads,' she said, her voice flat, 'it's a *disaster* for the whole district.' The lights above us began to flicker.
disaster:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现电网数据全部异常，若核心过载将是整个街区的____。
disaster:0.hook: Then the tablet screen went black.
disaster:0.line: 'This is not a drill — one wrong step and *disaster* follows.'

emergency:0.en: A sharp tone cut through the server room. Red text rolled across every screen on the wall: CITY CORE BREACH. Grey Crow grabbed my shoulder. 'This is a real *emergency*,' he said. 'Zero triggered the failsafe.' Ali was already at the door, her fingers moving fast over the exit panel.
emergency:0.cnHint: 警报声响起，灰鸦确认这是真正的____，零点已触发了保险装置。
emergency:0.hook: The exit panel sparked — and the door stayed shut.
emergency:0.line: 'Move — this *emergency* gives us less than four minutes.'

familiar:0.en: The smell hit me first — burnt wire and cold rain, a *familiar* mix I knew from the night Zero first crossed my path. We were inside the relay station beneath Pier Nine. Ali touched the wall and frowned. 'I have been here before,' she said. So had our enemy. The dust on the floor showed two sets of fresh footprints.
familiar:0.cnHint: 那股气味令我感到____，我们在九号码头的中继站里发现了两组新鲜脚印。
familiar:0.hook: One set of footprints led in — none led out.
familiar:0.line: 'This place is too *familiar* — Zero was here tonight.'

furthermore:0.en: Grey Crow laid out the plan in thirty seconds flat. We would cut the signal at the source, then pull the core drive before Zero could wipe it. '*Furthermore*,' he added, eyes on the door, 'Ali has the only key to the backup room — which means Zero will come for her next.' Ali did not look surprised.
furthermore:0.cnHint: 灰鸦说明计划后____补充道，零点的下一个目标就是阿栗。
furthermore:0.hook: A shadow moved under the door.
furthermore:0.line: '*Furthermore*, if we split up now, one of us won't return.'

hardly:0.en: I could *hardly* read the symbols on the central drive — they shifted every few seconds, a live cipher Zero had designed to burn itself on contact. Grey Crow stood back and said nothing. Ali leaned in close, her breath steady. 'I see the pattern,' she said quietly. My own hands were shaking.
hardly:0.cnHint: 中央硬盘上的符号不断变化，我____能辨认，而阿栗却冷静地发现了规律。
hardly:0.hook: Then the pattern changed — and Ali went still.
hardly:0.line: 'I can *hardly* keep the signal stable — hurry.'

hinder:0.en: Zero had planted a looped audio signal inside the relay box — a low pulse designed to *hinder* any attempt to decode the core drive. Every time Ali got close to a solution, the pulse spiked and the screen reset. Grey Crow pulled a thin wire from the box. 'Cut this,' he said, 'and we cut the noise.'
hinder:0.cnHint: 零点在中继箱内植入了音频信号，专门用来____阿栗的解码工作。
hinder:0.hook: Grey Crow cut the wire — and an alarm shrieked.
hinder:0.line: 'Don't let doubt *hinder* you — we finish this now.'

injury:0.en: Ali winced and pulled her hand back from the relay panel. A thin cut ran across her palm — a spring-loaded blade, hidden inside the casing. 'It's a small *injury*,' she said, wrapping her fingers in a strip of cloth. But Grey Crow's jaw was tight. A trapped panel meant Zero knew we were coming. The room felt smaller.
injury:0.cnHint: 阿栗触碰中继面板时被暗藏的刀片划伤，这点小小的____说明零点早已料到我们会来。
injury:0.hook: Grey Crow whispered: 'He left that blade for me.'

register:0.en: The basement smelled of burnt wire. Grey Crow pressed a cold panel; a soft chime sounded. 'You need to *register* your signal here,' he said, 'or the system treats you as a ghost.' I pressed my thumb to the glass. A name appeared — but it was not mine.
register:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要求调查员在地下室的终端上____身份，屏幕却显示出陌生的名字。
register:0.hook: Someone had already registered my face.
register:0.line: 'You must *register* your signal, or this door will never open for you.'

skin:0.en: Ali pulled back her sleeve under the blue lamp. A faint pattern glowed beneath her *skin* — a signal map, she said, burned in during the city blackout three years ago. 'Zero did this to me.' Her voice was flat. I said nothing. Outside, the rain came harder.
skin:0.cnHint: 阿里在灯下展示手臂，调查员看到她____下隐藏着一张信号地图。
skin:0.line: 'The signal is right under my *skin* — I have carried it for three years.'

spirit:0.en: The old server room was silent except for a low hum. Grey Crow touched the dusty rack. 'This machine kept the resistance alive,' he said quietly. 'Not the hardware — the *spirit* inside every broadcast.' I looked at the dead screens and tried to feel what he felt. I could not.
spirit:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在废弃服务器间告诉调查员，真正支撑抵抗运动的是那台机器所承载的____。
spirit:0.hook: Then one dead screen flickered on.
spirit:0.line: 'The hardware can die, but the *spirit* of that broadcast will never be erased.'

spread:0.en: Ali unrolled a paper map across the table — old tech, impossible to hack. Red lines marked every node. 'The signal *spread* from this building outward like roots,' she said, tracing a circle with her finger. 'Cut the center and the whole thing dies.' I stared at the circle. It covered our block.
spread:0.cnHint: 阿里在纸质地图上向调查员展示信号____的路径，起点就在他们所在的大楼。
spread:0.hook: The circle had a small mark — my apartment number.
spread:0.line: 'Watch how the signal *spread* from this single point to every corner of the city.'

totally:0.en: I ran the decryption program twice. Both times the output was the same string of names. Grey Crow leaned over my shoulder. 'You look *totally* lost,' he said. 'That is fine. Lost people ask the right questions.' He closed the screen before I could save the list. I reached for his arm.
totally:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在调查员破译名单时出现，随即关掉屏幕，让调查员____措手不及。
totally:0.hook: The list had included Grey Crow's own name.
totally:0.line: 'You look *totally* lost — good, that means you are finally seeing the truth.'

tree:0.en: The evidence board filled one wall. Each witness was a node, each link a branch. Grey Crow called it the *tree*. 'Every operation has one,' he said. 'Find the root and you find the order that started all of this.' I found the root. It was a name I recognized from my own files.
tree:0.cnHint: 灰鸦用"____"来描述整张证据关系图，调查员顺藤摸瓜找到了根节点。
tree:0.hook: The root name was someone I trusted.
tree:0.line: 'Every operation grows like a *tree* — trace it down and you will find the root.'

weigh:0.en: Two drives sat on the table. One held the city council records. One held the names of every informer. Ali looked at me. 'You have to *weigh* what you do next,' she said softly. 'One of these destroys the system. The other protects people like me.' I picked up both drives.
weigh:0.cnHint: 阿里让调查员____两个硬盘背后的代价，两个选择都可能改变很多人的命运。
weigh:0.hook: I had no intention of choosing only one.
weigh:0.line: 'Take your time and *weigh* every option — one wrong move and we all disappear.'

alive:0.en: The signal came back at midnight — a voice, clear and cold. Zero. 'Still *alive*, investigator?' The words echoed off the concrete walls. Grey Crow killed the speaker, but the voice seemed to stay in the air. Ali grabbed my hand. 'He knows where we are,' she said. The door handle turned slowly.
alive:0.cnHint: 零在午夜发来信号，嘲讽调查员还____，灰鸦关掉音箱后门把却开始转动。
alive:0.hook: None of us had touched that door.
alive:0.line: 'Still *alive*, investigator? I am almost disappointed you made it this far.'

anyway:0.en: The server room hummed with cold air. Zero had locked every exit. I had no key, no signal, no plan. But I moved *anyway*, sliding through the dark toward the faint glow of a terminal. Grey Crow's voice crackled in my earpiece: 'Keep going.'
anyway:0.cnHint: 所有出口都被封锁，调查员____向前走去。
anyway:0.hook: The terminal flickered — then showed my own face.
anyway:0.line: 'I have no map, but I move *anyway*.'

besides:0.en: The archive room smelled of burnt wire. I had cracked the first cipher. *Besides* the coded map on the table, a second message was pressed flat beneath it — older, handwritten, signed with a crow's feather. Grey Crow had been here before me.
besides:0.cnHint: 除了桌上的密文地图，调查员还发现了另一份____的旧信息。
besides:0.line: '*Besides* the map, there is one thing you missed.'

certainly:0.en: Zero stepped into the light. 'You found the room,' he said, almost calm. I kept my back to the wall. The door behind me had *certainly* been open thirty seconds ago. Now it was sealed. He had planned this long before I arrived.
certainly:0.cnHint: 调查员意识到，门____是被人故意锁上的。
certainly:0.hook: Zero smiled and held up my access card.
certainly:0.line: 'You are *certainly* brave — or very, very lost.'

challenging:0.en: Grey Crow laid out the final mission: reach the core node, plant the trace, get out in four minutes. The timing alone was *challenging*, but the node sat behind a live cipher wall that changed every ninety seconds. Ali looked at me. I looked at the clock.
challenging:0.cnHint: 最终任务的计时要求极具____性，让所有人都感到压力。
challenging:0.hook: The cipher wall shifted — forty seconds early.
challenging:0.line: 'This is the most *challenging* lock I have ever seen.'

circumstance:0.en: Under any other *circumstance* I would have waited for backup. But the signal was fading, the window was closing, and Ali was already inside. I pulled my coat tight and stepped through the service hatch into a corridor that smelled of old rain and ozone.
circumstance:0.cnHint: 在这种特殊的____下，调查员决定独自行动。
circumstance:0.hook: The hatch sealed behind me with a soft, final click.
circumstance:0.line: 'In this *circumstance*, waiting is the same as losing.'

comfort:0.en: Ali handed me a small folded note before I entered the restricted floor. I read it in the elevator. Three words from Grey Crow — nothing strategic, just quiet *comfort* for the moment ahead. I folded it back carefully and slipped it into my pocket.
comfort:0.cnHint: 在进入危险区域之前，调查员从一张纸条中得到了____。
comfort:0.hook: The elevator opened onto total darkness.
comfort:0.line: 'Take this — it is small *comfort*, but it is real.'

enrich:0.en: The stolen broadcast contained more than coordinates. Zero had hidden inside it a full language key — a cipher system designed to *enrich* the underground network's code by a hundred new signals. With this, they could hide entire conversations in plain air. We had to erase it.
enrich:0.cnHint: 零点藏在广播中的密码系统能____地下网络的通信能力。
enrich:0.line: 'This key will *enrich* their code beyond anything we know.'

collection:0.en: The back room smelled of dust and old circuitry. Grey Crow moved a rusted cabinet aside and revealed a *collection* of confiscated signal devices — each one tagged, dated, logged. 'Zero left these,' he said quietly. Every tag bore the same handwriting. Mine.
collection:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在密室里展示了一批被没收的信号装置，我认出了那笔迹。
collection:0.hook: Every tag was signed with my name.
collection:0.line: 'This *collection* did not gather itself — someone you trust built it.'

depression:0.en: Ali sat at the edge of the steel desk, staring at the dead monitor. 'It is not fear,' she said. 'It is a *depression* that settles in when you realize the system was never on our side.' I had nothing to offer. The room felt smaller than before.
depression:0.cnHint: 阿栗向我倾诉内心的____，我们都意识到这场战斗从一开始就不公平。
depression:0.hook: Then her earpiece crackled with Zero's voice.
depression:0.line: 'A *depression* like this means you finally see the truth.'

foot:0.en: The corridor was one *foot* wide at its narrowest point. I pressed sideways through the dark, one hand on the cold wall, listening for movement ahead. Grey Crow had marked this passage on the map with a single red line. He had also marked it: do not stop.
foot:0.cnHint: 我侧身挤过一条极窄的通道，灰鸦的地图上对此处有一个警告。
foot:0.hook: Something warm brushed past my ankle in the dark.
foot:0.line: 'One *foot* of space is enough — if you are not afraid.'

graduate:0.en: The file on the screen read: subject — urban systems *graduate*, recruited at twenty-two, went dark at twenty-four. I read it twice. The photograph matched the face I had seen in the market two hours ago. Ali leaned over my shoulder and said nothing for a long moment.
graduate:0.cnHint: 档案显示那个神秘人物是一名____，两小时前我曾在市场见过他。
graduate:0.hook: Ali finally whispered, 'I know that person.'
graduate:0.line: 'A *graduate* of that program answers to only one name: Zero.'

intake:0.en: The ventilation shaft hummed above us. 'The main air *intake* is directly above the server room,' Grey Crow said, pointing at the blueprint pinned to the wall. 'Cut the feed for thirty seconds and every guard in there loses focus.' Ali checked her timer. Thirty seconds was very short.
intake:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指出主____口的位置，计划靠它制造短暂混乱。
intake:0.line: 'Block the *intake* and the whole room goes quiet — for exactly thirty seconds.'

screen:0.en: A single *screen* flickered at the far end of the room, casting pale blue light across rows of empty chairs. On it, a countdown: four minutes. Grey Crow typed fast. 'The signal hides inside the broadcast,' he said. 'When the clock hits zero, every receiver in the city opens.'
screen:0.cnHint: 房间尽头的____上显示着倒计时，灰鸦正在争分夺秒地破解信号。
screen:0.hook: With two minutes left, the keyboard went dead.
screen:0.line: 'Watch the *screen* — when it flickers twice, run.'

chair:0.en: I pulled the single metal *chair* to the center of the room and sat facing the door. Zero's message had said to wait here. Alone. Grey Crow thought it was a trap. Ali thought it was a test. I thought both of them were right.
chair:0.cnHint: 我按照零点的指示独自坐在房间中央的____上等待，这可能是陷阱。
chair:0.hook: The lock clicked, and the door began to move.
chair:0.line: 'Stay in the *chair* — standing up is how they know you are afraid.'

court:0.en: The encrypted file was titled: internal *court* — session seven — sealed. Grey Crow broke the seal in under a minute. Inside: names, dates, verdicts handed down in secret. My own name appeared on page three. I had been judged without ever entering the room.
court:0.cnHint: 灰鸦破解了一份____密档，我在第三页发现了自己的名字。
court:0.hook: The verdict beside my name read: guilty.
court:0.line: 'A secret *court* left no record — except this one.'

egg:0.en: The lab was cold and silent. On the steel table sat a single glass case, and inside it — one pale *egg*, no bigger than a thumb. Grey Crow leaned close. 'This is what Zero has been hiding,' he said. 'One cell. One signal. The entire city encoded inside.' I felt sick.
egg:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在实验室里发现了一个藏有城市全部密码的____。
egg:0.hook: The case had already been opened from the inside.
egg:0.line: 'That *egg* holds every secret Zero ever buried,' Grey Crow whispered.

hire:0.en: Ali slid a thin card across the table. 'They didn't kidnap me,' she said quietly. 'It was a *hire*. Someone paid to bring me into this room on this exact night.' The overhead light buzzed. I looked at the card — my own name was printed on it as the one who placed the order.
hire:0.cnHint: 阿里透露自己来到这里是一次有人付钱安排的____，而那个人竟是我。
hire:0.hook: My signature was already on the contract.
hire:0.line: 'A *hire* like this doesn't happen without someone at the top,' Ali said.

aid:0.en: The signal was breaking apart. I pressed the receiver hard against my ear, searching for Grey Crow's voice in the static. Then Ali grabbed my wrist and held up a small device. 'Here,' she said. With her *aid*, the frequency locked. The message came through — short, cold, final.
aid:0.cnHint: 在阿里的____下，我终于锁定了频率，听到了那条令人不寒而栗的信息。
aid:0.hook: Grey Crow's voice said only: 'Don't trust the door.'
aid:0.line: 'Without your *aid*, that signal would have died,' I told Ali.

bill:0.en: A single *bill* was pinned to the inside of the locker door — old paper money, edges burned. On its face, someone had written a string of numbers in red ink. Grey Crow said those numbers matched the city's master lock code. Zero had hidden the key in plain sight, in a piece of paper everyone ignores.
bill:0.cnHint: 一张旧____上写着的数字，竟是整座城市主锁的密码。
bill:0.line: 'This *bill* is worth more than money tonight,' Grey Crow said flatly.

paint:0.en: The back wall of the control room was covered in layers of old *paint*, grey over grey over grey. Ali ran her fingers along a seam. The top layer peeled back like skin, and beneath it was a map — every tunnel, every exit, every blind spot in Harbor City — drawn years ago by someone who knew we would come.
paint:0.cnHint: 控制室墙壁的____下藏着一张详尽的城市地图，似乎早有人预料到我们会来。
paint:0.hook: One tunnel on the map led straight to Zero's last known room.
paint:0.line: 'Peel the *paint* — the real map is underneath,' Ali said.

bean:0.en: On the small table sat a cold cup of tea and a single dried *bean* — a street signal I had not seen in three years. It meant: someone was here one hour ago and left this for me on purpose. Grey Crow had taught me that code. Which meant Grey Crow himself had been in this room.
bean:0.cnHint: 桌上一粒干____是街头暗号，说明灰鸦一小时前曾在这个房间里。
bean:0.hook: His coat was still hanging on the chair.
bean:0.line: 'One *bean* — that's Grey Crow's oldest warning sign,' Ali said.

birthday:0.en: The encrypted file was locked behind a personal key. I tried every date I knew. Then Ali said, very quietly, 'Try Zero's *birthday*.' I paused. 'How do you know it?' She didn't answer. I typed the date. The file opened. Thousands of names filled the screen — and mine was at the top.
birthday:0.cnHint: 用零点的____作为密钥，加密文件打开了，而我的名字赫然排在名单最前面。
birthday:0.hook: Ali already knew what we would find inside.
birthday:0.line: 'Zero's *birthday* is the only key that opens this,' Ali said quietly.

flight:0.en: The last elevator was already moving — up, not down. Grey Crow had taken it. I found the schedule pinned to the wall: one *flight* out of Harbor City, departing from the roof in eleven minutes. Ali looked at me. We had no clearance, no tickets, no plan. We had exactly eleven minutes to stop him.
flight:0.cnHint: 灰鸦已经出发，屋顶有一趟____将在十一分钟后离开这座城市。
flight:0.hook: The elevator doors opened — and the roof was already on fire.
flight:0.line: 'That *flight* leaves with or without our permission,' Ali said.

housing:0.en: The briefing room smelled of cold coffee and old maps. Grey Crow spread a city grid across the table. 'Every *housing* block in the east quarter is a front,' he said quietly. 'Zero does not live in any of them. He operates beneath them.'
housing:0.cnHint: 灰鸦向我展示东区地图，指出每一栋____背后都藏着秘密。
housing:0.hook: Something moved in the vent above our heads.
housing:0.line: 'Every *housing* block on this map is a lie.'

behaviour:0.en: Ali pulled up the security feed on her small screen. We watched Zero cross the lobby three times in one hour, always the same path, same pause at the second pillar. 'Study his *behaviour*,' Ali said. 'People repeat patterns when they think no one is watching.'
behaviour:0.cnHint: 阿栗要我仔细观察零点的____，因为习惯会出卖一个人。
behaviour:0.hook: On the fourth pass, Zero looked straight at the camera.
behaviour:0.line: 'His *behaviour* tonight is different — he knows we are here.'

husband:0.en: The woman at the desk did not look up when I entered. A framed photo sat beside her keyboard: a man in a grey coat, smiling. Grey Crow leaned close to my ear. 'Her *husband* works for Zero,' he whispered. 'She is the real source.'
husband:0.cnHint: 档案室的女人看似普通，但她的____却与零点有关联。
husband:0.hook: She slowly closed her hand over the photo.
husband:0.line: 'My *husband* left this building six hours ago and never came back.'

tourist:0.en: I wore a light jacket and carried a paper map, playing the part. 'Act like a *tourist*,' Grey Crow had told me. 'Lost, slow, harmless.' The lobby of the signal tower was busy. No one checked my bag. I found the service door in under a minute.
tourist:0.cnHint: 为了混入信号塔，我假扮成一名____，顺利找到了隐藏的通道。
tourist:0.hook: A guard turned and began walking directly toward me.
tourist:0.line: 'A *tourist* in this block after midnight — Zero will notice.'

agent:0.en: The file on the table had no name on the cover, only a number. Grey Crow tapped it twice. 'This *agent* has been inside Zero's network for two years,' he said. 'Tonight that cover breaks.' I opened the file. The face inside was someone I recognised.
agent:0.cnHint: 灰鸦给我看一份绝密档案，里面记录着一名潜伏已久的____的信息。
agent:0.hook: The face in the file was Ali.
agent:0.line: 'An *agent* who stays too long always starts to forget which side they are on.'

cash:0.en: The drop point was a narrow room behind a laundry. A bag sat on the floor, unzipped. Ali crouched and counted fast. 'Enough *cash* to buy silence from half the city block,' she said flatly. 'Zero was not running a mission. He was running an exit.'
cash:0.cnHint: 我们在藏匿点发现了大量____，这说明零点根本不是在执行任务，而是在准备逃跑。
cash:0.hook: The bag was still warm, as if someone had just set it down.
cash:0.line: 'This much *cash* means he is already gone — we are too late.'

competition:0.en: Grey Crow set two decoded files side by side under the lamp. 'There is no *competition* between the two factions,' he said, his voice flat. 'They merged three weeks ago. Everything we thought we knew about their conflict was planted for us to find.' The room went very quiet.
competition:0.cnHint: 灰鸦发现两个对立势力之间的____根本是假象，真相让人震惊。
competition:0.hook: If the conflict was fake, then our entire operation was a trap.
competition:0.line: 'The *competition* you tracked for months was a story they wrote for you.'

farmer:0.en: The old man in the holding room wore mud on his boots and said nothing for an hour. Grey Crow passed me a note: 'Not a *farmer*. Look at his hands.' I looked. The calluses were in the wrong places — not from a tool, but from a keyboard used for years.
farmer:0.cnHint: 审讯室里这个看似____的老人，手上的茧子却出卖了他真实的身份。
farmer:0.hook: He smiled at me as if he had been waiting for that moment.
farmer:0.line: 'I have not been a *farmer* for a very long time, young investigator.'

burn:0.en: Inside the server vault, the air smelled of melted wire. Grey Crow pointed at my left wrist — a red mark from the signal cable I had grabbed too fast. 'That *burn* won't fade,' he said quietly. 'Neither will what you saw on that screen.'
burn:0.cnHint: 在服务器室里，我手腕上的____让引路人停下了脚步。
burn:0.hook: The screen still glowed, showing a name I recognized.
burn:0.line: 'That *burn* is your first honest mark in this city.'

cook:0.en: The safe room smelled like old noodles. Ali crouched over a small burner, stirring something grey and thick. 'I can *cook* under any condition,' she said without turning around. On the wall behind her, a map of Harbor City's underground grid was pinned with red markers.
cook:0.cnHint: 阿栗在藏身处____食物，但墙上的地图暗示她心里装着更大的计划。
cook:0.hook: One red marker pulsed — it was moving.
cook:0.line: 'I can *cook* a meal or a plan — tonight you need both.'

corporate:0.en: The badge on the door read NEXLINK. Grey Crow traced the silver letters with one finger. 'Every signal in this block runs through one *corporate* hub,' he said. 'Cut it and the whole grid goes blind.' I stared at the lock. We had four minutes.
corporate:0.cnHint: 引路人解释说，整栋楼的信号都由一个____中心控制。
corporate:0.hook: Four minutes became three before I finished breathing.
corporate:0.line: 'One *corporate* hub — one cut, and they lose their eyes.'

dangerous:0.en: Zero's voice came through the earpiece, low and steady. 'The frequency you are chasing is *dangerous* — not because it carries a weapon, but because it carries the truth.' The lights in the relay room flickered once. Ali grabbed my sleeve and pulled me toward the back wall.
dangerous:0.cnHint: 零点警告我，那个频率之所以____，是因为它承载着真相。
dangerous:0.hook: The lights died, and something behind the wall began to hum.
dangerous:0.line: 'The truth is more *dangerous* than any signal I have cracked.'

debt:0.en: Grey Crow dropped a data chip on the table between us. 'This clears my *debt* to you,' he said, voice flat. The chip contained three years of hidden transmissions — enough to bring down the network we had been hunting. I picked it up. It felt too light for what it held.
debt:0.cnHint: 引路人用一枚数据芯片偿还了他欠我的____。
debt:0.hook: Something in his eyes said the debt was not really cleared.
debt:0.line: 'Take it — my *debt* to you ends here, in this room.'

discipline:0.en: The training hall on the fourth floor was silent at midnight. Grey Crow stood at the far end, running the same hand signal sequence for the hundredth time. 'Signal work is a *discipline*,' he said when he heard me enter. 'Get one step wrong and the message dies.'
discipline:0.cnHint: 引路人告诉我，信号破译是一门需要严格训练的____。
discipline:0.hook: Then he showed me the step I had been getting wrong all week.
discipline:0.line: '*Discipline* is the only thing standing between you and silence.'

error:0.en: The decryption bar hit ninety-nine percent and stopped. Ali leaned closer to the screen. 'One *error* in the final key block,' she said, fingers already moving. Somewhere above us, boots crossed the ceiling. We had found the mistake, but the clock had not stopped to let us fix it.
error:0.cnHint: 解密进行到最后一步时，阿栗发现了一个致命的____。
error:0.hook: The boots above us paused — directly over our heads.
error:0.line: 'One *error* in the key and three years of work turns to dust.'

gym:0.en: The address led us to a converted *gym* on the east side of the building — rubber floors, dead lights, and rows of old lockers. Zero had used the space as a dead-drop point. Ali found the locker marked with a small scratch. Inside, a single folded note waited in the dark.
gym:0.cnHint: 线索把我们引到了一间改建过的____，零点曾在此留下暗语。
gym:0.hook: The note had only two words, and one of them was my name.
gym:0.line: 'Every *gym* in this city hides a secret — this one hides mine.'

salary:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Grey Crow's hideout. I found the payroll file — every agent's *salary* listed in plain code, enough to buy silence or loyalty. Someone had been skimming funds for months. The numbers pointed to one name I recognized.
salary:0.cnHint: 我在服务器室发现了工资档案，某人一直在从中____，指向一个熟悉的名字。
salary:0.hook: The name on the screen was Ali's.
salary:0.line: 'My *salary* stopped three months ago — someone is stealing from us.'

shopping:0.en: The underground market looked like a normal *shopping* district — bright signs, loud vendors, packed aisles. But every item carried a second price: information. Grey Crow moved fast between stalls, slipping me a data chip without breaking stride. Nobody looked our way.
shopping:0.cnHint: 在地下____区，灰鸦神不知鬼不觉地将一枚数据芯片塞进了我的手里。
shopping:0.hook: The chip was warm — someone had just pulled it from a live machine.
shopping:0.line: 'This *shopping* street is a cover — every vendor reports to Zero.'

tendency:0.en: Zero had one flaw: a *tendency* to leave a single clue behind, as if daring someone to follow. Grey Crow had mapped every scene and found the pattern. I stared at the wall of evidence and finally saw what she meant. It was almost a signature.
tendency:0.cnHint: 灰鸦分析了零点留下线索的____，我终于在证据墙上看出了规律。
tendency:0.hook: Every clue led to the same locked room on Level Nine.
tendency:0.line: 'His *tendency* to show off will be the thing that ends him.'

tough:0.en: The encrypted vault door resisted every tool Ali brought. 'This one is *tough*,' he muttered, sweat on his jaw. I held the light steady while he worked. Outside, boots echoed on wet concrete, getting closer with each second.
tough:0.cnHint: 保险库的门极其____，阿栗正在费力破解，而门外的脚步声越来越近。
tough:0.hook: The lock clicked open just as the shadow reached the door.
tough:0.line: 'It is *tough*, but I have cracked worse — give me sixty seconds.'

tour:0.en: The building's security system ran a slow automated *tour* of every floor, camera by camera. Grey Crow had memorized the cycle. We had forty seconds between sweeps. I followed her through the dark corridor, counting under my breath, heartbeat loud in my ears.
tour:0.cnHint: 灰鸦记住了摄像头____的规律，我们只有四十秒穿越走廊。
tour:0.hook: At thirty-nine seconds, a light we had not expected flickered on.
tour:0.line: 'The camera *tour* resets at midnight — that is our only window.'
