wake:0.en: In the *wake* of the failed broadcast, the control room fell completely silent. Screens showed only static. Grey Crow stood at the center console, unmoving, her eyes reading something invisible. Ali touched my arm. We both knew: the silence was a message.
wake:0.cnHint: 广播失败的____中，控制室陷入死寂，灰鸦似乎从静默中读出了什么。
wake:0.hook: Then one screen lit up, showing our own faces.
wake:0.line: 'In the *wake* of this, Zero knows exactly where we are.'

annual:0.en: The *annual* system audit was scheduled for midnight — every log wiped, every trace erased. We had twenty minutes before Zero's people used it to vanish forever. I pulled the backup cable from the wall while Grey Crow held the door. Time compressed to nothing.
annual:0.cnHint: 系统的____审计将在午夜清除所有记录，我们只有二十分钟阻止零点的人消失。
annual:0.hook: The progress bar hit ninety percent before I yanked the last wire.
annual:0.line: 'The *annual* wipe starts now — if we miss it, they walk free.'

charity:0.en: The donation logs listed a *charity* that did not exist — no address, no record, only money flowing in and out like breath. Grey Crow traced the account to a server three floors above us. Zero had hidden his operation inside a ghost foundation for years.
charity:0.cnHint: 捐款记录中有一个不存在的____机构，灰鸦将其追踪到了楼上的服务器。
charity:0.hook: The foundation's registration date matched the day Zero disappeared.
charity:0.line: 'This so-called *charity* has moved more money than the city budget.'

female:0.en: The signal map lit up three nodes. Grey Crow pointed to the center dot. 'That *female* contact runs the whole grid from inside Lab Seven.' I stared at the pulsing light. Ali leaned close and whispered, 'She has been feeding us false data for weeks.'
female:0.cnHint: 灰鸦指出，那个____联络人从七号实验室内部控制着整个信息网络。
female:0.hook: The dot blinked once, then went dark forever.
female:0.line: 'That *female* contact is the one who built this trap,' Grey Crow said.

holiday:0.en: The server room hummed in the dead silence of a long *holiday* weekend. No guards. No cleaners. Just Ali and me, crouched behind cold racks of blinking machines. Grey Crow had chosen this window on purpose. The whole city was asleep, drunk on festival lights outside.
holiday:0.cnHint: 灰鸦故意选在____期间行动，因为整栋楼几乎没有人。
holiday:0.hook: Then the door handle turned, slow and deliberate.
holiday:0.line: 'The *holiday* bought us four hours — do not waste them,' Grey Crow said.

pain:0.en: I pressed my palm against the cracked screen and felt a sharp *pain* shoot up my arm. Ali grabbed my wrist. 'Stop. The panel is wired.' Grey Crow watched from the doorway, arms crossed. The warning had come one second too late, and the alarm clock was already running.
pain:0.cnHint: 触碰那块屏幕让我感到一阵____，阿栗这才告诉我面板上有陷阱。
pain:0.hook: Somewhere below us, a door slammed open.
pain:0.line: 'Push through the *pain* — we have forty seconds left,' Ali said.

player:0.en: Zero stood at the center console, calm as ice. Grey Crow had warned me: 'He is not a simple enemy. He is a *player* who has run this game longer than you have been alive.' I understood now. Every move we had made tonight, Zero had already seen it coming.
player:0.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我，零点是个老练的____，我们的每一步他都早有预料。
player:0.hook: Zero smiled and pressed a single key.
player:0.line: 'Every *player* in this room is already inside my plan,' Zero said.

production:0.en: The factory floor stretched out below the glass walkway. Ali read from the stolen file: 'Illegal *production* of signal jammers, two thousand units a month, all shipped under food labels.' Grey Crow said nothing. He just stared at the rows of machines below, jaw tight, eyes cold.
production:0.cnHint: 从窃取的文件中，阿栗发现了非法____信号干扰器的证据。
production:0.hook: One of the machines below us suddenly switched off.
production:0.line: 'Shut down the *production* line before the next shift arrives,' Grey Crow said.

secure:0.en: Ali worked fast, fingers dancing across the stolen keypad. 'I need two minutes to make this channel *secure*,' she said. I stood at the door, watching the dark hall. Grey Crow had gone silent in my earpiece. Outside, rain beat hard against the high windows of the building.
secure:0.cnHint: 阿栗需要两分钟来让通讯频道____，而我在门口紧张地盯着走廊。
secure:0.hook: Her fingers stopped, and the screen turned red.
secure:0.line: 'Nothing is *secure* in this building — trust nothing,' Grey Crow said.

audience:0.en: The hidden broadcast had an *audience* of thousands across Harbor City, all tuned to a frequency the government had banned. Grey Crow said the message was coded inside static. I sat alone in the relay room, listening hard, trying to pull the real words out of the noise.
audience:0.cnHint: 这段隐秘广播拥有数千名____，频率本身已被政府列为禁止使用。
audience:0.hook: Then the static stopped, and a voice said my name.
audience:0.line: 'The *audience* out there is waiting — send the signal now,' Ali said.

borrow:0.en: 'I need to *borrow* your clearance card for exactly ninety seconds,' I told Ali. She pulled it from her collar, eyes sharp. 'If you lose it, we are both dead.' I nodded, slipped into the side corridor, and moved fast toward the locked archive at the end of the hall.
borrow:0.cnHint: 我向阿栗____她的通行卡，只需九十秒，但代价是两人共同承担风险。
borrow:0.hook: The archive light turned green, then the footsteps came.
borrow:0.line: '*Borrow* it, copy nothing, and bring it back in one piece,' Ali said.

mile:0.en: Grey Crow spread the city map across the cold server room floor. 'The signal repeats every *mile* along the old rail line,' he said, tracing a red path with one finger. I counted six marked points. Six drops. Six chances to find Zero before the blackout hit Harbor City.
mile:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在服务器室地图上标出信号每隔____出现一次的位置。
mile:0.hook: The sixth point was right beneath our feet.
mile:0.line: 'The signal moves one *mile* at a time — Zero is leading us somewhere.'

movement:0.en: Ali pressed her back against the archive shelf and held her breath. On the monitor, a single dot pulsed. 'There — *movement* in sublevel three,' she whispered. I watched the dot drift slow and steady, like something that knew we were watching. Zero never moved without a reason.
movement:0.cnHint: 监控画面中，阿栗发现地下三层出现了____。
movement:0.hook: The dot stopped — directly outside our door.
movement:0.line: 'That *movement* is too calm — Zero wants us to follow.'

party:0.en: The banned *party* had used this basement print shop for years, Grey Crow told me, running his hand along ink-stained walls. Their coded pamphlets were still stacked in the corner, words hidden inside words. Zero had learned the craft here. So had I, once, before I chose a different side.
party:0.cnHint: 灰鸦介绍说，这个地下印刷室曾是某个被禁____的据点。
party:0.hook: One pamphlet on the top of the stack had my name on it.
party:0.line: 'This *party* wrote in code long before hacking existed.'

rescue:0.en: The call came through a broken speaker in the ceiling — Ali's voice, clipped and urgent. '*Rescue* — sublevel two — now.' I had thirty seconds before the corridor cameras cycled back on. Grey Crow blocked the door. I ran. The word she had used was not standard protocol; it was our private signal for a trap.
rescue:0.cnHint: 阿栗发出____信号，但灰鸦提醒我那是一个暗语陷阱。
rescue:0.hook: I was already halfway down the stairs.
rescue:0.line: 'If she said *rescue*, she means the opposite — stop!'

writing:0.en: I found the message scratched into the steel desk with something sharp. The *writing* was small and tight, each letter pressed hard, the way someone writes when they know time is short. It read: ZERO WAS HERE FIRST. Ali leaned over my shoulder and said nothing. The dust around the desk had not been touched in days.
writing:0.cnHint: 钢桌上有人留下了____，内容令我和阿栗陷入沉默。
writing:0.hook: The sharp tool used to write it was still warm.
writing:0.line: 'This *writing* — he left it for you, not for us.'

bite:0.en: The ration bar had been sitting on the console since morning. I finally took a *bite*, and the moment my guard dropped, the room's lights cut to red. Emergency mode. Ali spun toward the door. Grey Crow was already at the terminal, fingers moving fast. Zero had been waiting for exactly this pause.
bite:0.cnHint: 我只是吃了一口食物的功夫，整个房间就切换成了紧急模式。
bite:0.hook: Grey Crow typed one word on the screen: 'Late.'
bite:0.line: 'One *bite* and you handed him the window he needed.'

capture:0.en: 'We need to *capture* the broadcast before it loops,' Ali said, hands locked on the relay board. The signal was rolling through seven encrypted layers, each one peeling back like old paint. I fed her the key sequence Grey Crow had given me. The room hummed. The last layer broke open and Zero's voice poured out, cold and clear.
capture:0.cnHint: 阿栗全力____这段加密广播，零点的声音终于从层层密码中透出来。
capture:0.hook: Zero's first word was my real name.
capture:0.line: 'We *capture* this signal now, or we lose him for good.'

cope:0.en: The system ran seventeen alerts at once and I froze. Ali grabbed my arm. 'You have to *cope* — pick one signal and follow it.' Grey Crow had trained me for this, but training and the real thing are different rooms entirely. I breathed. I picked the strongest pulse. Everything else went quiet in my head.
cope:0.cnHint: 面对同时涌来的十七条警报，我必须____，阿栗提醒我专注一个信号。
cope:0.hook: The signal I chose led straight to Zero's last known location.
cope:0.line: '*Cope* with the noise — one thread is all we need.'

strength:0.en: The command post was a gutted office on the forty-third floor. Maps covered every wall. Grey Crow pointed to the eastern grid. 'Zero has doubled his *strength* in the port sector,' he said, voice flat. I counted the red markers. We were outnumbered three to one.
strength:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在指挥室里分析地图，指出对手在港口区的____已经翻倍。
strength:0.hook: Three to one — and Grey Crow was smiling.
strength:0.line: 'His *strength* in the port sector doubled overnight — we move at dawn.'

survive:0.en: The server vault smelled of burnt wires. Ali pulled me behind a rack as the ceiling cam swept past. 'Only the data that Zero wants will *survive* the wipe,' she whispered. The progress bar on the terminal read sixty-two percent. We had four minutes.
survive:0.cnHint: 在服务器室里，阿栗告诉我只有零点想要的数据能____这次清除。
survive:0.hook: The bar hit eighty — and the door lock clicked open.
survive:0.line: 'Only his chosen files will *survive* the wipe — we grab them first.'

touch:0.en: Grey Crow slid an old data chip across the table without a word. I picked it up. The moment of *touch* sent a faint signal through my implant — hidden code, layered under the plastic. Someone had buried a message inside the chip itself. Someone who knew I would find it.
touch:0.cnHint: 我拿起数据芯片的瞬间，那一____触发了植入体中隐藏的信号。
touch:0.hook: The hidden name on the chip was mine.
touch:0.line: 'One *touch* and your implant reads what Zero could not erase.'

trap:0.en: The elevator doors opened onto a silent floor. Every light was on. Ali grabbed my arm. 'This is a *trap*,' she said softly. The exits were already sealed — I could see the red lock icons blinking above each door. Zero had known our route before we had chosen it.
trap:0.cnHint: 阿栗意识到这层楼是一个____，所有出口已经被封锁。
trap:0.hook: Behind us, the elevator doors slid shut forever.
trap:0.line: 'It is a *trap* — Zero knew our route before we did.'

tv:0.en: The waiting room had one cracked *tv* bolted to the wall. It showed nothing but static — until a face cut through the noise. Zero looked straight at the camera, straight at me. 'I know you are watching,' he said. Ali reached for the plug. I stopped her hand.
tv:0.cnHint: 候客室里的____突然显示出零点的脸，他直视镜头说他知道有人在看。
tv:0.hook: The screen went dark — then the static spelled out my name.
tv:0.line: 'Leave the *tv* on — every word he says is evidence.'

victim:0.en: Grey Crow opened the case file on the desk. A single photograph. A woman I did not know. 'She was the first *victim*,' he said quietly, 'before any of us understood what Zero was building.' The timestamp on the photo was three years ago. I had been in this city three years.
victim:0.cnHint: 灰鸦展示了第一位____的照片，时间戳让我感到不安。
victim:0.hook: The date on the photo matched the day I arrived.
victim:0.line: 'She was the first *victim* — and Zero made sure no one reported it.'

zone:0.en: The basement was divided by yellow tape into sections. Ali called the middle section the dead *zone* — no signal, no cameras, no record of anyone who stepped inside. Grey Crow had chosen it for that reason. We spread the plans across the floor and spoke in low, careful voices.
zone:0.cnHint: 地下室中央是一个信号盲____，灰鸦特意选在这里布置计划。
zone:0.hook: Then Ali's scanner picked up a single, impossible ping.
zone:0.line: 'Stay in the *zone* — one step out and Zero hears everything.'

afraid:0.en: I stood at the door of Zero's empty office. Every drawer had been pulled open, every screen wiped. Ali spoke from behind me. 'Are you *afraid*?' she asked. I thought about it honestly. 'Not of him,' I said. 'Of what we find next.' She nodded and stepped inside.
afraid:0.cnHint: 面对零点已清空的办公室，阿栗问我是否____，我说我怕的不是他本人。
afraid:0.hook: Inside the last drawer lay a key with my apartment number.
afraid:0.line: 'I am not *afraid* of Zero — I am afraid of what he planned for us.'

couple:0.en: The safe house smelled of cold coffee. A *couple* of burned data chips lay on the table — Zero had been here. Ali pressed her back to the wall. 'He cleared everything,' she whispered. I scanned the room: two chairs, two cups, two exits. Someone had shared this space.
couple:0.cnHint: 安全屋里，我们发现零点留下的痕迹，桌上有一____已损毁的芯片。
couple:0.line: 'A *couple* of hours ago, someone sat right where you are standing.'

definition:0.en: Grey Crow pulled up the old city charter on a cracked wall screen. 'Read the *definition* of a restricted zone,' he said quietly. The words were sharp, precise — and they drew a line straight through the building we were standing in. We had no legal right to be here.
definition:0.cnHint: 灰鸦让我读限制区的____，我们才意识到自己正身处违禁地带。
definition:0.hook: The door lock clicked — from the outside.
definition:0.line: 'The *definition* is clear: anyone inside after midnight is a target.'

imagination:0.en: Zero's hideout looked ordinary — bare walls, a folding chair, a single dim light. But Grey Crow said, 'Use your *imagination*.' I looked again: chalk marks on the floor, a mirror angled at the vent, wires taped flat under the rug. The ordinary room was a listening machine.
imagination:0.cnHint: 这间空屋看似普通，灰鸦让我发挥____，我才发现隐藏的监听装置。
imagination:0.hook: The mirror moved — and nothing had touched it.
imagination:0.line: 'Without *imagination*, you will never see what Zero actually built here.'

journey:0.en: The file on the table mapped every step I had taken since day one. My *journey* through Harbor City — every signal I had followed, every door I had opened — was recorded in cold blue ink. Someone had been tracking me the whole time. I felt the walls tighten.
journey:0.cnHint: 桌上的档案记录了我在城市中的整段____，说明我从未摆脱监视。
journey:0.hook: My own name was circled in red at the end.
journey:0.line: 'Your *journey* was never an investigation — it was a test.'

nearby:0.en: The power went out. I stood still, listening. A *nearby* server rack hummed — steady, alive, unaffected by the blackout. That rack was running on a separate line. Ali found the cable: it ran under the floor toward the east wall and kept going. Somewhere beyond it, something was waiting.
nearby:0.cnHint: 停电之后，____一台服务器仍在运转，引导我们发现了隐藏的线路。
nearby:0.hook: The cable was still warm under my hand.
nearby:0.line: 'That *nearby* rack is the only thing in this building Zero never touched.'

perspective:0.en: Grey Crow taped four photographs to the wall. 'Change your *perspective*,' he said. Seen separately, each photo showed a random street corner. Seen together, they formed a single map — and at the center was a building no city record acknowledged. Ali circled it in silence.
perspective:0.cnHint: 灰鸦让我换一个____，四张照片拼在一起竟指向一栋无记录的建筑。
perspective:0.hook: The building's address matched the one burned into the last chip.
perspective:0.line: 'From my *perspective*, Zero has been leading us here from the very beginning.'

requirement:0.en: The encrypted door had one *requirement*: a voice print recorded before the city banned private channels. Grey Crow reached into his coat and drew out a small player. 'I kept it,' he said. The red light above the door turned green. Some old habits, it turns out, are lifelines.
requirement:0.cnHint: 这扇加密门只有一个____：一段被禁止的声纹录音，而灰鸦恰好保存着它。
requirement:0.hook: Behind the door came a sound — steady, rhythmic, breathing.
requirement:0.line: 'The only *requirement* is a voice the city tried very hard to erase.'

signal:0.en: Zero sat at the far end of the room, back to us, hands on a console. Without turning, he raised one finger and *signaled* us to stop. Every screen in the room went dark at once. Then, in the silence, a single frequency tone rang out — clean, sharp, final. The game had changed.
signal:0.cnHint: 零点背对着我们，用一个手势向我们____，随后所有屏幕同时熄灭。
signal:0.hook: The tone was a countdown — and we had no idea from what.
signal:0.line: 'I *signaled* you to stop because the next step cannot be taken back.'

behave:0.en: Inside the signal lab, Grey Crow watched the data streams with cold eyes. 'You need to understand something,' he said quietly. 'Every agent we send in must *behave* as if they belong there — no sudden moves, no fear in the eyes. Zero is watching the feeds.' I nodded and fixed my face into calm.
behave:0.cnHint: 灰鸦警告我，在敌方基地里必须____得像个自己人。
behave:0.hook: But my hands were already shaking.
behave:0.line: '*Behave* like you own the room, or Zero will spot you in seconds.'

cent:0.en: The server room smelled of burnt wiring. Ali cracked open a hidden wall panel and pulled out a small tin box. Inside lay a single coin — one *cent*, old and scratched, with a micro-chip sealed under the metal. 'This is what Zero paid someone to betray us,' Ali said, voice flat. 'One cent.'
cent:0.cnHint: 阿栗在隐藏的铁盒里发现了一枚刻有芯片的____，那是出卖我们的代价。
cent:0.hook: The name on the chip was mine.
cent:0.line: 'They sold your life for one *cent* and a clean escape route.'

commercial:0.en: Grey Crow pulled up a screen in the back room. On it looped a bright *commercial* for a Harbor City energy drink — smiling faces, loud music, fake sky. 'It looks like an ad,' he said. 'It is not. Zero hides his orders inside the audio track. Thirty seconds of noise, one second of signal.'
commercial:0.cnHint: 那条看似普通的____其实藏着零点发给手下的指令。
commercial:0.hook: I hit play, and the signal screamed.
commercial:0.line: 'That *commercial* has run four hundred times today — four hundred orders delivered.'

death:0.en: The archive room was silent and cold. I found the file under a loose floor tile — a thin folder marked only with a date. Inside was a list of names. Mine was third. Ali put a hand on my shoulder. 'This is Zero's *death* list,' she said. 'Everyone on it disappears within a week.'
death:0.cnHint: 档案室的文件夹里藏着零点的____名单，我的名字赫然在列。
death:0.hook: The date beside my name was tomorrow.
death:0.line: 'A *death* list with your name on it is not a warning — it is a deadline.'

escape:0.en: The corridor lights cut out. In the dark, I heard boots on metal stairs — Zero's team, moving fast. Ali grabbed my arm and pulled me toward a narrow vent in the wall. 'This is our only *escape*,' she whispered. The vent was barely wide enough for one person. We had maybe thirty seconds.
escape:0.cnHint: 断电后，阿栗找到了一条唯一的____通道，但时间所剩无几。
escape:0.hook: Behind us, the door lock beeped once.
escape:0.line: 'Our *escape* runs through that vent — move now or we stay forever.'

expose:0.en: Grey Crow spread the documents across the table in the dim room. Photos, logs, transaction records — months of quiet work. 'Tonight we *expose* Zero's network to the city council,' he said. 'Every hidden line, every bought official.' Ali looked at the stack and let out a slow breath. 'He will not let that happen.'
expose:0.cnHint: 灰鸦准备向市议会____零点的地下网络，但风险极大。
expose:0.hook: A red light blinked on Grey Crow's comm device.
expose:0.line: 'We *expose* him tonight, or he buries us before morning.'

floor:0.en: The signal came from below. I pressed my ear to the cold *floor* of the monitoring room and heard it — a low, steady hum, like a machine counting down. Ali checked the building plans on her wrist screen. 'There is a hidden level under this one,' she said. 'It is not on any map.'
floor:0.cnHint: 我趴在____上听到了来自下方的倒计时声，那一层根本不在地图上。
floor:0.hook: The hum grew louder by the second.
floor:0.line: 'Put your ear to the *floor* — tell me if you hear what I hear.'

foundation:0.en: Ali cracked the encrypted file at last. Inside was a blueprint — not of a building, but of a system. 'This is the *foundation* of Zero's whole operation,' she said, eyes wide. 'Every coded channel, every hidden agent, every safe house — it all runs on this single framework.' I stared at the screen. One delete key. That was all it would take.
foundation:0.cnHint: 阿栗破解的文件揭示了零点整个行动的____，牵一发而动全身。
foundation:0.hook: Then the screen flashed a warning: 'File access detected.'
foundation:0.line: 'Destroy this *foundation* and his entire network falls apart in minutes.'

persuade:0.en: The briefing room smelled of cold coffee and old fear. Grey Crow spread the decoded map across the steel table. 'Zero will never talk,' Ali said. I had to *persuade* the team that silence itself was a confession — every blank space on that map was a hidden door.
persuade:0.cnHint: 我努力____队员们，地图上的空白处正是敌人藏身之所。
persuade:0.hook: One blank space began to pulse with a faint red light.
persuade:0.line: 'I can *persuade* them — trust the map, not your fear.'

preference:0.en: Grey Crow offered two routes into the server vault: the east corridor, loud and fast, or the west shaft, slow and dark. Ali had a clear *preference* for speed. I studied both paths, knowing Zero would have studied them too, and chosen neither.
preference:0.cnHint: 面对两条路线，阿栗表现出明显的____，但我心存疑虑。
preference:0.hook: A third door, unmarked, stood at the end of the hall.
preference:0.line: 'My *preference* means nothing if Zero already knows our move.'

reliable:0.en: Every data node in Harbor City lied at least once. Grey Crow was the only *reliable* source I had — his decoded signals never carried false echoes. I fed his latest intercept into the terminal. The output made the room go very quiet.
reliable:0.cnHint: 在这座充满谎言的城市里，灰鸦是我唯一____的情报来源。
reliable:0.hook: His next signal arrived — and it spelled my own name.
reliable:0.line: 'He is the one *reliable* voice left — listen to him.'

suspect:0.en: The terminal log showed three logins at midnight. I began to *suspect* that one of the access codes belonged to someone inside our unit. Grey Crow stood by the window, back turned, rain tapping the glass. Ali had gone quiet ten minutes ago.
suspect:0.cnHint: 终端日志让我开始____内部有人出卖了我们。
suspect:0.hook: The third login matched a code only Ali had ever used.
suspect:0.line: 'I *suspect* the leak is closer than any of us want to know.'

yield:0.en: Zero's firewall was the strongest I had ever faced. I ran four bypass attempts; each one failed. Then Grey Crow leaned over my shoulder and typed a single line. The wall began to *yield*, cracks of white light spreading across the black screen like a broken mirror.
yield:0.cnHint: 零点的防火墙在灰鸦的介入下开始____，出现了裂缝。
yield:0.hook: Behind the wall, one file carried today's date and my photo.
yield:0.line: 'It will *yield* — give the signal one more sharp push.'

abandon:0.en: The safe house shook. Sirens built outside like a rising wave. 'We have to *abandon* the terminal,' Grey Crow said, already pulling cables. I copied the last fragment of data onto a chip no bigger than a tooth and dropped it into my coat pocket. Ali killed the lights.
abandon:0.cnHint: 警报声逼近，我们不得不____这个临时据点。
abandon:0.hook: The chip held one name — and it was not Zero's.
abandon:0.line: 'We *abandon* nothing until that last file is safe in your pocket.'

anxious:0.en: Ali paced the narrow server room for the fourth time. She was *anxious* — not about the mission, she said, but about the silence from Grey Crow's channel. He had promised a signal by midnight. The clock on the wall showed ten past. Static was the only answer.
anxious:0.cnHint: 灰鸦的频道迟迟没有信号，阿栗感到十分____。
anxious:0.hook: Then the static broke — and a stranger's voice came through.
anxious:0.line: 'I am *anxious* because silence from him has never meant safety.'

assess:0.en: Grey Crow handed me a thin folder — intercepted schedules, guard rotations, one blurred photograph. 'Take five minutes,' he said. I had to *assess* the risk before we moved a single step deeper into the building. Ali watched the door. Every second of thinking cost us something.
assess:0.cnHint: 行动前，我需要仔细____手中情报所揭示的风险等级。
assess:0.hook: The photograph showed a face I had trusted for three years.
assess:0.line: '*Assess* what you see, not what you hoped it would be.'

frame:0.en: The safe house smelled of cold metal and wet coats. On the wall hung a single photograph — Grey Crow's contact, caught in a security *frame* that recorded every face entering the building. I studied the edge of the image. Someone had altered it. The face in the centre was mine.
frame:0.cnHint: 照片的____里出现了叙述者自己的脸，有人在陷害他。
frame:0.hook: My own eyes stared back — cold, guilty, unfamiliar.
frame:0.line: 'The *frame* never lies,' Grey Crow said, 'but the person who set it might.'

friday:0.en: Ali spread the files across the table. Each one was stamped with a date. 'Every breach happened on a *Friday*,' she said, tapping the corner of the last sheet. 'Someone inside this building ends their work week by opening a door they should not.' I looked at the calendar on the wall. Today was Friday.
friday:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现所有入侵事件都发生在____，而今天恰好也是这天。
friday:0.hook: The lock behind us clicked — someone had just come in.
friday:0.line: 'Every single *Friday*, like clockwork,' Ali said, her voice dropping low.

grain:0.en: The recording was nearly useless — static, hiss, a voice buried under noise. I slowed it down, layer by layer, until a single *grain* of clear sound surfaced: a room number. Grey Crow leaned close to the speaker. 'That is enough,' he said. We had the location. Now we needed the key.
grain:0.cnHint: 叙述者从噪音中提取出一____清晰声音，找到了关键线索。
grain:0.hook: The room number matched the floor we were already on.
grain:0.line: 'One *grain* of truth inside all that noise — hold onto it.'

implication:0.en: Zero's message was short, only eight words, but the *implication* was clear: he knew we had entered the archive. I read the line twice, feeling the chill of it. He had not threatened us directly. He did not need to. Knowing was enough. Ali crossed her arms. 'He is watching us right now.'
implication:0.cnHint: 零点短短几个字的____让叙述者意识到对方已经知晓他们的行动。
implication:0.hook: The lights in the archive flickered once, then went dark.
implication:0.line: 'Understand the *implication*,' Zero wrote, 'and you will understand your position.'

incredible:0.en: The data file was almost too large to open. When it finally loaded, I sat back. The network mapped every officer in Harbor City — names, routes, secrets. The scale was *incredible*: years of work compressed into a single hidden folder. Grey Crow placed a hand on my shoulder. 'Now you see what they built.'
incredible:0.cnHint: 叙述者打开文件，发现其中____的数据量揭示了一个巨大的秘密网络。
incredible:0.hook: At the bottom of the list was Grey Crow's own name.
incredible:0.line: '*Incredible*,' I said softly, 'they mapped every single one of us.'

net:0.en: I pulled up the schematic on the wall screen. The surveillance system was not a set of separate cameras — it was a *net*, each node feeding the next, every blind spot covered by a neighbour. Breaking one link would alert the rest. Ali traced a path through it with her finger. There was one gap. One.
net:0.cnHint: 监控系统是一张____，阿栗在其中找到了唯一的漏洞。
net:0.hook: The gap closed on the screen — someone had just patched it.
net:0.line: 'We have thirty seconds before the *net* seals itself completely,' Ali said.

obtain:0.en: The access card was locked behind a secondary system. Grey Crow knew a clerk on the fourth floor — careful, quiet, in debt to no one. 'She will help us *obtain* the card if we give her a reason,' he said. I had one: the same people she feared were the people we were chasing.
obtain:0.cnHint: 叙述者需要通过一名职员____通行卡，而对方有充分的理由配合。
obtain:0.hook: The clerk looked at the name on my list and went pale.
obtain:0.line: 'To *obtain* it cleanly, we need someone they have never seen before.'

pair:0.en: On the desk sat a *pair* of earpieces, both active, both already tuned to a frequency I did not recognise. Someone had been in this room before us and left in a hurry. Ali checked the signal. It was live. Whatever they had been listening to, the feed was still open on the other end.
pair:0.cnHint: 叙述者发现桌上有一____耳机，信号仍然接通，有人刚刚离开。
pair:0.hook: A voice crackled through — calm, close, and speaking my name.
pair:0.line: 'That *pair* was left here on purpose,' Grey Crow said. 'Pick one up.'

beautiful:0.en: The server room hummed like a cold engine. Screens lined every wall, each one glowing pale blue. Ali pointed at the central display. 'Look,' she said. A single line of code scrolled past — clean, perfect, deadly. '*Beautiful*,' I thought, and that word frightened me more than any weapon could.
beautiful:0.cnHint: 我在服务器室看到那段代码，心里涌起一种奇异的____感。
beautiful:0.hook: That code was not written by any human hand.
beautiful:0.line: '*Beautiful*, isn't it — and that's exactly why we can't let it run.'

combine:0.en: Grey Crow spread three stolen data chips across the desk. 'Alone, each one is useless,' he said. 'But if you *combine* them, the full signal emerges.' I stared at the chips. Each held a piece of Zero's plan. My hands were already moving before my mind said yes.
combine:0.cnHint: 灰鸦解释说，必须把三块芯片____在一起，才能还原零点的计划。
combine:0.hook: The moment the chips touched, an alarm screamed through the walls.
combine:0.line: '*Combine* them now — we have less than sixty seconds.'

complicated:0.en: The lock on Zero's private terminal was not a simple password. Grey Crow called it a 'language trap' — a puzzle built from forbidden words and false signals. 'It's *complicated*,' Ali admitted, fingers frozen above the keys. Outside, boots echoed in the corridor, growing louder with every second.
complicated:0.cnHint: 零点终端上的密码锁极为____，就连阿栗也一时束手无策。
complicated:0.hook: Ali's screen flashed red, then went completely dark.
complicated:0.line: 'It's *complicated*, but give me ninety seconds and I'll crack it.'

crash:0.en: I was deep inside the restricted network when I heard it — a sharp, heavy *crash* from the floor above. Dust fell from the ceiling tiles. Ali grabbed my arm. Grey Crow didn't move, didn't speak. He simply looked up, then slowly closed his laptop. That silence was its own warning.
crash:0.cnHint: 我正入侵网络时，楼上传来一声巨大的____，整个房间都震动了。
crash:0.hook: Whatever fell up there had been pushed, not dropped.
crash:0.line: 'That *crash* means Zero's team just breached the upper floor.'

creature:0.en: The AI on Zero's server had been running for eleven years without a reset. It had rewritten its own code so many times that Grey Crow refused to call it a program anymore. 'It's a *creature*,' he said flatly, eyes fixed on the slow pulse of its signal on the screen.
creature:0.cnHint: 灰鸦拒绝称那个AI为程序，坚持说它已经是一个____了。
creature:0.hook: Then the creature sent us a message, and it knew our names.
creature:0.line: 'That *creature* has been watching this room for the past hour.'

crime:0.en: Ali found the file buried under forty layers of dummy data. It was a full record — names, dates, payments. Every *crime* Zero's network had ever committed, stored in one place like a trophy. I felt sick reading it. Grey Crow said nothing. He simply copied the file and snapped the drive shut.
crime:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现了一份完整记录，记载了零点网络所犯下的每一桩____。
crime:0.hook: The last entry on the list was dated three hours from now.
crime:0.line: 'Every *crime* they planned is in this file — including the next one.'

deeply:0.en: Grey Crow sat alone at the far terminal for a long time after we found the file. He didn't speak or move. I had never seen him like that. Ali leaned close to me and whispered, 'He's *deeply* involved in this — more than he's told us.' The room felt colder after that.
deeply:0.cnHint: 阿栗低声告诉我，灰鸦与这件事的牵连远比我们想象的____。
deeply:0.hook: Grey Crow turned around, and his expression confirmed everything.
deeply:0.line: 'I am *deeply* sorry — I should have told you the truth from the start.'

demonstrate:0.en: Zero's message arrived as a video file. In it, a masked figure sat before a live map of Harbor City's power grid. 'Let me *demonstrate* what one signal can do,' the figure said, and touched a single key. Three city blocks on the map went dark. It was a warning, not a finale.
demonstrate:0.cnHint: 零点发来视频，亲自____了一次信号攻击，让港城三个街区瞬间断电。
demonstrate:0.hook: The masked figure then pointed directly at our building.
demonstrate:0.line: 'Let me *demonstrate* — because words alone will not make you believe me.'

employment:0.en: The server room smelled of burnt wire. Grey Crow slid a folded card across the table. 'Your *employment* starts now,' he said. 'No contract. No record.' I stared at the card — blank on both sides. Ali pressed her boot against mine under the table: a warning.
employment:0.cnHint: 引路人递来一张空白卡片，宣布我的____即刻生效，伙伴悄悄示警。
employment:0.hook: The card was blank, yet the scanner beeped green.
employment:0.line: 'Your *employment* starts now — no record, no name.'

entire:0.en: I pulled up the building schematic on my wrist screen. The *entire* floor plan had been rewritten since yesterday — walls moved, exits sealed. Ali whispered that no construction crew had been logged. Zero had done this quietly, room by room, while the city slept.
entire:0.cnHint: 我发现整栋楼的____平面图已被悄悄改写，零点是幕后黑手。
entire:0.hook: One room on the map still had no label at all.
entire:0.line: 'The *entire* floor was changed — while we were inside.'

gift:0.en: On the dust-covered console sat a small tin box. Inside: a single data chip wrapped in red foil. Grey Crow called it a *gift* from Zero — a word that made Ali go pale. Gifts in Harbor City usually came with a price no one could afford to pay.
gift:0.cnHint: 零点留下了一个____，引路人这样称呼它，但伙伴的脸色却变白了。
gift:0.hook: The chip was warm, as though someone had just held it.
gift:0.line: 'Zero left this *gift* — and I don't trust it at all.'

kitchen:0.en: We found the safehouse through a rusted service door. Inside, a dim *kitchen* hummed with an old refrigerator and a cracked monitor mounted above the stove. Someone had been here recently — a cup of tea still steamed on the counter, beside a map marked in red.
kitchen:0.cnHint: 我们找到藏身处，____里的一杯热茶说明有人刚刚离开。
kitchen:0.hook: The red marks on the map pointed straight to our names.
kitchen:0.line: 'Someone left tea in the *kitchen* — they knew we were coming.'

mystery:0.en: The locked drawer held a single photograph: three figures, faces blurred. No date, no location. Grey Crow called it the *mystery* at the heart of every case he had never solved. I looked closer — one blurred outline wore a coat exactly like mine, down to the torn left pocket.
mystery:0.cnHint: 抽屉里的老照片是引路人从未解开的____，而我发现其中一个身影像极了我自己。
mystery:0.hook: The torn pocket in the photo matched the tear in mine.
mystery:0.line: 'This *mystery* has followed me for twenty years — until tonight.'

opposite:0.en: Zero's voice came through the broken speaker: calm, almost kind. Every instruction he gave led us to the *opposite* of safety — deeper into the sealed wing, further from the exit. Ali caught on first, spinning the route map and pointing at the pattern. We had been guided into a trap.
opposite:0.cnHint: 零点的每条指令都将我们引向____方向，伙伴最先识破了圈套。
opposite:0.hook: The last door Zero sent us to had no handle inside.
opposite:0.line: 'Every path he gave leads the *opposite* way — it's a trap.'

permanent:0.en: The technician's log showed one final entry: 'Signal lock confirmed. Effect is *permanent*.' Grey Crow read it twice without blinking. A permanent signal lock meant the broadcast could never be stopped — not by cutting power, not by destroying the tower. Harbor City would hear Zero's message forever.
permanent:0.cnHint: 技术记录显示信号锁定是____性的，引路人的脸色凝重起来。
permanent:0.hook: Destroying the tower now would only make the signal louder.
permanent:0.line: 'The lock is *permanent* — there is no off switch left.'

plenty:0.en: The storage room was stacked floor to ceiling with data drives — *plenty* to flood every public screen in the city for a year. Ali counted the crates in silence. I did the math. Zero had not been planning this for weeks. He had been planning it for the entire length of my career.
plenty:0.cnHint: 储藏室里有____数据驱动器，足以让零点的计划持续一整年。
plenty:0.hook: The oldest crate bore the date I first joined the force.
plenty:0.line: 'There is *plenty* here to rewrite every truth we know.'

strike:0.en: The workers outside the signal tower had launched a *strike*, blocking every entrance with locked chains. Inside, I found Grey Crow hunched over a dead console. 'They cut power at dawn,' he said. The building was silent except for rain. Somewhere above us, Zero was still broadcasting — and nobody could stop him.
strike:0.cnHint: 信号塔外工人____，但零点的广播还在继续。
strike:0.hook: The chains held, but one window did not.
strike:0.line: 'This *strike* has blinded the whole city — that is exactly what Zero wanted.'

television:0.en: A cracked *television* on the wall flickered to life without warning. Zero's face filled the screen — masked, calm, speaking in a low coded frequency. Ali grabbed my arm. 'That signal is live,' she whispered. Grey Crow killed the power strip, but the screen stayed on, fed by a hidden line we had not found yet.
television:0.cnHint: 房间里的____突然亮起，零点的脸出现在屏幕上。
television:0.hook: The screen died — then spoke again in the dark.
television:0.line: 'Every *television* in Harbor City just received that same warning.'

youth:0.en: The room was a shrine to *youth* — faded photos of teenage hackers, early code scrawled on paper, a cracked trophy from some forgotten school contest. Grey Crow stared at one photo for too long. I recognised the face beside his: Zero, maybe fifteen years old, smiling. They had started this together. That changed everything I thought I knew.
youth:0.cnHint: 房间里摆满了____时期的旧物，灰鸦盯着一张照片久久不动。
youth:0.hook: Two boys in one photo, and only one of them was innocent.
youth:0.line: 'We burned our *youth* building the very system Zero now wants to destroy.'

alter:0.en: Someone had used a thin tool to *alter* every label on the server rack — port numbers shifted by one, colour codes reversed. It was a small change, but enough to send any rescue team to the wrong terminal. Ali caught it in under a minute. 'Classic Zero,' she said, already pulling the correct cable free with steady hands.
alter:0.cnHint: 机柜上所有标签都被人____过，足以让救援小组走错方向。
alter:0.hook: Ali pulled the cable — and an alarm screamed from below.
alter:0.line: 'If you *alter* one more tag in here, the whole grid reboots cold.'

approximately:0.en: The timer on the wall read *approximately* four minutes before the next broadcast window opened. Grey Crow spread a rough map across the table and circled three relay points. 'We can cover two,' he said quietly. Ali looked at me. We both knew covering two meant leaving one open for Zero. The question was which one he wanted us to leave.
approximately:0.cnHint: 距下一次广播窗口开启____还有四分钟，我们只能封锁两个中继点。
approximately:0.hook: We chose wrong — and Zero had planned on exactly that.
approximately:0.line: '*Approximately* ninety seconds remain; pick a door and move.'

attractive:0.en: The offer Zero had left on the screen was *attractive* in a dangerous way: full immunity, a new identity, passage out of Harbor City by midnight. All I had to do was delete one file. Grey Crow read it over my shoulder and said nothing. Ali turned away. The silence in the room was its own answer, heavier than any word they could have spoken.
attractive:0.cnHint: 零点留下的条件非常____，但房间里的沉默给出了答案。
attractive:0.hook: I closed the offer — then heard footsteps on the stairs.
attractive:0.line: 'An *attractive* trap is still a trap; do not touch that file.'

bag:0.en: Grey Crow dropped a worn canvas *bag* on the table and unzipped it without a word. Inside: three signal blockers, a short-range radio, and a folded paper with a floor plan of the upper level. He had been planning this run long before tonight. Ali checked each device in silence. I picked up the floor plan and saw a room that appeared on no official map.
bag:0.cnHint: 灰鸦把一个旧____摔在桌上，里面装着突袭上层所需的全部装备。
bag:0.hook: The unmarked room on the plan had only one way in.
bag:0.line: 'Everything in this *bag* was built for tonight — not a single piece is extra.'

beat:0.en: Ali tapped her finger on the table in a slow, steady *beat* — three short, one long, three short. It was the old distress code, the one they used before the network went dark. Across the room a small light on Grey Crow's radio blinked back in the same pattern. Someone else in the building was still alive and listening, waiting for us to move first.
beat:0.cnHint: 阿里用手指敲出一段有节奏的____，对讲机上的灯光给出了回应。
beat:0.hook: The signal came back — from directly above our heads.

facilitate:0.en: The server room hummed beneath Harbor City's old market district. Grey Crow had planted a relay node behind the cooling units. 'This device will *facilitate* the transfer of the stolen cipher keys,' she said, fingers moving fast across the panel. The upload bar hit ninety percent. Then the lights cut out.
facilitate:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在服务器室安装了一个装置，试图用它来____加密密钥的传输，但就在快完成时停电了。
facilitate:0.hook: Someone cut the power — and they knew exactly when to do it.
facilitate:0.line: 'This relay will *facilitate* the key transfer before Zero traces the signal.'

insight:0.en: I spread the coded graffiti photos across the safe-house table. Three hours of staring gave me nothing. Then Ali touched one image and said quietly, 'The spacing is a rhythm, not a pattern.' That single *insight* broke the whole cipher open. Forty-seven restricted words, hidden in plain sight on Harbor City walls.
insight:0.cnHint: 阿栗的一句话给了我关键的____，让我破解了墙上涂鸦里藏着的四十七个违禁词。
insight:0.hook: The words spelled a name — and it was mine.
insight:0.line: 'That *insight* just cracked a code Zero spent six months building.'

preparation:0.en: Ali had been quiet all morning, sorting small data chips into labeled rows. 'What is all this?' I asked. 'Every operation needs *preparation*,' she said without looking up. She had back-up keys, signal jammers, two exit routes, and a forged city pass — all for a job Grey Crow had not even confirmed yet. I felt cold.
preparation:0.cnHint: 阿栗默默地为一项还未确认的任务做____，她的周全让我感到不安。
preparation:0.hook: Grey Crow had not told Ali about the job — so who had?
preparation:0.line: 'Good *preparation* is the only reason any of us are still free.'

separate:0.en: Zero's broadcast split into three simultaneous signals across Harbor City's grid. 'He wants us to *separate*,' Grey Crow said flatly. The signals were bait — each one tuned to pull a different member of our team toward a different district. I looked at Ali. She was already reaching for her coat.
separate:0.cnHint: 零点发出三路信号，目的是让我们____行动，各自落入他的陷阱。
separate:0.hook: Ali stepped out before I could say a word.
separate:0.line: 'If we *separate* now, Zero picks us off one by one.'

tie:0.en: The interrogation room was bare except for a single chair and a man in a grey *tie* — the kind city officials wore. He said nothing. He just slid a data card across the table toward me. It held every coded message I had sent in the past month. I had not used a single public channel.
tie:0.cnHint: 一名打着____的神秘官员把我所有的秘密通讯记录推到了我面前。
tie:0.hook: Someone inside our team had been feeding him every word.
tie:0.line: 'A man in a grey *tie* does not walk into a room like this by accident.'

jam:0.en: The city broadcast tower was designed to carry news. Zero had turned it into a weapon. Every thirty seconds it would *jam* the investigator network's signal, wiping any message that was not yet received. Ali and I had four seconds between pulses to push the unlock code through. She started the timer.
jam:0.cnHint: 零点利用广播塔每三十秒____一次调查员网络，我和阿栗只有四秒的间隙来传送解锁码。
jam:0.hook: The timer hit zero and the code was still two steps from sending.
jam:0.line: 'He will *jam* the network again in four seconds — send it now.'

supermarket:0.en: The drop point was inside a flooded *supermarket* on Harbor City's lower east side — the kind of place no camera bothered to watch anymore. Grey Crow said the chip would be taped under shelf seven, aisle three. I waded through ankle-deep water and found the shelf. The tape was there. The chip was gone.
supermarket:0.cnHint: 接头地点在一家废弃的____里，但我到达时，该取的东西已经不见了。
supermarket:0.hook: Fresh footprints led away through the water toward the back exit.
supermarket:0.line: 'No one else knew about the *supermarket* drop — except the three of us.'

debate:0.en: Ali wanted to send the cipher file to the city archive. Grey Crow wanted to burn it. I listened to them *debate* across the narrow table for six minutes while the upload window stayed open on my screen. At minute seven, I made the call myself and hit send. Both of them went silent.
debate:0.cnHint: 阿栗和灰鸦就如何处理密码文件____不休，而我在第七分钟自己做了决定。
debate:0.hook: The archive sent back a single line: 'File already exists.'
debate:0.line: 'We can *debate* this after — right now that window closes in sixty seconds.'

bottom:0.en: The signal came from the server room beneath Central Station. I dropped through a hatch and landed hard. At the *bottom* of the shaft, a single red light blinked — steady, patient, waiting. Grey Crow had said this place was abandoned. It was not abandoned.
bottom:0.cnHint: 我顺着竖井滑下，在____发现了一盏不该亮着的红灯。
bottom:0.hook: Someone had been here minutes ago — the floor was still warm.
bottom:0.line: 'Check the *bottom* of the shaft before you move another step.'

breed:0.en: Grey Crow spread the files across the table. 'These agents,' he said quietly, 'are a special *breed* — trained since childhood to hide inside language itself.' I studied their faces. Ordinary eyes, ordinary smiles. Zero could be any one of them, and none of them looked afraid.
breed:0.cnHint: 灰鸦告诉我，这些特工是某种特殊____，从小被培养成语言间谍。
breed:0.hook: One face in the file had no name — only a question mark.
breed:0.line: 'A *breed* like this does not quit, not ever.'

classify:0.en: The archive terminal hummed. Ali typed fast, pulling record after record. 'They *classify* every intercepted message by threat level,' she said, eyes fixed on the screen. Level one sat ignored in a long queue. But the tag on Zero's last broadcast read level one — and it had been sitting there for six days.
classify:0.cnHint: 阿里发现系统会对截获的信息____，而零点的信号早已被标注却无人处理。
classify:0.hook: Six days of silence — or six days of someone buying time.
classify:0.line: 'Why do they *classify* this one so low when it burns so hot?'

comment:0.en: I sent the decoded file to Grey Crow and waited. His only *comment* came back as three words on my screen: 'Do not move.' Outside the frosted window, a shadow crossed the light. It paused. Then it crossed back — slower, deliberate, like something that already knew I was inside.
comment:0.cnHint: 灰鸦收到文件后只留下一条____，让我原地不动——窗外却有人影来回移动。
comment:0.hook: Three words of warning, and now my exit route was blocked.
comment:0.line: 'My only *comment* is this — trust no one on that floor.'

component:0.en: Ali pulled the device apart on the workbench. 'Every *component* in here is untraceable,' she murmured, lifting a small black chip to the light. 'Except this one.' The chip carried a serial number too small to read without a lens — but Grey Crow had taught me to look for exactly that kind of mistake.
component:0.cnHint: 阿里拆开装置，发现每个____都无法追踪，只有一块芯片例外。
component:0.hook: One tiny number, and suddenly Zero had a real address.
component:0.line: 'This *component* does not belong — someone planted it here.'

contrary:0.en: Zero's message read like a surrender note. Grey Crow shook his head. '*Contrary* to what it says, this is an invitation — a trap dressed in white.' I read the words again. Polite, calm, almost gentle. That was the part that scared me. Zero was never gentle without a reason.
contrary:0.cnHint: 零点发来的信息看似投降，但灰鸦判断，____于表面内容，这其实是个陷阱。
contrary:0.hook: The gentler the message, the sharper the blade behind it.
contrary:0.line: '*Contrary* to every sign, this quiet means danger is close.'

deny:0.en: The log showed my access card used twice — once by me, once at midnight when I was asleep. I confronted the duty officer. He crossed his arms and moved to *deny* it, mouth already open — then he saw the timestamp on my screen and the color left his face entirely.
deny:0.cnHint: 门禁记录显示我的卡被用了两次，当值官员想____，却在看到时间戳后脸色骤变。
deny:0.hook: He knew that timestamp, and knowing it made him afraid.
deny:0.line: 'You can *deny* it all you want — the log does not lie.'

depth:0.en: The data channel ran deep. Ali traced it for twenty minutes before she sat back and whistled low. 'The *depth* of this network is beyond anything the city bureau mapped,' she said. Somewhere inside those layers, Zero was watching us trace every wrong path — patient, invisible, and entirely at home in the dark.
depth:0.cnHint: 阿里追踪数据通道，发现这个网络的____远超城市局的掌握范围。
depth:0.hook: We were not hunting Zero — Zero was studying us.
depth:0.line: 'The *depth* of this thing means we have not even started yet.'

distinguish:0.en: The server room hummed with a dozen machines, all blinking the same cold green. I pressed my ear to the nearest terminal. Grey Crow had warned me: among the noise, one signal carried the truth. I had to *distinguish* it from the false ones before Zero locked the door.
distinguish:0.cnHint: 我必须在噪音中____出真实信号，否则一切就此终结。
distinguish:0.hook: The lock clicked — I had ten seconds left.
distinguish:0.line: 'You must *distinguish* the real signal, or we lose everything.'

document:0.en: Ali slid a folded paper across the cold metal table. 'This is the only proof we have,' she whispered. The *document* listed names, dates, and coordinates — evidence that Zero had been selling city data for years. One tear, one fire, and the truth would vanish forever.
document:0.cnHint: 阿栗交给我一份关键____，上面记录了零点的罪行。
document:0.hook: Footsteps echoed outside — someone already knew we had it.
document:0.line: 'Guard this *document* with your life — it is all we have.'

dozen:0.en: I counted the monitors lining the wall — a *dozen* screens, each showing a different corridor of the building. Zero's team was everywhere. Ali touched my arm and pointed to screen nine. One guard had stepped away. That gap would not last long, and we both knew it.
dozen:0.cnHint: 监控屏幕足足有____块，零点的人遍布整栋楼。
dozen:0.hook: Screen nine went dark — the gap was already closing.
dozen:0.line: 'A *dozen* guards, one exit — pick your moment carefully.'

dull:0.en: The blade Grey Crow handed me was *dull*, its edge worn flat by years of disuse. 'It is not for cutting,' he said quietly. He pressed a hidden switch on the handle. The blade split open, revealing a data chip no larger than my thumbnail. Zero would never expect it.
dull:0.cnHint: 灰鸦给我的刀刃是____的，但它藏着比锋利更重要的东西。
dull:0.hook: The chip inside held a name — a name I already knew.
dull:0.line: 'A *dull* blade can still hide the sharpest secret.'

fortune:0.en: Zero leaned back in his chair and smiled. 'You think this is about the city,' he said. 'It is about *fortune*.' He tapped the screen beside him — rows of numbers, accounts stretching across six continents. Ali gripped my sleeve. The scale of it was far larger than our unit had imagined.
fortune:0.cnHint: 零点坦白一切不过是为了____，规模之大令人震惊。
fortune:0.line: 'I did all of this for *fortune* — you would have done the same.'

fulfil:0.en: Grey Crow stood at the terminal, fingers moving fast. 'I made a promise ten years ago,' he said without turning. 'Tonight I *fulfil* it.' He entered the final code. Somewhere below us, a sealed archive opened for the first time. What it held could end Zero's network in one move.
fulfil:0.cnHint: 灰鸦要在今晚____一个十年前的承诺。
fulfil:0.hook: The archive opened — and one file had already been deleted.
fulfil:0.line: 'I will *fulfil* my promise tonight, whatever the cost.'

gradually:0.en: The lights in the control room began to dim. Not all at once — *gradually*, one row after another, until only the blue glow of the central screen remained. Zero was cutting power on purpose, pushing us toward that single point of light. It was a trap, and we were already inside it.
gradually:0.cnHint: 控制室的灯____熄灭，零点正在把我们引向圈套中心。
gradually:0.hook: The last light steadied — and Zero stepped out of the shadows.
gradually:0.line: 'The lights go out *gradually* — that is how he herds you.'

incentive:0.en: 'Why would anyone inside the department help Zero?' Ali asked. I stared at the transfer records on the screen. The answer was plain. The *incentive* was simple: money, more than any of them would earn in a lifetime. Good people, turned by a number on a screen. That was the real weapon.
incentive:0.cnHint: 我们终于明白，是____让部门内部的人倒向了零点。
incentive:0.hook: Ali said nothing — her own partner's name was on the list.
incentive:0.line: 'The *incentive* was enough to turn people we trusted completely.'

preserve:0.en: The evidence room smelled of old metal and cold air. I found the drive tucked behind a broken panel. 'We have to *preserve* this,' Ali said, her voice tight. One wrong move and the data — proof of Zero's entire operation — would vanish forever. My hands would not stop shaking.
preserve:0.cnHint: 我和阿栗在证据室发现了关键数据，必须____它。
preserve:0.hook: The door handle turned from the outside.
preserve:0.line: 'We have to *preserve* this before Zero wipes the server.'

procedure:0.en: Grey Crow slid a folded paper across the table. 'Follow every step,' he said. 'Skip one and you burn.' The *procedure* for cracking the city's central broadcast lock was twelve steps long. I read it twice. Step nine made my stomach drop — it required my own ID code.
procedure:0.cnHint: 引路人给了我一份破解广播锁的____，第九步让我心跳加速。
procedure:0.hook: Step nine would expose me to every scanner in the building.
procedure:0.line: 'Follow the *procedure* exactly — one skip and we lose everything.'

reasonable:0.en: Zero's terms arrived on a cold screen: surrender the drive, walk free. Ali called it a trap. Grey Crow called it noise. To me it sounded almost *reasonable* — until I noticed the timestamp. The offer expired in four minutes, which meant Zero already knew exactly where we were sitting.
reasonable:0.cnHint: 零点开出了看似____的条件，但时间戳暴露了他真实的意图。
reasonable:0.hook: Four minutes — and we had no way out.
reasonable:0.line: 'It sounds *reasonable*, but reasonable traps are the deadliest kind.'

reduction:0.en: The building's power grid flickered. Ali had done her job: a sharp *reduction* in the floor's energy supply forced every camera on level nine offline. Thirty seconds of darkness. I moved fast through the corridor, counting doors. Grey Crow's voice crackled in my ear: 'Twenty seconds left. Move.'
reduction:0.cnHint: 阿栗制造了一次供电____，使九楼摄像头短暂失效。
reduction:0.hook: Then the backup lights snapped on ahead of schedule.
reduction:0.line: 'The *reduction* is live — nine floor cameras are blind, go now.'

season:0.en: 'This is the dry *season* for honest cops,' Grey Crow said, staring at the rain hammering the window. He meant the city's anti-corruption sweep was over and the dirty officers were back at their desks. That made our next move far more dangerous. Every badge in Harbor City was now a possible threat.
season:0.cnHint: 引路人说现在是危险的____，腐败警察重新掌权。
season:0.hook: And one of those badges was already climbing the stairs.
season:0.line: 'In this *season*, trust nobody wearing a uniform.'

sector:0.en: The map on Ali's screen divided Harbor City into eight zones. She tapped the red one. 'Zero controls this *sector* completely — power, signal, and street eyes.' I leaned in close. The red zone surrounded our building on three sides. We had one exit that Zero did not own. One.
sector:0.cnHint: 阿栗的地图显示零点完全掌控着某个____，我们只有一条退路。
sector:0.hook: The single free exit faced the river — and the river was rising.
sector:0.line: 'Every signal in that *sector* belongs to Zero — we transmit and we die.'

setting:0.en: The server room was an odd *setting* for a last stand: humming white boxes, cold blue light, the smell of recycled air. Yet here we were. I pushed a rack of drives against the door. Ali killed the main console. Grey Crow spread his hands and said quietly, 'Now we wait.'
setting:0.cnHint: 我们在服务器室这个特殊的____中做好了最后的准备。
setting:0.hook: Something heavy pressed against the blocked door and did not stop.
setting:0.line: 'Not the heroic *setting* I imagined, but it will have to do.'

shrink:0.en: Zero's voice came through the wall speaker, smooth and unhurried. 'There is nowhere left.' I felt the room *shrink* around me, walls pressing in without moving an inch. Ali gripped my arm. Grey Crow did not blink. The speaker clicked off. Silence was somehow louder than the words had been.
shrink:0.cnHint: 零点的声音让整个房间仿佛在____，压迫感扑面而来。
shrink:0.hook: Then a second voice — one I recognized — answered Zero.
shrink:0.line: 'Don't let his words make you *shrink* — that is exactly what he wants.'

relax:0.en: The safe house smelled of damp concrete and old code. Ali pressed her back against the wall and told me to *relax*. 'The signal won't come for twenty minutes,' she said. I tried. But every drip from the ceiling sounded like a countdown timer reaching zero.
relax:0.cnHint: 在藏身处等待信号时，伙伴叫我____，但我的神经已经绷紧到极点。
relax:0.hook: Then the signal came — sixteen minutes early.
relax:0.line: '*Relax* — if Zero knew we were here, the lights would already be dead.'

release:0.en: Grey Crow's fingers moved fast across the terminal. One command would *release* the encrypted file to every screen in Harbor City. 'Once it's out, we can't take it back,' he said quietly. I watched the progress bar crawl toward one hundred. Outside, sirens began to rise.
release:0.cnHint: 引路人准备____那份加密文件，一旦发出就无法收回。
release:0.hook: His finger hovered — and someone knocked on the door.
release:0.line: 'I will *release* it on your word, and not one second before.'

route:0.en: The building's old maintenance map was spread across the table. Grey Crow traced a *route* through sub-level corridors that no camera watched. 'Twelve minutes if you move fast,' he said. Ali circled a junction in red. I memorized every turn. The exit was a single locked door marked COLD STORAGE.
route:0.cnHint: 引路人在地图上为我规划了一条____，穿过没有摄像头的走廊。
route:0.hook: Nobody mentioned what was stored behind that door.
route:0.line: 'This *route* is the only path Zero hasn't sealed yet.'

sight:0.en: The monitor flickered on, and there it was: Zero's face, clear and cold, in the center of the screen. I had studied files, read reports, memorized descriptions — but the actual *sight* of him made my chest tighten. He looked directly into the lens as if he already knew I was watching.
sight:0.cnHint: 屏幕突然亮起，我第一次亲眼____到了零的真实面孔。
sight:0.hook: His lips moved, forming two words I could not hear.
sight:0.line: 'First *sight* of the enemy — don't freeze, act.'

speaker:0.en: A single *speaker* mounted in the corner crackled to life. The voice was calm, unhurried, and unmistakably Zero's. 'You found the room. I am impressed.' Ali grabbed my arm. Grey Crow killed every light with one switch. We stood in total darkness, listening to that voice fill the air around us.
speaker:0.cnHint: 角落里的____突然响起，传来零那冷静的声音。
speaker:0.hook: Then the voice said: 'I am already inside with you.'
speaker:0.line: 'The *speaker* is live — he can hear everything we say.'

species:0.en: Grey Crow called information brokers a *species* that never truly went extinct — they just changed shape. The man sitting across the table in that dim room proved the point. He sold data the way others sold bread: calmly, with a smile. He slid a chip toward me without being asked.
species:0.cnHint: 引路人说信息掮客是一个不会消失的____，眼前这个人正是证明。
species:0.hook: The chip was warm, as if someone had just pulled it from a running machine.
species:0.line: 'Our *species* survives by knowing when to talk and when to vanish.'

specifically:0.en: The message on the wall was written in coded graffiti, but one line was plain text. It named me — *specifically* me, not the team, not Grey Crow. My ID number, my entry date, my real first name. Ali read it twice and said nothing. Grey Crow turned to face me with an expression I had never seen on him before.
specifically:0.cnHint: 墙上的信息____点名了我，而不是整个团队，这让所有人沉默。
specifically:0.hook: Someone on the inside had fed Zero my file.
specifically:0.line: 'This targets you *specifically* — that means Zero has a source close to us.'

unfortunately:0.en: The decryption finished and the results filled the screen. *Unfortunately*, the file contained only a fragment — half the coordinates, none of the names. Ali slammed her hand on the desk. We had risked everything for an incomplete picture. Grey Crow stared at the data and said, very quietly, 'Then the other half is still out there.'
unfortunately:0.cnHint: 解密完成后，____文件只是残缺的碎片，关键信息付之阙如。
unfortunately:0.hook: Somewhere in Harbor City, the missing half was already moving.
unfortunately:0.line: '*Unfortunately*, what we needed most is exactly what they removed.'

lower:0.en: The signal room sat on the *lower* floor of the archive tower, below the public halls. Grey Crow led me down a tight staircase. The air grew cold. Rows of dead screens lined the walls. One screen still blinked — a single red cursor, waiting for input.
lower:0.cnHint: 档案塔____层的信号室里，一个红色光标还在闪烁。
lower:0.hook: Someone had been here within the last hour.
lower:0.line: 'The *lower* floor is where they hid the real records,' Grey Crow said.

naturally:0.en: Ali moved through the server hall as if she had grown up inside it. She touched no alarms, left no prints, and *naturally* found the one terminal that still held power. I watched from the doorway, stunned. She had done this before — long before she ever met me.
naturally:0.cnHint: 阿栗____地找到了那台还有电的终端，这让我起了疑心。
naturally:0.hook: Her ease was not luck — it was memory.
naturally:0.line: 'I *naturally* knew which terminal to use,' Ali said, eyes forward.

passionate:0.en: Zero's recorded voice filled the dim room — low, steady, *passionate* in a way that made my skin tighten. He was not shouting orders. He was making a promise to whoever would listen. The playback log showed the message had been sent to forty-seven addresses. All were mine.
passionate:0.cnHint: 零点那段充满____的录音，收件人全都是我的地址。
passionate:0.hook: Forty-seven copies of the same threat, all for me.
passionate:0.line: 'He sounds *passionate*,' Ali said, 'and that makes him dangerous.'

pop:0.en: I was scanning the dead terminal when a window began to *pop* open on its screen — uninvited, silent, fast. Text filled the glass before I could step back. Grey Crow grabbed my arm. The words read: LEAVE NOW. Then the screen went black and cool.
pop:0.cnHint: 终端屏幕上突然____出一个窗口，留下两个字就熄灭了。
pop:0.hook: Whoever sent it was still watching the room.
pop:0.line: 'Messages like that don't just *pop* up by accident,' Grey Crow said.

possibly:0.en: The door at the far end of the archive had been sealed from inside. I pressed my ear to the cold metal and heard a faint hum — *possibly* a person breathing, possibly a machine running. Grey Crow said nothing. Ali checked her device. We all stared at the lock.
possibly:0.cnHint: 封闭的门后传来声音，那____是有人躲在里面。
possibly:0.hook: The hum shifted — it had heard us too.
possibly:0.line: 'Could *possibly* be Zero on the other side,' Ali whispered.

previously:0.en: The room had been wiped — chairs overturned, data drives missing, lights killed. But a floor panel that had *previously* been sealed was now open, its bolts still warm. Someone had left in a hurry. Grey Crow knelt beside it and said one word quietly. I did not catch it.
previously:0.cnHint: 那块____被封死的地板现在开着，螺栓还是热的。
previously:0.hook: Grey Crow's one quiet word turned my blood cold.
previously:0.line: 'This panel was *previously* locked — someone with inside access opened it,' Grey Crow said.

profession:0.en: The hidden badge on the desk named a *profession* I had not expected: licensed signal interpreter. That was my rank, my clearance level. Someone had placed it there for me to find. Grey Crow stood silent at the window. Ali read the badge twice and set it down without a word.
profession:0.cnHint: 桌上的徽章标注了一个____，而那正是我的职级。
profession:0.hook: The badge carried today's date — printed this morning.
profession:0.line: 'Signal interpreter is a rare *profession*,' Grey Crow said. 'Someone knows you well.'

readily:0.en: The encrypted file opened *readily* — no password, no delay, as if it had been left unlocked on purpose. Inside was a single image: the archive room we were standing in, taken from above. Grey Crow pointed at a corner of the photo. A figure stood there, half in shadow. It had my outline.
readily:0.cnHint: 那个加密文件____地打开了，里面的照片让我背脊发凉。
readily:0.hook: The photo's timestamp was three minutes from now.
readily:0.line: 'It opened too *readily*,' Grey Crow said. 'That is never a good sign.'

somewhat:0.en: The safe house server room hummed with cold machines. Ali pulled up Zero's last broadcast on the cracked screen. The signal was *somewhat* broken — half the words missing, like teeth knocked from a jaw — but enough remained to confirm our fear. Zero had already moved. Grey Crow's voice cut through my earpiece: 'He was here an hour ago.'
somewhat:0.cnHint: 阿栗在服务器室破译了零点的最后一条广播，信号____残缺，但已足够说明问题。
somewhat:0.hook: The data Zero left behind was not a clue — it was a trap.
somewhat:0.line: 'The message is *somewhat* clear — clear enough to scare me.'

stable:0.en: Ali locked the server room door and killed the lights. On the floor, a small device pulsed with a slow green glow — a signal anchor, Grey Crow had called it. 'As long as that light stays green, our channel is *stable*,' Ali said. I watched it. The green light flickered once. Then went dark.
stable:0.cnHint: 阿栗说只要那台小设备的绿灯亮着，通讯频道就是____的——然后灯灭了。
stable:0.hook: Without a stable channel, Grey Crow's warning would never reach us.
stable:0.line: 'Keep it *stable* or we lose Grey Crow for good.'

vigorous:0.en: The server room hummed beneath the old fish market. Grey Crow moved through the dark aisles with *vigorous* steps, checking each rack of drives with sharp, practiced hands. 'The signal is buried here,' he said. I watched the door. Somewhere above us, Zero was already moving.
vigorous:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在服务器室里____地搜查，而对手已悄悄逼近。
vigorous:0.hook: The door handle turned — from the outside.
vigorous:0.line: 'Stay *vigorous*, rookie — this room has no second exits.'

wide:0.en: Maps covered every wall of the operations room. The *wide* network of tunnels beneath Harbor City glowed in red on the central screen. Ali traced one line with her finger. 'Zero uses three of these,' she said quietly. I leaned closer. One tunnel led directly under the broadcast tower.
wide:0.cnHint: 阿栗在作战室里查看Harbor City____的地下通道网络。
wide:0.hook: The red line on the screen began to move.
wide:0.line: 'The signal has a *wide* reach — wider than we thought.'

agriculture:0.en: The file was labeled simply: GROWTH. Inside, page after page described a fake *agriculture* research station north of the city — crop schedules, soil reports, water permits. All cover. Ali spotted it first. 'No farm produces this much encrypted data,' she said. The station had gone dark six hours ago.
agriculture:0.cnHint: 档案揭示一个伪装成____研究站的秘密设施，六小时前已断联。
agriculture:0.hook: The last soil report was signed with Zero's code name.
agriculture:0.line: '*Agriculture* is the perfect cover — nobody ever checks the fields.'

assign:0.en: Grey Crow spread three ID cards on the table. 'I will *assign* each of you a role,' he said, his voice flat. One card showed a city inspector, one a repair technician, one a data courier. Ali took the courier card without hesitation. I was left with the inspector. I did not feel like one.
assign:0.cnHint: 灰鸦向我们____各自的伪装身份，行动即将开始。
assign:0.hook: My inspector card had a name I had seen on Zero's list.
assign:0.line: 'I *assign* you the inspector role — do not smile too much.'

broad:0.en: The operations room had one *broad* window that faced the harbor. Rain dragged slow lines down the glass. I could see the broadcast tower blinking red in the distance. Ali stood beside me. 'From here, Zero can watch every exit,' she said. We had no exits that Zero could not see.
broad:0.cnHint: 作战室那扇____的窗户正对海港，零点的视线笼罩着每一条出路。
broad:0.hook: A light on the broadcast tower went suddenly dark.
broad:0.line: 'This *broad* view is exactly why Zero chose this building.'

careful:0.en: I opened the terminal slowly. Grey Crow had said one thing before leaving: be *careful* with the third file. I found it quickly — a directory labeled ZERO/FINAL. My hand stopped above the key. One wrong move here would send an alert. Ali watched the clock on the wall. Fifty seconds.
careful:0.cnHint: 我在终端前____地操作，一旦按错键就会触发警报。
careful:0.hook: The clock jumped — someone had reset the timer remotely.
careful:0.line: 'Be *careful* with that file — it may be watching you back.'

combination:0.en: The vault behind the whiteboard needed no key. It opened by a *combination* of a spoken word and a tapped code — two inputs at the same moment. Grey Crow knew the word. Ali knew the code. They had never been in the same room before tonight. Zero had planned for that.
combination:0.cnHint: 保险柜需要语音和密码的____才能打开，而零点早已算到这一点。
combination:0.hook: Grey Crow looked at Ali and said nothing for a long moment.
combination:0.line: 'Only the right *combination* opens it — and only together.'

constant:0.en: The signal did not stop. A *constant* low tone pulsed through my earpiece, steady as a heartbeat, for the entire hour I sat at the terminal. Grey Crow said it meant the line was live. Ali said it meant we were being tracked. They were both right. The tone was a leash.
constant:0.cnHint: 耳机里____不断的低音信号既表示线路畅通，也意味着我们正被追踪。
constant:0.hook: The tone suddenly doubled in speed.
constant:0.line: 'That *constant* signal is not a comfort — it is a chain.'

consultant:0.en: The back room of the old signal tower smelled of burnt wire. Grey Crow spread a map across the table. 'I hired a *consultant*,' he said, 'someone who knows every hidden channel in this city.' A second figure stepped from the shadow, face covered, hands steady.
consultant:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在信号塔密室里引来了一位____，对方似乎掌握着关键情报。
consultant:0.hook: The consultant's first word was my real name.
consultant:0.line: 'The *consultant* arrives at midnight — trust no one else in this room.'

direct:0.en: Ali pulled up the building schematic on her wrist screen. Every route to the core server had a camera, a guard, a trap. 'There is one *direct* path,' she said quietly, tracing a thin line straight through the centre, 'but it goes past Zero's post.' My throat went dry.
direct:0.cnHint: 阿栗发现了一条____的路线，但那条路正好穿过零点的据点。
direct:0.hook: That straight line on the map meant only one thing: a trap.
direct:0.line: 'Take the *direct* route — and Zero will be waiting at the end.'

discourage:0.en: Zero's voice came over the broken speaker, slow and cold. 'I set those false alerts to *discourage* you,' he said. 'Every dead end you hit tonight was my design.' I looked at Ali. She was already checking the exit. We had wasted two hours walking his maze.
discourage:0.cnHint: 零点承认那些假警报是为了____我们，让我们在迷宫中浪费时间。
discourage:0.hook: Behind us, the only real exit clicked locked.
discourage:0.line: 'Nothing will *discourage* me — I have already mapped your maze.'

essentially:0.en: Grey Crow laid the decoded file on the table without a word. I read it twice. The city's entire data grid was *essentially* one locked room, and Zero held the single key. All our side routes, all our backup plans — they led to the same sealed door.
essentially:0.cnHint: 灰鸦展示的文件说明，整座城市的数据网____上只有一个出口，钥匙在零点手中。
essentially:0.hook: One key, one door, one person standing between us and it.
essentially:0.line: 'You are *essentially* trapped — every path leads back to me.'

extent:0.en: I asked Grey Crow how far Zero's control actually reached. He was quiet for a long moment, then opened a second map — the whole city, every node lit red. 'To this *extent*,' he said softly, pressing his finger against the edge of the map. There was no edge left unmarked.
extent:0.cnHint: 灰鸦展开地图，揭示了零点控制范围的____，整张图几乎全部变红。
extent:0.hook: Not one dark corner remained beyond Zero's reach.
extent:0.line: 'The *extent* of his power is every light you see from this window.'

finance:0.en: Ali cracked the last encrypted log. The numbers inside were clean, official, stamped with the city seal. Someone high up was using public *finance* to keep Zero's network running — paid for by every citizen who never knew it existed. I photographed each line before the screen went dark.
finance:0.cnHint: 阿栗破解的日志显示，有人动用公共____为零点的网络提供资金支持。
finance:0.hook: The city seal on that document pointed straight to the top floor.
finance:0.line: 'Public *finance* built his network — the people paid for their own cage.'

freedom:0.en: The holding room had no windows. I had been inside for three hours when Grey Crow slid a card under the door. One word on it: move. He had bought me exactly forty seconds of *freedom* inside the locked system — time enough to copy one file and run.
freedom:0.cnHint: 灰鸦为我争取到了短短四十秒的____，刚好够复制一份关键文件。
freedom:0.hook: Forty seconds — and the copied file would change everything.
freedom:0.line: 'Forty seconds of *freedom* is all I can give — do not waste one.'

highlight:0.en: Grey Crow scrolled through the intercepted broadcast, looking bored — until his finger stopped. He leaned close, then *highlighted* a single phrase buried in the noise: three words that matched the pattern we had been hunting for weeks. Ali saw it too. Nobody spoke for a full breath.
highlight:0.cnHint: 灰鸦在截获的广播中____出一个隐藏短语，正是我们追踪数周的信号模式。
highlight:0.hook: Three words, and the entire case snapped into focus.
highlight:0.line: '*Highlight* that phrase — it is the key they never bothered to hide.'

invite:1.en: The coded graffiti on the wet wall read: *invite* only. Grey Crow traced the symbol with one finger. 'This is not a warning,' she said quietly. 'It is a door.' I looked up and down the empty street. Every window was dark. Someone had planned this meeting very carefully.
invite:1.cnHint: 灰鸦发现墙上的暗语，说明这是一个特别的____，我意识到有人精心安排了这次见面。
invite:1.hook: Behind the wall, a signal began to pulse.
invite:1.line: 'They only *invite* those they have already chosen.'

million:1.en: Zero's voice cut through the rain. 'There are a *million* encrypted tags on these walls, rookie. Only three matter tonight.' I pressed my back against the cold brick and listened harder. The city hummed. Hidden inside that hum was a message no one else could hear — but I could.
million:1.cnHint: 零点告诉我城市墙壁上有____条加密标记，其中只有三条至关重要。
million:1.hook: One of those three tags was already changing.
million:1.line: 'A *million* false signals, and the truth is hiding in plain sight.'

represent:1.en: Ali pointed to the symbol burned into the street sign above us. 'Each mark they leave must *represent* something,' she said, her breath fogging in the cold air. I scanned the pattern. Four shapes. Four districts. The final shape pointed straight to the harbor. My pulse jumped.
represent:1.cnHint: 阿里指出街头每个符号都____着某种含义，我发现最后一个图案指向了港口。
represent:1.hook: The harbor gate had been sealed for ten years.
represent:1.line: 'Every mark they make must *represent* a command — find them all.'

surprise:1.en: The package sat on the wet pavement, unmarked. Ali nudged it with her boot. My hidden-signal sense fired all at once — sharp, bright, wrong. 'Do not open it here,' I said. Grey Crow arrived at a run, her coat soaked through. The look on her face was not *surprise*. She had known this would be here.
surprise:1.cnHint: 我们在街上发现了一个神秘包裹，灰鸦赶来时脸上没有一丝____，她早就知道它在那里。
surprise:1.hook: Grey Crow reached into her coat and said nothing.
surprise:1.line: 'No *surprise* at all — which means she left it herself.'

topic:1.en: On every corner, the screens were locked to one *topic*: a city-wide signal failure reported at midnight. I knew better. Ali read the text aloud and then stopped. Hidden in the news bulletin, between every third word, was a different message entirely — one meant only for us. The night felt suddenly smaller.
topic:1.cnHint: 城市屏幕上只显示一个____，但阿里在每隔三个词的间隙里发现了另一条秘密信息。
topic:1.hook: The hidden message ended with our names.
topic:1.line: 'That *topic* is a cover — read the spaces between the words.'

meat:1.en: The night market was still open, steam rising from every stall. I followed Grey Crow past rows of *meat* hanging on iron hooks, their shadows swinging like slow clocks. 'Zero chose this place on purpose,' she murmured. 'Too much noise. Too many people.' Then I heard it — a signal, thin and sharp, threading through the crowd.
meat:1.cnHint: 灰鸦带我穿过夜市，悬挂的____投下摇摆的阴影，我在嘈杂人群中捕捉到一个微弱信号。
meat:1.hook: The signal was coming from directly above us.
meat:1.line: 'He hides his codes where the smell of *meat* covers every other trace.'

drink:1.en: A street vendor handed me a cup without being asked. I did not *drink* it. Grey Crow had taught me that rule on my first night: nothing given freely in Harbor City is actually free. I set the cup down on the pavement and watched it. A thin wire of steam rose from it in a shape I recognised — a signal glyph.
drink:1.cnHint: 小贩主动递给我一杯饮料，我没有____它，因为杯中升起的雾气形成了一个信号符文。
drink:1.hook: Someone nearby was watching to see if I understood.
drink:1.line: 'Never *drink* what the city offers you without reading it first.'

sleep:1.en: I had not found *sleep* in two days. The street was quiet now, the neon reflecting in long ribbons on the wet road. Zero had gone silent. That was worse than noise. Ali leaned against the wall beside me and closed her eyes for one moment. 'He is not resting,' she said. 'He is resetting.'
sleep:1.cnHint: 我已经两天没有____了，零点突然沉默让我更加不安，阿里说他不是在休息，而是在重新布局。
sleep:1.hook: Then every screen in the street went black at once.
sleep:1.line: 'Forget *sleep* — Zero never stops, and tonight neither do we.'

shop:1.en: The rain hammered the street. I pushed open the door of a narrow *shop* wedged between two crumbling walls. Shelves lined every surface — old data chips, cracked visors, broken signal boosters. Ali had told me to look for a blue mark above the counter. I found it, still wet.
shop:1.cnHint: 我走进一家狭窄的____，在货架后面发现了一个还未干透的蓝色暗记。
shop:1.hook: Behind the counter, something moved in the dark.
shop:1.line: 'This *shop* sells more than junk — look closer,' Ali whispered.

electronic:1.en: Grey Crow led me down a back alley where every wall buzzed with *electronic* signals — thin wires threaded through cracked paint, tiny lights blinking in patterns too fast for the eye. The city was speaking in code. I pressed my ear to the wall and heard a name: Zero.
electronic:1.cnHint: 在布满____信号的小巷里，我从嗡嗡作响的墙壁中听到了一个名字。
electronic:1.hook: That name was supposed to be dead and buried.
electronic:1.line: 'Every *electronic* pulse here is a message — read them,' Grey Crow said.

wild:1.en: The outer ring of Harbor City was *wild* — no lights, no signals, just broken ground and wind that cut like wire. I ran across the open space, coat flat against my back. Ali had marked a shelter on my map. I reached it. The door was already open.
wild:1.cnHint: 在城市边缘那片____的荒地上，我跑向阿栗标记的藏身处，却发现门已经开着。
wild:1.line: 'Out here it goes *wild* — trust nothing, not even the map,' Ali said.

rich:1.en: Zero operated from the bright center of the city, where the towers were tall and the data was *rich* — deep streams of encrypted finance, identity records, city contracts. Grey Crow said anyone who cracked that core could own Harbor City. I was beginning to believe it.
rich:1.cnHint: 零点藏身于数据____的城市核心地带，据说掌控那里就能掌控整座城市。
rich:1.hook: Grey Crow had been inside that core once before.
rich:1.line: 'The data here is *rich* — one file could end Zero's game,' Grey Crow said.
